summary.en: The Galatia Academy storyline: from the tutorial through "A People's History of Collapse", finding Coureuse, Project Ziggurat, and At the Gates.
summary.zh: Galatia 学院主线：从新手任务到《大崩塌人民史》、寻找 Coureuse、Ziggurat 计划，直至"群星之门"。

briefing.zh: 前往 Galatia 学院，并与新任院长

briefing.en: Return the data core to Academician Sebestyen. He'll get you your reward.
briefing.zh: 将数据核心交还给 Sebestyen 院士，并领取你的报酬。

briefing.en: marines will be needed to perform the recovery.
'Autonomous weapon systems' may pose a danger.
briefing.zh: 一个独特的超导结构元件

briefing.en: Avoid the black hole located in-system.
briefing.zh: 避开位于星系中的黑洞。

briefing.en: Go to the nearest jump-point and retrieve the instrument package from scavengers before they leave the system.
briefing.zh: 从探测器中打捞仪器套件，目标

briefing.en: , and drop off a small team of scientists at an outpost located there.
briefing.zh: ，并将一小队科学家送到 位于那里的 一个前哨站中。
一个独特的可再生结构元件

briefing.en: , and contact the 'researcher' at the Tri-Tachyon black research site located there.
briefing.zh: ，与位于速子 黑色研究基地 中的 '研究员' 联系。
联系 Galatia 学院的院士
联系 Galatia 学院的院长

briefing.en: You've found Academician Scylla Coureuse and brought her out of hiding to return her to work on Baird's secret project at the Galatia Academy.
Get a lead on the whereabouts of Kelise Astraia, who is associated with a secret Tri-Tachyon research base called "Alpha Site".
briefing.zh: 找到 Kelise Astraia 的下落，此人和被称为 "阿尔法研究站" 的 速子科技 秘密研究基地有关系。

briefing.en: She is sentimental about the ship - her first independent command - and is willing to pay a large sum for its return.
briefing.zh: 将 ISS Hamatsu 号还给

briefing.en: You've recovered the data archive of the Academy's previous Provost, Tomas Kallichore, which contains the results of failed gate activation experiments.
Contact Horus Yaribay to get envoy credentials so you can contact High Hegemon Daud.
briefing.zh: 联系 Horus Yaribay，来获得特使凭证，这样你就可以联系至高霸主 Daud 了。

briefing.en: Go directly to the coordinates held in the array's data.
briefing.zh: 直接前往阵列数据中记录的坐标。

texts.en:
The comms link crackles with static, then clears to an image of the scavenger captain.

"Greetings fellow starfarer," $heOrShe says. "What brings you out here? Can't say we've found much worth salvaging lately, ha-ha."

Something seems a little off. It doesn't feel like pirates this time. What is it?
texts.zh:
通讯链接伴随着静电的噼啪声，随后清晰的显示出拾荒者舰长的图像。

"你好，同道的远行者。" $HeOrShe说，"是什么风把你吹这来了？我们最近可没有发现什么值得打捞的东西，哈-哈。"

你察觉到有什么不对劲。这次看起来并不像是海盗。这会是什么？

options.en: Probably nothing. Exchange pleasantries and sign off.
options.zh: 可能无关紧要。寒暄后关闭通讯链接。

options.en: Request that they transfer the probe's instrument package to you. Immediately.
options.zh: 要求他们立刻把探测器仪器套件转移给你。

texts.en: You cut the comm link after exchanging a few pleasantries.
texts.zh: 你在寒暄了几句后切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe looks shocked. "I... " $heOrShe swallows. With a dry throat; you can tell. "The package? I mean, what probe? Dammit."

The pretense drops under your withering stare. "It's ours fair and square," $heOrShe stammers, "Right of salvage. We all know how it works."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe看起来很震惊。"我..." $HeOrShe哽咽着。多么喉咙干哑的声音，令你印象深刻。"套件？我是说，什么探测器？该死。"

在你无情的凝视下，对方卸下了伪装。"这是为了我们的公平和公正，" $HeOrShe结巴的说到，"打捞权，这我们都懂的吧。"

options.en: Ask if the probe's transponder was active when this "salvage" took place
options.zh: 询问这次 "打捞" 发生的时候，探测器的应答器是否处于激活状态。

texts.en:
You explain that, as every scavenger knows, an uncrewed probe with an operational transponder is not legal salvage. And the Galatia Academy is a very well connected institution. And the Academy has been known to be rather litigious when it comes to their research equipment.

Guilt is written across the captain's face. "We just... we were going to-"
texts.zh:
你解释道，每一个拾荒者都知道，打捞带有应答器的无人探测器是不合法的行为。Galatia 学院的人脉很广。而且众所周知，当涉及到他们的研究设备时，学院可是相当纠缠不休的。

舰长的脸上写满了内疚。"我们只是...我们打算 ——"

options.en: Immediately transfer the instrument package to my ship.
options.zh: 请立即将仪器套件转移到我的船上。

texts.en:
"Yes, of course." $HeOrShe turns to an underling and says something that isn't quite picked up by the comms. "It'll be in-transit in just a moment, captain."

$HeOrShe mumbles an abashed farewell platitude and signs off just as your logistics officer reports an incoming cargo drone.
texts.zh:
"是的，当然。" $HeOrShe转向一个下属说了些什么，没有被通讯系统传过来。"它马上就会送到，舰长"

$HeOrShe有些困窘地低声说了些道别的话语，结束了谈话，正好你的后勤官报告说有一架接近的货运无人机。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The comms link crackles with static, then clears to an image of the scavenger captain.

"Greetings fellow starfarer," $heOrShe says. "What brings you out here? Can't say we've found much worth salvaging lately, ha-ha."
texts.zh:
通讯链接伴随着静电的噼啪声，随后清晰的显示出拾荒者舰长的影像。

"你好，同道的远行者。" $HeOrShe说，"是什么风把你吹这来了？我们最近可没有发现什么值得打捞的东西，哈-哈。"

options.en: Confront them about the probe
options.zh: 与他们就探测器进行对峙。

options.en: I'm sorry to hear it. Burn bright.
options.zh: 我很抱歉听到这些。祝航行无阻。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe looks shocked. "I... " $heOrShe swallows. With a dry throat; you can tell. "The package? I mean, what probe? Dammit."

The pretense drops under your withering stare, replaced with defiance. "It's ours fair and square. Right of salvage. We all know how it works."
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe看起来很震惊。"我..." $HeOrShe哽咽着。多么喉咙干哑的声音，令你印象深刻。"套件？我是说，什么探测器？该死。"

在你无情的凝视下，对方卸下了伪装，换上了顽固。"这是为了我们的公平和公正，打捞权，这我们都懂的吧。"

options.en: Ask if the probe's transponder was active when this "salvage" took place
options.zh: 询问当这次"打捞"发生的时候，探测器的应答器是否处于激活状态。

texts.en: "Well." $HeOrShe glances to one side, as if someone over there might have a better answer than the truth.
texts.zh: "很好。" $HeOrShe向一边瞥了一眼，似乎那边的人可能会知道比真相更好的答案。

options.en: Explain "how it works" to the scavenger
options.zh: 向拾荒者解释"道上的规矩"。

texts.en:
You explain that, as every scavenger knows, an uncrewed probe with an operational transponder is not legal salvage. And that the Galatia Academy is a very well connected institution. And that the Academy is extremely litigious when it comes to meddling with their research equipment.

Guilt is written across the captain's face. $HeOrShe stammers "We just... we were going to-"
texts.zh:
你解释道，每一个拾荒者都知道，打捞一个带应答器的无人探测器是不合法的。Galatia 学院的人脉很广。众所周知，当涉及到他们的研究设备时，该学院可是相当纠缠不休的。

舰长的脸上写满了内疚。"我们只是...我们打算 ——"

options.en: Immediately transfer the instrument package to my ship.
options.zh: 请立即将仪器套件转移到我的船上。

texts.en:
"Yes. Of course."

Defeated, $heOrShe turns to an underling and says something that isn't quite picked up by the comms. "It'll be in-transit in just a moment, captain."

$HeOrShe mumbles an abashed fare-well platitude and signs off just as your logistics officer reports an incoming cargo drone.
texts.zh:
"是的，当然。"

自认失败之后，$HeOrShe转向一个下属，说了几句没有完全被通讯器给捕捉进去的话。"货物片刻之后就会抵达，舰长。"

$HeOrShe喃喃地说了一句羞愧的告别语，然后签了字，这时你的后勤官报告说有一架货运无人机接近。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Tell Baird you want to change your approach to the Coureuse mission
options.zh: 告诉 Baird 你想改变寻找 Coureuse 的方法

texts.en: "Oh?" Baird's tone is neutral, behind it you can only feel the weight of an unresolved quantum state of judgment. "If you want to change your approach, make sure that this is your final decision, captain."
texts.zh: "哦？" 你从 Baird 的语气中听不出她的态度，就好像她的决断正处于无法确定的量子叠加态一般，"如果你想改变你处理这事的方法，确保这是你的最终决定，舰长。"

options.en: I'd like to take the exploration path.
options.zh: 我想用探索的方法来处理这事。

options.en: Never mind.
options.zh: 算了。

texts.en:
"Very well," she says, "Exploration it is. I shall ensure that you have the data you need to carry out your revised mission."

Provost Baird turns back to her desk display, reading something. "May I assume that is all, captain?"
texts.zh:
"很好，" 她说，"那就探索吧。我会确保你能得到执行调整后的任务所需的资料。"

Baird 把目光投向了她桌上的显示屏，读着什么东西。"舰长，我猜你没别的事了吧？"

options.en: Tell Baird you want to change your approach to the Coureuse mission
options.zh: 告诉 Baird 你想改变寻找 Coureuse 的方法

texts.en: "Oh?" Baird's tone is neutral, behind it you can only feel the weight of an unresolved quantum state of judgment. "If you're sure you want to change your approach, make sure that this is your final decision, captain."
texts.zh: "哦？" 你从 Baird 的语气中听不出她的态度，就好像她的决断正处于无法确定的量子叠加态一般，"如果你想改变处理这事的方法，请确定这是你的最终决定，舰长。"

options.en: I'd like to take the diplomatic path.
options.zh: 我想用外交对话的方法来处理这事。

options.en: Never mind.
options.zh: 算了。

texts.en:
"Very well," she says, "Diplomacy it is. I shall ensure that you have the data you need to carry out your revised mission."

Provost Baird turns back to her desk display, reading something. "May I assume that is all, captain?"
texts.zh:
"很好，" 她说，"那就外交对话吧。我会确保你能得到执行调整后的任务所需的资料。"

Baird 把目光投向了她桌上的显示屏，读着什么东西。"舰长，我猜你没别的事了吧？"

texts.en:
The comms link holds for a few moments on the understated crest of Persean League Fleet Intelligence before connecting.

"Greetings, I am Lieutenant Finlay Siyavong with the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service," Siyavong says. "How may I be of assistance?"
texts.zh:
通讯链接在英仙座联盟舰队情报部那枚低调的徽记上停了片刻，随后接通。

"您好，我是英仙座联盟舰队情报部的 Finlay Siyavong 中尉，\" Siyavong 说道。\"有什么可以效劳？"

texts.en: Your sensors officer reports that an ejected cargo pod floating in a spray of post-battle debris contains something that matches the mission target specifications.
texts.zh: 你的传感器技官报告道，一个弹射出来的货舱漂浮在战后碎片的包围中，其中包含符合任务目标规格的东西。

texts.en:
The scavenger captain flickers into your comm display.

"Greetings. Pardon my presumption, but I hope all is well? It's a long way back to the core worlds my friend, and we must look after one another."
texts.zh:
拾荒者的舰长在你的通讯显示器上闪烁着。

"你好。请原谅我的打扰，希望你那里一切都好？回到核心世界的路还很长，我的朋友，我们必须互相照顾。"
effects: # remove important tag from finding empty probe

options.en: Did you happen to find a probe belonging to the Galatia Academy?
options.zh: 你有没有找到过一个属于 Galatia 学院的探测器？

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Ah..." The scavenger looks aside to avoid your gaze. "One finds all sorts of things out here and I, I couldn't really say if we did or not. I'd uh, have to have my assessor check the logs."

$HeOrShe shrugs with one shoulder, "Might take a while."
texts.zh:
"我明白了。" 拾荒者看向一旁，避开了你的目光。"人们在这里可以找到各种各样的东西，我也不能确定我到底找到了没有。我得让我的评估员检查一下日志。"

$HeOrShe耸了耸肩，"可能需要一段时间。"

options.en: I have all the time in the world.
options.zh: 我可以在这等到世界终结。

options.en: Perhaps a 'donation' could help speed things along.
options.zh: 也许一点点 '捐助' 能加速这个过程。

options.en: I'm authorized to recover Academy property- by force, if necessary.
options.zh: 学院允许我在必要时动用武力回收这个东西。

texts.en:
"Very well, captain. We have to do some minor repairs anyway. I'll be sure to forward your concern to my assessor who, I assure you, is doing their utmost to find your, ah, missing property."

The scavenger switches the feed to a generic holding signal.

You order your navigator to maintain position relative to the scavenger fleet, and to keep an eye out for any funny business.
texts.zh:
"很好，舰长。反正现在我们要做一些小修理。我一定会把你的关切转达给我的评估员，我向你保证，他们正在尽最大努力寻找你的，呃，失踪的财产。"

拾荒者将通讯频道切到通用待机信号。

你命令你的领航员保持与拾荒者舰队的相对位置，并注意任何异常情况。

options.en: Wait
options.zh: 等着

texts.en:
It doesn't take long.

Your comms officer interrupts your reverie. "Captain! Something in the scavenger flagship cargo hold just emitted a short range comms pulse. Seen this before, profile fits a Pather op. Maybe pirates."

A breath later, the comms hold signal switches to the distraught face of the scavenger captain.
texts.zh:
没过多久。

通讯军官的一声大喊打断了你的沉思。"舰长！拾荒者旗舰货舱里的某个东西刚刚发出了一道短程通讯脉冲。我们以前见过这个，符合卢德左径的特征，也有可能是海盗。"

通讯频道的信号几乎马上就切换到拾荒者舰长那慌张的脸上。

options.en: Wait
options.zh: 等着

texts.en:
"You didn't tell us it was trapped!" $heOrShe shouts in panic, "You should have said something, you should have- no, we need to get out of here. I'm ejecting the damn thing. Tell them I don't have it!"

The comms snap off.

Your tactical officer reports that the scavenger fleet is powering up engines.
texts.zh:
"你没告诉我们它是陷阱！" $heOrShe惊恐地喊道，"你应该告诉我的，你应该 —— 不，我们得离开这里。我要丢了那该死的东西。告诉他们那玩意儿不在我这！"

通讯中断了。

战术军官报告说，拾荒者舰队正在开动引擎。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: "Oh, well now." The scavenger smiles, "Time is money, isn't it? And at faster than light speeds, my account books start doing funny things, ha-ha. I'm sure we could get some more of the crew checking cargo pods if there was some incentive... let's say $gaFC_bribeCost credits."
texts.zh: "哦，当然了。" 拾荒者微笑着说，"时间就是金钱，不是吗？我的账本开始以超越光速的效率做一些有趣的事情，哈哈。我相信，如果得到一些激励的话，我可以让更多的船员检查货舱...比方说 $gaFC_bribeCost 星币。"

options.en: I'll transfer those credits to speed things along. (bribe)
options.zh: 我会给你一些星币来加速这个过程。 (贿赂)

options.en: Actually, I have all the time in the world. (wait)
options.zh: 事实上，我可以等到世界终结。 (等着)

options.en: Don't test me. I will use force to recover Galatia Academy property if necessary.
options.zh: 不要考验我的耐心，Galatia 学院允许我在必要时用武力回收。

texts.en:
You authorize the credits transfer and can pin-point the moment it arrives because a wide smile breaks over the scavenger captain's face.

"Glad we could do business, captain. I've ordered my quartermaster to eject the cargo pod in question, so it's all yours," the scavenger says magnanimously.

"Burn bright captain, I'm sure we'll meet again!" $HeOrShe closes the comms before you can comment on the uncannily speedy 'discovery' of the Galatia Academy probe.
texts.zh:
你授权支付了星币。拾荒者舰长的脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容，你确定星币成功到账了。

"很高兴我们能做生意，舰长。我已经命令我的军需官弹出你想要的货舱，它就交由你处置了。" 拾荒者真诚地说道。

"航行无阻，舰长，相信我们会再见面的！" $HeOrShe关闭了通讯器，快到你都没来得及质疑这颗 Galatia 学院的探测器怎么这么容易就能找到。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I- ah, I see." The scavenger taps at a console and appears to think for about a second.

"Oh, would you look at that, we did find something with Galatia Academy markings. Must have slipped my mind."

$HeOrShe looks at you accusingly, "Would've returned it once it was identified properly. You could have asked nicely. We gotta look out for each other out here, remember? Otherwise we're no better than pirates or the boot-licking Heggies."
texts.zh:
"我 —— 呃，我懂了。" 拾荒者敲击着一个控制台，思考了大约一秒钟。

"哦，你看看这个，我们确实找到了带有 Galatia 学院标记的东西。一定是我忘了。"

$HeOrShe指责地看着你，"只要我们找到了，就会归还它。你可以礼貌的问我们。我们必须在这里互相照顾，懂吗？否则就和海盗或 霸主 的那些狗官一样。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I've ordered my quartermaster to eject the cargo pod, so it's all yours," the scavenger says testily. "Burn bright captain... into an asteroid, for all I care."

The comms are abruptly disconnected.
texts.zh:
"我已经命令军需官弹出货舱，它现在归你了。" 拾荒者试探性地说道，"航行无阻...撞上小行星也无所谓，我才不在乎。"

通讯突然中断了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Tell Baird that Coureuse is in the Isirah system
options.zh: 告诉 Baird，Coureuse 现在在 Isirah 星系。

texts.en:
Provost Baird looks over her spectacles at you, "But you have not made contact yet. Because if you had, that is what you would be telling me."

She sighs, and raises her eyes briefly to the firmament, such as it is. "Very well..."

"If your information can be trusted, it may be effective to simply confront the local authorities with that knowledge and see what you might ascertain." She's gone into full lecture mode. "Bluff, perhaps. Competing authorities in-system might have knowledge of the activities of their counterparts; intel and counter-intel. Those less scrupulous might be bribed - and before you ask, I believe we've paid you quite enough already to carry out this mission one way or another without another creative entry for the bursar's office."
texts.zh:
Baird 院长的目光越过那往下滑了些许的眼镜投向你，"但是你还没有与她取得联系。因为如果你那么做了，那才是你该告诉我的事。"

她叹了口气，短暂地抬起眼睛望向天空 —— 大概是天空的方向。"很好..."

"如果信息是可靠的，那么你可以直接向当地政府了解情况来看看你能查明些什么，这或许会是有效的办法。" 她已经进入了演讲的状态。"虚张声势，大概吧。星系内相互竞争的当局可能知道对方的活动；情报工作与反情报工作。那些不那么谨慎的人可能会被贿赂 —— 在你开口之前，我得说我们已经给了你足够的钱，让你不管怎样都能完成这项任务，所以不要再为财务处添乱了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Pacing, she turns from the bay windows illuminating her office, "On the other hand, you might adopt an even less direct approach. Certain low-lifes and radicals, even Luddic Pathists, may follow in the wake of Coureuse. Or be looking for her themselves. I'm confident that you can handle such scum."

She stops, and faces you, "Not every problem can be solved with direct application of force," a slight smile appears, "All knowledge, perhaps, is the result of this human frustration. Now, go. You will be rewarded once I am in contact with Scylla Coureuse."
texts.zh:
她在照亮她办公室的凸窗前转过了身子，踱步起来，"另一方面，你也可以采取一种不那么直接的方式。某些底层居民和激进人士，甚至是卢德的左径分子，都可能在追踪着 Coureuse。或者是自己也在找她。我相信你有能力从这些人渣入手。"

她停了下来，面对着你，"并不是所有的问题都能通过简单粗暴的方式解决，" 一个微笑出现在了她脸上，"也许，所有的知识都是人类遭受挫折后总结出来的。现在，去吧。等我能联系上 Scylla Coureuse，你就可以得到报酬。"

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

options.en: I'm looking for someone called Scylla Coureuse.
options.zh: 我在找一个叫 Scylla Coureuse 的人。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe looks you over, licks $hisOrHer lips, and thinks the question over for a moment.

"Might know someone by the name, might not. Why should I tell you?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe打量着你，舔了舔$hisOrHer的嘴唇，并稍微思考了一会。

"我也许知道这个人，也许并不。我为什么要告诉你呢？"

options.en: Let's talk about credits.
options.zh: 让我们来谈谈钱的事吧。

options.en: I'm one of you, you can work with me. I've got a reputation.
options.zh: 我是你们中的一员，我们可以合作一下。要知道我可是很有名气的。

options.en: Because uh, Warlord Kanta said so?
options.zh: 因为，呃，军阀 Kanta 这么说了？

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
The pirate boss leans forward. "You have my attention, good captain."

"If you could come up with... let's say $gaFC_kapteynBribeCost reasons why I should help you out, it might be that I'd be so inclined."
texts.zh:
海盗头子稍微往前倾了倾身子。"你成功地吸引了我的注意力，明事理的舰长。"

"如果你能支付...嗯，$gaFC_kapteynBribeCost 星币，我就可以帮你 —— 并且十分愿意这么做。"

options.en: Accept
options.zh: 同意付款

options.en: Let's talk about Scylla Coureuse again, instead.
options.zh: 我们还是再来谈谈这个 Scylla Coureuse 吧。

texts.en: "You've got a way with words, you know that?" $personName says with a conspiratorial smile, flashing gold teeth, "Very persuasive."
texts.zh: "你这张嘴可真会说话，知道吗？" $personName 露出一副阴森的笑容，你能看到对方那闪烁着的金牙，"非常有说服力。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I may have heard something from someone. It's my business, right, knowing who's making the moves in the Isirah system, and to who."

$HeOrShe leans close to the comms pick-up, and speaks quietly "Word is the Persean League started asking a lot of questions about someone named 'Coureuse', and that was because the Hegemony started asking around first."
texts.zh:
"我从某些人那里得到了一些信息。对，这就是我的工作 —— 去调查谁在 Isirah 星系里搞小动作，以及他们是为谁而行动。"

$HeOrShe凑得离通讯设备更近了一些，轻声说道："听说 英仙座联盟 最近到处打听一个叫 'Coureuse' 的人，因为 霸主 率先对此展开了调查。"

options.en: And?
options.zh: 然后呢？

texts.en:
"And then just about all at once the League snitches all stopped asking about Coureuse. That tells me, $firstName, it looks like someone found who they were looking for. It also tells me they're not a real experienced operation. Leave it to the League, right? Appointing offices by influence more than ability. I'd never abide by that."

"Anyway, shortly after that a unit of top pay-grade League agents fresh from Kazeron set up shop on Laicaille Habitat."
texts.zh:
"然后，英仙座联盟里的眼线们突然就都不再问 'Coureuse' 的事了。那我可就知道了啊，$firstName，估计是有人找到了他们想找的人。这同时还让我知道那些人并不是经验老道的特工。有什么事都直接丢给英仙座联盟 —— 对吧？他们任命官员居然不考核能力而是考核影响力，真让我看不下去。"

"总之，在那之后不久，一群从 Kazeron 来的太子爷 英仙座联盟 特工就开始在 Laicaille 栖息地 '安居乐业' 了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Now, being a curious individual and a friend of the friendless, I was on the lookout for a League crackdown on our legitimate business operations. But it didn't come. Just the same-old same-old. 'So what're those spies doing on Laicaille?', I asked myself."

"I paid a real professional surveillance contractor and they got me list of names, rented properties, and schedule of activities. Looks like they've got some fancy safehouse set-up." The Pirate boss taps a datapad and your comms ping to alert you to an incoming file. "You've bought yourself a copy of the data, my friend."
texts.zh:
"现在，作为一个好奇心旺盛的人和那些无业游民的朋友，我估计 英仙座联盟 就要开始打击我们那些明面上的企业了。但它没有这么做。而是让一切保持着原样，那么那些间谍到底来 Laicaille 做什么呢？我这么问我自己。"

"我雇了一个专业监控团队，之后他们给了我一份清单，上面有一堆名字，租借房屋信息以及一些活动的日程表。看起来特工们在这里弄好了一些精致的安全屋。" 海盗头子轻触了一下数据平板，你的通讯器则发出了接收到文件的提示音。"你给自己搞到了一份资料，我的朋友。"

options.en: I do like to keep informed.
options.zh: 我确实喜欢保持消息灵通。

texts.en:
$HeOrShe leans back, putting on a casual act. "Me, I just ask questions. Maybe you're looking for answers, maybe you'll find one. Maybe it'll teach those League goons a bit of humility." The pirate smiles broadly at this thought.

"Just don't forget who helped you along, right?"
texts.zh:
$HeOrShe靠回了椅背，摆出一副漫不经心的样子。"我只是个问问题的人，答案还得你自己去找，也许你还真能找到什么东西。希望你的努力能让那些英仙座联盟的呆子们变得谦逊一些。" 海盗头子讲到这里，自己都笑了出来。

"别忘了是谁帮的你，如何？"

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
With only one piece of evidence that Coureuse is at Laicaille Habitat you're not absolutely certain it would not be dismissed as merely circumstantial if you attempted to leverage it against the authorities.

You need to find one more piece of corroborating evidence.
texts.zh:
现在只有一项证据表明 Coureuse 在 Laicaille 栖息地，如果你试图以某种方式利用它对当局提出质疑，对方可能会以这只是间接证据为由不予考虑。

你得再找一个确凿的证据。

texts.en:
With multiple pieces of evidence, you feel confident that you have sufficient leverage to confront authorities at Laicaille Habitat about Scylla Coureuse.

It is time to talk to the archon of Laicaille Habitat.
texts.zh:
现在你有了两份不同的证据，你觉得自己已经有足够的筹码去和 Laicaille 栖息地的当局就 Scylla Coureuse 的事进行对质。

是时候和 Laicaille 栖息地的执政官谈谈了。

texts.en:
The pirate boss frowns, then reaches for $hisOrHer console. "One moment, captain."

The comm feed blanks to an ancient holding pattern for the Eridani-Utopia Corporation.
texts.zh:
海盗头子皱了皱眉头，然后将手伸向了$hisOrHer的控制台。"稍等，舰长。"

通讯信号突然失效了，呈现在你面前的东西变成了古老的 波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 的等候界面。

options.en: Wait
options.zh: 等待

options.en: Wait
options.zh: 等待

texts.en:
The feed flips back on. $personName is examining a datapad in $hisOrHer hands.

"Very funny, captain... $playerName. Because it looks to me more like if you'd got yourself the chance, you'd turn me in to the closest League fleet for a handful of credits and a pat on the head." $HeOrShe drops the datapad with a clatter.

"If that's how it is, that's how it is. I don't expect anything more, and I'll shoot you down myself if you step out of line on my station. But don't pretend to be my friend when you're nothing but a fawning bootlicker when an official patrol comes sniffing around."
texts.zh:
信号又恢复了。$personName 正在查看$HeOrShe手中的数据平板。

"非常有趣，$playerName... 舰长。因为在我看来，你一有机会就会把我交给最近的 英仙座联盟舰队 来换取一些荣誉和奖励。" $HeOrShe在一声重响之中将数据平板砸到了地上。

"就这样了，我可没期望从你那里得到什么，如果你在我的空间站上有越线的行为，我就亲自毙了你。你什么也不是，只是一个会阿谀奉承的马屁精，所以别假装我们很熟，特别是当有巡逻队在这附近嗅来嗅去的时候。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: The pirate boss slaps at the comms console and the line disconnects, leaving you staring at static.
texts.zh: 海盗头子拍打着控制台挂掉了通讯，你只能对着一堆噪点干瞪眼。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
The feed flips back on. $personName is examining a datapad in $hisOrHer hands and looking much more relaxed.

"Ah, $playername. I knew I'd heard that name somewhere. Yeah, alright. You've done some things for us. So I could do a thing for you. Just you don't forget it when the goings get tough, and be sure to tell good like-minded folks that $personName is a friend to all freedom-loving individuals who've been put on the wrong side of the law."
texts.zh:
信号又恢复了。$personName 正在查看$HeOrShe手中的数据平板，对方看起来比之前放松了一些。

"啊，$playername。我就知道我在哪儿听过这个名字。对，不错，你为我们做过一些事情，所以现在我也可以帮你个忙。当事情变得棘手起来时不要忘了这一点，还有，一定要告诉志同道合的人，$personName 是所有热爱自由但被法律抛弃的人的好朋友。"

options.en: You can count on it, friend.
options.zh: 你可以放心，朋友。

texts.en:
"No she didn't. Get lost."

The pirate boss slaps at the comms console and the line disconnects, leaving you staring at static over nothing.
texts.zh:
"不，她没有，滚。"

海盗头子轻拍了一下通讯控制台，通讯就被断开了，你眼前的屏幕除了噪点以外只剩一片漆黑。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
After a few minutes the secretary reappears.

"I'm sorry," they say, smiling. "But the Prime Demarchon is unavailable. Would you like to leave a message?"
texts.zh:
片刻过后，秘书再度现身。

"很抱歉，" 对方微笑着说道，"大统领暂时无法接见。您需要留言吗？"

options.en: I'm looking for Scylla Coureuse. I believe she is on Laicaille Habitat.
options.zh: 我正在寻找 Scylla Coureuse，我确定她正在 Laicaille 栖息地上。

options.en: I would like to speak with the Prime Demarchon about joining the Persean League.
options.zh: 我想和大统领谈谈加入 英仙座联盟 的事。

options.en: I would like to offer my services to Reynard Hannan. My reputation should speak for itself.
options.zh: 我希望能为 Reynard Hannan 效力。我的名声应该足以证明我的实力。

options.en: I have important information concerning the Gates to discuss with the Prime Demarchon.
options.zh: 我有关于星门的重要信息需要与大统领讨论。

options.en: I have important information concerning the Gates to discuss with the Prime Demarchon.
options.zh: 我有关于星门的重要信息需要与大统领讨论。

options.en: I wish to discuss a delicate matter concerning Horus Yaribay.
options.zh: 我想谈谈某个和 Horus Yaribay 有关的敏感问题。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
The secretary nods attentively, hands unmoving. Accessing some kind of implant?

"Wonderful. I'll let the Prime Demarchon know as soon as he's available."
texts.zh:
秘书专注地点点头，双手一动不动。是在通过某种植入体传讯吗？

"很好。大统领一有空，我会立即告知他。"

texts.en:
The secretary nods attentively, again.

"Fantastic. I'll inform the Prime Demarchon as soon as he's free."
texts.zh:
秘书再次专注地点了点头。

"太好了。大统领一有空闲，我会立刻通知他。"

texts.en:
Ever pleasant and responsive, the secretary nods with that hint of a smile.

"Of course, thank you $playerSirOrMadam. I'm sure the Prime Demarchon will contact you as soon as he's able."
texts.zh:
秘书一如既往地亲切且反应迅速，带着一丝微笑点了点头。

"当然，谢谢您，$playerSirOrMadam。我相信大统领一有空就会联系您。"

texts.en:
The secretary nods pleasantly, as usual, repeating assurances that the Prime Demarchon will respond as soon as he can.

You have a growing feeling that you are not being taken seriously.
texts.zh:
秘书像往常一样愉快地点了点头，再次保证大统领会尽快回复。

你越来越觉得他们在敷衍你。
