options.en: I'm looking for Scylla Coureuse. I believe she is on Laicaille Habitat.
options.zh: 我正在寻找 Scylla Coureuse，我确定她正在 Laicaille 栖息地上。

options.en: Can you help me find Kelise Astraia?
options.zh: 你能帮我找找 Kelise Astraia 吗？

texts.en:
"You asked! Oh, joy of joys." Gargoyle rocks back and forth, as if in the throes of ecstasy. "That's all it takes: asking nicely. You know, it's not everyone that can bring themselves to do that."

Gargoyle smiles spitefully, then pauses, visibly calms down, and puts on a facade of professionalism. "It is an honor to assist you with this mission, captain. I will do my duty to my utmost."
texts.zh:
"你问了！噢，太美妙了。" Gargoyle 来回晃动，似乎沉浸在狂喜之中，"友好地请求 —— 这就是想得到答案时最需要做的，但你知道并不是每个人都能做到这点。"

Gargoyle 邪笑了一阵子，然后强迫自己冷静了下来，并装出一副官方的口吻："很荣幸在这项任务中协助你，舰长。我会尽我最大的努力。"

options.en: Good. So you can help?
options.zh: 好，这么说你会帮忙咯？

texts.en:
The officer act is dropped as the hacker picks up a datapad, "This doesn't have to be difficult. It's Tri-Tach, they'll sell anything. Just ask my buddy Arroyo! He's a Tri-Tach goon top to bottom, he'll know who to bribe."

Gargoyle tosses the datapad onto the desk, looking satisfied. "Glad I could help, captain. I'm sure I'll prove essential to your success".
texts.zh:
当黑客拿起数据平板时，他刚刚装出来的客套模样消失得无影无踪。"这并不难，要知道这可是 速子科技，只要价码合适，他们什么都会卖的。问问我的朋友 Arroyo 吧！他是一个彻头彻尾的 速子科技 大佬，他肯定知道该贿赂谁。"

Gargoyle 把数据平板扔到了桌上，看起来他对自己的表现很满意："能帮上忙我很高兴，舰长。我相信我能证明我对你的成功是必不可少的。"

options.en: Thank you.
options.zh: 谢了。

options.en: I'll be honest, that was a little underwhelming.
options.zh: 说实话，这有点令人失望。

texts.en:
"Well I'll be honest too," says Gargoyle, "You're very welcome for the gift of my spare time."

With that, the hackers' comms disconnect leaving you with a blank feed.
texts.zh:
"好吧，我也实话实说，" Gargoyle 阴阳怪气地说，"你随便浪费我的空闲时间，还真是感谢啊。"

说完后，黑客的通讯就断开了，留在你面前的只有空无一物的显示屏。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: What was that you were saying about 'Project Ziggurat'?
options.zh: 你刚才说的 '通灵塔计划' 到底是什么？

texts.en:
"The provost doesn't think it's important to let me explain," Gargoyle scoffs, "Maybe you should just fly off to Hybrasil without knowing anything but the name of one crackpot weapons engineer. No, go ahead! I'll wait. Tell me how it goes."

The silence draws out for nearly three seconds before Gargoyle begins ranting again.

"Imagine! Letting you con me into the data heist of a lifetime - set a nice fire under the High Hegemon's chair, didn't it! - then I decrypt the precious archive of the guy whose job she stole, and not asking what I thought of the contents? Which I read. Mostly. Can you believe it? Typical. She thinks she knows everything."

The hacker slumps, sulking.
texts.zh:
"院长认为我的解释不重要，她也许认为你应该在只知道自己要找一个疯子武器工程师的情况下就跑到 Hybrasil 星系去。" Gargoyle 嘲笑道，说着说着他就装出了院长的样子，"哇！这计划真是完美无缺！我会在这里等着的，记得告诉我进展如何。"

你们大眼瞪小眼，瞪了好一会后 Gargoyle 又开始咆哮。

"想象一下！院长让你把我骗进了一场令人毕生难忘的数据劫案 —— 还是在 霸主 的眼皮子底下！然后她又让我解密那个被她偷了饭碗的人的珍贵档案，到头来却不问已经将档案中大部分内容浏览完毕的我对其中内容的看法？她以为自己什么都知道！典中典！"

说完后黑客垂头丧气，不难看出他在生闷气。

options.en: I would like to hear about what you found, Gargoyle.
options.zh: 我想听听你的见解，Gargoyle。

options.en: If you just want to whine about it, I can be on my way.
options.zh: 如果你只是想抱怨的话，我想我可以离开了。

options.en: Just wait
options.zh: 什么都不说，就这么看着他

texts.en: Gargoyle looks up at you, "Yeah?"
texts.zh: Gargoyle 抬头看着你："喔？真的？"

options.en: I value your expertise.
options.zh: 我觉得你应该有一些专业的看法。

options.en: If you just want to whine about it, I can be on my way.
options.zh: 如果你只是想抱怨的话，我想我可以离开了。

options.en: Just wait
options.zh: 什么都不说，就这么看着他

texts.en: Gargoyle sits up, "Thank-you captain. Project Ziggurat, now that's a story!"
texts.zh: Gargoyle 坐了起来："多谢了，舰长。通灵塔计划是吧？让我来告诉你一些关于这玩意儿的事。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "The logs were scrubbed pretty hard before even Kallichore got them. I mean, there are the logs between the Tri-Tach contacts and Kallichore, and then there's a whole other set of internal Tri-Tach comms. Must have had some good connections, probably a mole or three. Those execs would throw each other out the airlock in a second if they thought it'd boost their own career. And it might!"
texts.zh: "在 Kallichore 拿到这些日志之前，它们已经被清理得很干净了。这里有 速子科技 的联络人和 Kallichore 之间的通话记录，也有一整套 速子科技 内部的通讯记录，这其中肯定有一些关联。那些高管们会马上把对手扔出气闸，只要他们觉得这样能促进自己的事业 —— 或许确实真的可以。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Anyway," Gargoyle leans in, speaking with quiet drama, "Project Ziggurat scared them. If you read between the lines," the hacker makes a self satisfied expression, "The initial phase of the project utilized a handful of AI cores of various grades. Guess what? Self-deleted. Tri-Tachyon thinks they're not supposed to be able to do that, but," a wobbly hand gesture, "Eh. Negotiable. Amazing what seemingly innocuous hardware can be made to do when you think outside the box."

"But what makes an AI delete itself?" Gargoyle leans in closer, "Whatever Project Ziggurat is, that's what. Spooky, right?"
texts.zh:
"总之，通灵塔计划可把他们吓坏了，这你从字里行间可以看出来。" Gargoyle 倾身向前，神秘兮兮地说，"在一开始，他们使用了几个不同等级的 AI 核心。你猜接下来发生了什么？这些核心自我删除了，速子科技 可没想到它们能做到自毁...不，哪怕是跳出条条框框思考，抛开理论只是用常识想想，也没人能料到这些东西会做出这样的事情。"

"但究竟是什么能让 AI 自毁呢？" Gargoyle 靠得更近了，"不管通灵塔计划是什么，它做到了这一点。真是怪事，对吧？"

options.en: You've given me a lot to think about.
options.zh: 你提供的信息够我消化一阵子了。

texts.en: "You're welcome, captain!" Gargoyle leans back, grinning again, and flips through floating holodisplays.
texts.zh: "不用客气，舰长！" Gargoyle 靠回了椅背，又咧嘴笑了起来，他的影像在漂浮的全息显示屏上翻动了一阵。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Fine. I'm sure you'll do great and make Baird very happy and get lots of credits."

Gargoyle looks at you darkly, and says quietly, "You'll never be like Coureuse to her, you know. You're just muscle. A tool. A killer. Once you've served your purpose?"

Gargoyle turns away and flips a hand dismissively at you; the comms line goes black.
texts.zh:
"很好。我相信你会做得很好，你会让 Baird 非常高兴，然后拿到很多的报酬。"

Gargoyle 阴沉地看着你，幽幽地说："我想你也心知肚明，在她眼里，你永远不会拥有 Coureuse 那样的地位。你只是一个杀手，一个工具，而一旦你完成了你的使命..."

Gargoyle 转过身，轻蔑地朝你甩了甩手，接着通讯就被切断了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Silence. Gargoyle's hand starts tapping on a stray datapad.
texts.zh: 在一片沉默中，Gargoyle 玩起了他的数据平板。

options.en: I value your expertise.
options.zh: 我觉得你应该有一些专业的看法。

options.en: Keep waiting
options.zh: 就这么继续看着他

texts.en: "Ludd's commode, this is boring." Gargoyle sits up, "You wanted to know about Project Ziggurat, right? Now that's a story!"
texts.zh: "卢德在上，你真是太无聊了。" Gargoyle 坐了起来，"你想知道通灵塔计划，对吗？行吧，来听听故事。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Ask for help getting info on Kelise Astraia
options.zh: 请求帮助获取关于 Kelise Astraia 的信息

texts.en:
"Is it you asking or Provost Baird?" he says in a tone that says he thinks it's Baird. "Doesn't matter," he slaps a hand on his desk and looks away, chewing on the problem.

"So. Tri-Tachyon employee huh? It's not terribly hard to pry data out of HR, to say nothing of franchise polity muni services. If you know who to ask, and how." He manages a half-smile, "And you're me," then turns back to face you.

"After taking some real heat from that last misbegotten crashdown of an operation you pulled, I'm going to need a little favor before I help you help Baird."
texts.zh:
"这问题是你自己问的还是 Baird 院长让你问的？" 虽然嘴上这么说着，你却听得出来他已经认定这是 Baird 院长让你问的问题了，接着他把一只手拍在桌子上，挪开目光沉思起来，"算了，无需回答。"

"你要找一个 速子科技 的员工对吗？只要你知道该问谁和该怎么问，从人力资源部门获取数据并不难，更不用说拥有市政特权的情况 —— 有我帮助的情况下了。" 他勉强挤出一丝微笑，然后转过身来面对着你。

"上次你的行动搞砸了一些东西，这让我备受打击，所以在我帮你以便让你能帮 Baird 之前，我需要你帮个小忙。"

options.en: What kind of favor?
options.zh: 你想让我帮什么忙？

texts.en:
"It's a gift, is what it is," he says, "Dead easy. I just need someone else to do it. Here," Arroyo taps a key and a data transfer interface overlays your comm-view. He's sending an archive containing a series of comms recordings.

"This is a series of fake comms messages in which some leaky subcontractor proves that I was part of the conspiracy to hack the Hegemony relay in Aztlan. Take this to someone, I don't care who, someone semi-important in some pirate organization or other. Try Donn, or go to Qaras in the Yma system. Doesn't matter. Have them blackmail me with these messages."
texts.zh:
"这活就是白送钱。" 他说，"简单得要命，我只是需要有人来做这件事。喏，" Arroyo 轻触了某个按键，接着一个数据传输界面覆盖了你的通信视图，看起来他正在发送一份包含一系列通讯录音的档案。

"这是些虚假的通信信息，内容是某个嘴碎的联络人提到了我是入侵 Aztlan 星系中的那处 霸主 通讯中继站的密谋者之一。把它随便交给某人，我不在乎是谁，哪个海盗或什么组织的二把手都行。你可去 Donn 碰碰运气，或者去 Yma 星系的 Qaras。总之让他们用这些信息勒索我。"

options.en: You want my help to run a convoluted disinformation campaign.
options.zh: 看起来你是想让我帮你弄出一次复杂的造谣活动。

options.en: But you did take part in the conspiracy.
options.zh: 但你确实参与了那次密谋。

options.en: Why are you leaking evidence against yourself?
options.zh: 你为什么要泄露会对自己不利的证据？

texts.en: "Exactly!" Arroyo grins, and says "It'll be fun."
texts.zh: "完全正确！" Arroyo 笑道，"这会很有趣的。"

texts.en: "Look- they're bad fakes. I spoofed a contract ID and bid low on this junk. Didn't even send the final payment. Hegemony spies and Tri-Tachyon Partner Relations are already sniffing after me so if it looks like a junior-exec smelled blood and was coming after my operation by manufacturing dirt, well, it raises some questions about the veracity of the entire accusation. Doesn't matter how flimsy; my PR team gets an angle to work. You see?"
texts.zh: "听着 —— 这些都是假消息。我伪造了合同 ID，然后低价买回这个垃圾，甚至连尾款都没有付。现在 霸主 间谍和 速子科技 公关已经盯上我了。但是，如果这整件事看起来就只是...某个下级主管像闻到血的秃鹫一般，为了升职加薪，试图弄虚作假来将我抓捕归案，那么整件事就变得有些可疑了。然后，哪怕这事只有一丁点令人生疑，我的公关团队也总能找到一个突破口...你明白没？"

options.en: Sure.
options.zh: 好，我现在明白了。

options.en: No. But I'll do it if you want.
options.zh: 完全不懂，但如果你需要，我会帮你这个忙的。

options.en: This seems unlikely to work.
options.zh: 这看起来不太像能成功的样子。

texts.en: "Wonderful. Can't wait to see who you choose."
texts.zh: "太棒了，我等不及想看看你会把它丢给谁了。"

texts.en: "So," he says, tapping a few keys on his desk console "You have the files. Go find a pirate who'll try to exploit me for all I'm worth." Arroyo grins.
texts.zh: "所以，" 他敲了敲桌面的控制台上的几个键，"你已经拿到文件了，现在去找个会试着把我敲诈到一无所有的海盗来。" Arroyo 咧嘴一笑。

options.en: How about some credits to help this job along?
options.zh: 来点星币，让这活儿更顺当如何？

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯

texts.en:
Arroyo barks a laugh. "After what Gargoyle chiseled me for on your behalf? Not happening. Good-bye, captain. I'll have the Astraia files for you after some roach-eating brigand shows up on my comm trying to blackmail me."

He disconnects his feed, leaving you with a spinning Tri-Tachyon franchise logo.
texts.zh:
Arroyo 大笑："在 Gargoyle 为了你敲诈了我之后？算了吧。拜了个拜，舰长。要是哪个吃蟑螂的土匪出现在我的通讯系统里勒索我了，我再把 Astraia 的资料给你。"

他切断了通讯，在你面前留下了旋转着的 速子科技 商标。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯

texts.en: "Perfect. Doesn't matter what you think, as long as it's messy."
texts.zh: "也好。你怎么想不重要，只要你能把这件事搞乱就行。"

texts.en: "Doesn't matter. I'm creating an information environment my people can work with, so the messier, the better."
texts.zh: "没事的，我正在把这事弄成一个我的员工可以处理的局面，所以它越乱越好。"

texts.en: "Yes, obviously," Arroyo rolls his eyes.
texts.zh: "对啊，很显然。" Arroyo 翻了翻白眼。

texts.en: "Vindication." Arroyo holds his hands palms up, eyebrows raised, waiting for you to understand his scheme. After a moment, he shakes his head and sighs.
texts.zh: "当然是为自己辩护。" Arroyo 抬了抬手，眉毛扬起，等着看你什么时候才能认识到这是他的阴谋。过了一会儿，他摇摇头并叹了口气。

options.en: Offer to sell Arroyo's fake blackmail material
options.zh: 提出你想出售 Arroyo 伪造的勒索证据

texts.en:
You pitch the material to the pirate- a series of recorded comm calls between Rayan Arroyo and various parties setting up and carrying out a job to hack the Aztlan Relay. The Hegemony would pay well for this, or someone well-positioned in Tri-Tachyon. Why not dream big, why not sell it to both?

As the pirate considers your offer and you can see the logic of the situation working across $hisOrHer face.

"I'm going to make you an offer," $heOrShe says, a menacing smile growing on $hisOrHer face. "Transmit everything you've got now or I have my gang blow you out of the sky."
texts.zh:
你试着把这些材料推销给海盗，里面都是一些 Rayan Arroyo 和各种组织之间的通讯记录，能表明他们当时正策划和执行一项侵入 Aztlan 通讯中继站的任务。霸主 肯定会为此慷慨解囊，速子科技 里身居要职的家伙估计也会开出很高的价码。或者干脆更有想法一些，为何不把它同时卖给这两家？

在海盗审视你给出去的东西时，材料里那些能解释当前形势的逻辑关系明显起作用了，你从$hisOrHer的脸上看得出来。

"那我就给你开个价吧。" $heOrShe开了口，同时脸上浮现出了威胁人的阴险微笑，"把你手里现有的所有信息都传过来，否则我就叫我的人把你从天上给打下来。"

options.en: Brave words for someone without a warfleet behind them.
options.zh: 某人身后连支能打的舰队都没有，还真敢说这话。

options.en: Oh no. Anything but that. Transmitting now.
options.zh: 喔，别，千万别那样。我这就把资料传给你。

options.en: Insist on payment
options.zh: 坚持让对方付款

texts.en:
The pirate leans back and tries to give you a knowing smile, "I see this isn't your first time negotiating with an intelligent operator like myself. My um, threat was simply a ruse to see if you were serious."

"And um, you passed the test," $heOrShe says, leaning forward again. "I'm going to make you an offer and you're going to take it, because-"
texts.zh:
海盗靠了回去，努力地装出一副情况不出所料的样子笑了一下："看起来这不是你第一次和像我一样聪明的人谈判了。我刚才的那个...呃...恐吓，只是个简单的试探而已，想看看你是不是认真的。"

"所以...呃...你够格了。" $heOrShe说着，又把身子靠了过来，"我等下会开个价，而你会接受，因为..."

options.en: You're going to pay me $gaPZ_paymentForCommFakes credits.
options.zh: 你得付我 $gaPZ_paymentForCommFakes 星币。

texts.en: "I accept," $heOrShe says without hesitation, and wipes sweat from $hisOrHer brow, "Transferring credits now."
texts.zh: "我接受。" $heOrShe立马回应道，还擦了擦$heOrShe额头上的冷汗，"这就转星币过去。"

options.en: Transferring data now.
options.zh: 现在我把数据传给你。

texts.en:
With the data transfer complete, you watch as the pirate browses the blackmail material on $hisOrHer datapad with a hungry look on $hisOrHer face, "This is ... oh yes, very good. Wait 'til they see, it'll be-" $heOrShe seems to notice you again. "I believe we've made a fine deal, captain. Let's never speak of this again, yes?"

$personName shuts the commlink off, mercifully.
texts.zh:
数据传输完成后，海盗直接当着你的面就开始垂涎三尺地在$hisOrHer的数据平板上浏览起了那些黑料，"这是...哦，太棒了，等他们看到的时候，肯定会..." $heOrShe似乎才注意到你还在看着，"我想我们刚才真是做了笔好买卖，舰长。咱们就当这事从没发生过，咋样？"

$personName 切断了通讯，在你绷不住之前。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You transmit the data without bothering to put too much effort into acting scared; you have your dignity, after all.

As the transfer completes, the pirate leans back, a predatory smile on $hisOrHer face, "Very, very interesting. It's a good thing you came to someone smart, like me."

"Now scram before I change my mind."
texts.zh:
你就没再费功夫去装出一副被吓破胆了的样子，直接把数据传输了过去：毕竟你还是要给自己留点面子的。

数据传输完成后，海盗靠坐回椅背，脸上露出了能吃人的微笑，"非常，非常有趣。幸好你找到了像我这样的聪明人。"

"好了，在我改变主意之前，快滚。"

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
You pull out a personal datapad and explain that you can simply activate the EMP device attached to the memory core housing the blackmail data and they'll have no opportunity to blackmail anyone- in fact, you can spread word of their treachery in this matter. And then how many opportunities for mutual profit will show up in their orbit?

The pirate leans back and tries to give you a knowing smile, "Say no more. I can see that you are, like me, an intelligent operator. My um, threat was simply a ruse to see if you were serious about this business," $heOrShe says.
texts.zh:
你拿出了一个数据平板，向对方表明储存有勒索数据的内存核心上连有 EMP 装置，而你能轻易激活它，这样一来这份数据就毫无用处。此外，你还表示可以稍微宣传一下对方在这件勒索买卖上的诈骗行径，如此一来在这轨道上还会有多少利益往来的机会？

海盗靠了回去，努力地装出一副情况不出所料的样子笑了一下，"不用再说了。我看出你是干什么的了，和我一样，是个情报贩子。我刚才的那个...呃...恐吓，只是个简单的试探而已，想看看你是不是认真要做生意。" $heOrShe这么说到。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"And uh, congrats. You passed," $heOrShe says, recovering $hisOrHer composure. "You see before you someone who also knows all about business. And I'm going to make you an offer and you're going to take it, because- "

The pirate rambles, explaining why you won't find anyone else willing or indeed able to put your offering to best use. It's not a very good pitch.
texts.zh:
"所以...呃...恭喜，你够格了。" $heOrShe说，并恢复了镇静，"在你面前的是一个同样懂行的人。我等下会开个价，而你会接受，因为..."

海盗开始瞎扯，讲着些什么就你给出的那些材料，你没办法找到其他有意愿或有能力运用的人了之类的事情。这商谈的口才还真说不上好。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You wait for the right moment then cut through the posturing like a sabot core through a fluxed shield envelope, arguing the pirate into a price of $gaPZ_paymentForCommFakesHigh credits for the fake blackmail material.

"By Ludd's commode, yes, I get it" $heOrShe says finally, wiping sweat from $hisOrHer brow, "I accept your price. Transferring credits."
texts.zh:
犹如用赛博弹芯打穿幅能满载的护盾一般，你找准合适的时机，直接撕破了海盗装腔作势的嘴脸。争论直到对方愿意为假勒索线索支付 $gaPZ_paymentForCommFakesHigh 星币才算告一段落。

"看在卢德的份上，好吧，我接受。" $heOrShe最终同意了，擦着$heOrShe额头上的冷汗，"我接受你的开价。现在开始转账星币。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
With the data transfer complete, you watch as the pirate browses the blackmail material on $hisOrHer datapad with a hungry look on $hisOrHer face, "This is ... oh yes, very good. Wait 'til they see, it'll be-" $heOrShe seems to notice you again. "I believe we've made a fine deal, captain. Let's never speak of this again, yes?"

$personName shuts the commlink off, mercifully.
texts.zh:
数据传输完成后，海盗直接当着你的面就开始垂涎三尺地在$hisOrHer的数据平板上浏览起了那些黑料，"这是...哦，太棒了，等他们看到的时候，肯定会..." $heOrShe似乎才注意到你还在看着，"我想我们刚才真是做了笔好买卖，舰长。咱们就当这事从没发生过，咋样？"

$personName 切断了通讯，在你绷不住之前。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Offer to sell Arroyo's fake blackmail material
options.zh: 提出你想出售 Arroyo 伪造的勒索证据

options.en: Offer to sell Arroyo's fake blackmail material
options.zh: 提出你想出售 Arroyo 伪造的勒索证据

texts.en:
Arroyo seems genuinely amused when he answers the comms, "Ah, $playername! My ruthless blackmailer returns," he pauses for a moment and chuckles to himself while scrolling through a datapad.

"You should see the things they're saying about me, you'd think they caught me on holo in the High Hegemon's private quarters having a-" he looks up, "... Business, yes, of course." He tosses the datapad to the side.

"You wanted the file on Kelise Astraia." He grins, "I didn't even have to bribe the admin at Culann Starforge for this. Would you believe that we worked together a few cycles ago? There's a story there, but let me tell you about your weapons engineer."
texts.zh:
在接入通讯链接时，Arroyo 似乎真的被逗乐了："啊，$playername！我无情的勒索者回来了。" 他停顿了一下，一边检查数据平板一边暗自发笑。

"你应该听听他们是怎么说我的，你会以为他们手上有一套全息投影记录，还是关于我在至高霸主的私人房间里 —— " 他抬起头来，"...好吧，我们商量的事情。" 说着他把数据平板扔到了一边。

"你想要 Kelise Astraia 的档案。" 他笑着说，"我甚至不需要贿赂 Culann 星际锻炉的管理人员。你敢相信我们四年前在一起工作过吗？那时候发生了一些有趣的事 —— 算了，让我们来说说你的武器工程师吧。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Arroyo takes on the distant look of a cyberaug interfacing with the hypernet. With a nod, Arroyo summons a personnel file to overlay your comms-link, summarizing the life and career of Kelise Astraia.

"A bit of an eccentric, our Kelise," Arroyo says, "But you can get the details later. Relevant bit is here: looks here like she was contracting on the side for a Tri-Tach black project - one of them anyway - and was asked to go on-site full-time. Left a convincing resignation and booked a starship, the 'Hamatsu'. Venture-class. That one's made more than a few trips out of the core worlds; scavenging, special ops. A few jobs for the Company here and there."
texts.zh:
Arroyo 用程序远程访问了资料库，接着他点了点头，将一份个人档案覆盖在了通讯链接上，那上面显示着 Kelise Astraia 生活的细节。

"我们的 Kelise 女士有点古怪，" Arroyo 说，"总之你可以稍后再了解这些细节。相关的部分在这里：看起来她好像加入了 速子科技 的机密项目 —— 反正就是那些机密的其中之一 —— 并被要求去现场全职工作。她留下了令人信服的辞职信，订了一艘星舰，历险-级 Hamatsu 号。这艘船已经离开过核心世界好几次了，拾荒或是什么特殊行动，总之就是为公司跑腿。"

options.en: Can you tell me more about the Hamatsu?
options.zh: 你能告诉我更多 Hamatsu 号的细节吗？

texts.en:
"Let's see. It looks like Astraia requested special modifications." Arroyo raises an eyebrow, "Expensive ones. I'm guessing some of this is a little extra to keep things quiet. No specs on these modifications, however. Lazy work by whoever was doing this data-gathering."

"Looks like the ship left the Hybrasil system and turned its transponder off sometime before jumping out. Doesn't necessarily mean anything, but... " Arroyo considers for a moment, then pages the file ahead.
texts.zh:
"让我们看看。看起来 Astraia 要求对船体做过一些特别的改装。" Arroyo 扬起眉毛，"价格不菲，我猜这是为了保密而额外准备的。然而，这些改装的细节没有被记录，看起来当时负责盯着的间谍很懒。

这艘船在跃进超空间离开了 Hybrasil 星系前关掉了应答器，这透露不出什么很有价值的情报，但是..." Arroyo 思考了一会儿，然后把文件翻到了前面。

options.en: But what?
options.zh: 但是？

texts.en:
"They didn't want to be followed," says Arroyo, looking somewhere off-comms, "I would assume the flight plan logged with the port authority is worthless. Someone has to know something though. Hmm." Data scrolls on his desk display.

"The Hamatsu is owned by one Callisto Ibrahim." he looks up at you, "Heard of her? No? Bit of a reputation. My former partner hired her once a while back. She lied up and down on her credentials," he shrugs. "But it worked out. Respect the con. Anyway, she's operating a few small fleets out of Agreus in the Arcadia system these days."

Arroyo's eye twitches in a certain way and the display records disappear.
texts.zh:
"但是这至少意味着他们不想被人跟踪，" Arroyo 看了看通讯画面以外的某处，数据在他桌面的投影仪上滚动着，"我猜港务局记录的航行计划在这方面给不了我们帮助。总得有人知道些什么，嗯..."

"Hamatsu 号的主人叫 Callisto Ibrahim。" 他抬头看着你，"听说过她吗？没有？其实她还有点名气，我以前的合伙人雇过她。她的证书从头到尾都是谎言..." 他耸耸肩，"但你得承认这很有用。不管怎么说，她最近在 Arcadia 星系的 Agreus 运营着几支小舰队。"

Arroyo 的眼角抽了抽，他面前的资料记录消失了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Well, $playername, that was fun. I've forwarded the files. If I were you, I'd try to get some information out of Ibrahim. She seems like someone who knows how to do business if the pay is right."

Arroyo sits back, "Now I have a reputation to obscure, if you don't mind. Good luck finding your engineer. Remember: I don't want to hear any more about this. The last thing I need is to get some Company director on my case because you're stepping on their pet black project."

With that, he terminates the link, leaving you with a spinning Tri-Tachyon logo.
texts.zh:
"好吧，$playername，这很有趣。我已经把文件发给你了，如果我是你，我会试着从 Ibrahim 那里打听点消息。只要价格合适，她应该知道如何做生意。"

Arroyo 坐了下来："如果你不介意的话，现在我得低调一些了。祝你能找到你的工程师。记住：我不想再听和这事有关的消息了，我最不需要的就是让某个公司主管来处理我的案子，只因你挖到了他们宝贝的机密项目。"

说完后，他切断了通讯，你面前只剩下旋转着的 速子科技 公司商标。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The Tri-Tachyon comms logo resolves rapidly to the smiling administrator of Culann Starforge.

"Greetings Captain $playerName!" $HeOrShe glances at a secondary display, "Your net worth is admirable. On behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, I would like to welcome you to Culann Starforge."

$HisOrHer perfect smile grows slightly larger. "We supply a variety of alloys to both private firms and major polities. Or perhaps you're a supplier in the ore trade?"
texts.zh:
速子科技 的商标很快被 Culann 星际锻炉管理员的微笑取代了。

"您好，$playername 舰长！" $heOrShe偷瞄了一眼那边的副显示屏，"您的净资产真是多得令人钦佩。我代表 三一速子科技公司，欢迎您来到 Culann 星际锻炉。"

$heOrShe完美的笑容绽放得更加灿烂了一些："我们面向各种客户供应各种合金，小到私人厂商，大至国家政党。又或许您是一位来自矿石贸易行业的供应商？"

options.en: Ask about Kelise Astraia
options.zh: 打听有关 Kelise Astraia 的消息

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
You inquire about Kelise Astraia. The administrator's smile glows slightly less wide and a touch of confusion grows on $hisOrHer face. "A former employee you say? Well, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation has top-line privacy guidelines when it comes to discussion of human assets." $HisOrHer gaze drifts to the side, "However... "

This privacy guideline sounds flexible. $HeOrShe seems to be waiting for you to make an offer.
texts.zh:
你询问了有关 Kelise Astraia 的问题。管理员的笑容不那么灿烂了，$hisOrHer的脸上出现了一丝困惑。"你是说以前的一位雇员？在讨论人力资源时，公司有最高的隐私准则。" $hisOrHer的目光移到一边，"然而..."

你想起来$heOrShe手边放着的显示屏上有着你净资产的数据，不难推测$heOrShe似乎在等你出价，这么看来那个所谓的 "隐私准则" 十分的灵活。

options.en: We're just networking, right? Let me add you on Tri-link...
options.zh: 这只是普通的商业合作，不是吗？让我在 TriLink 上加一下你...

options.en: Perhaps a generous finder's fee would smooth things along?
options.zh: 也许一些慷慨的小费会让事情顺利些？

options.en: Make an excuse and close the comm link
options.zh: 找个借口关闭通讯链接

texts.en:
You activate your personal datapad and load up Tri-Tachyon's insipid professional networking service. While making light small-talk with $personName, you find $hisOrHer public profile and add $himOrHer as a connection, swiftly assigning the maximum level endorsement across all notable skills.

"Oh captain, how very kind of you," says $personName, "Now that we're professionally acquainted, I'd be more than willing to perform a quick consultation in the matter of the former employee of interest... though my fees are not trivial."

Bribery it is, then.
texts.zh:
你激活了你的个人数据平板，并进入了速子科技乏味的专业服务网络。当你和 $personName 进行闲聊时，你找到了$hisOrHer的公共档案，将$himOrHer添加为了合作伙伴，并将能找到的评级全都打到了最高级别。

"喔，舰长，您真是太慷慨了，" $personName 说，"既然我们已经是官方合作伙伴了，我非常愿意就您感兴趣的前雇员问题提供快速咨询服务...虽然我的费用并不低。"

说得好听，其实这就是贿赂，你俩心知肚明。

options.en: Of course. And this fee would come to... ?
options.zh: 当然，那么费用是...？

options.en: Make an excuse and close the comm link
options.zh: 找个借口关闭通讯链接

texts.en: "$gaPZ_culannBribe credits. Upfront, to my account via, ah, this UID," the administrator says as your datapad pings softly to alert you of the receipt of payment information. $personName smiles brightly again and awaits your response.
texts.zh: "$gaPZ_culannBribe 星币，通过这个 UID 预付到我的账户。" 当你的数据平板发出轻柔的响声提醒你收到付款所需要的账户信息时，管理员说道。$personName 恢复了灿烂的笑容，等待你的回复。

options.en: Pay the bribe
options.zh: 支付 "服务费用"

options.en: All things considered, you don't think...  (negotiate)
options.zh: 从各方面考虑，你不会认为... (讨价还价)

options.en: Make some excuse and close the comm link
options.zh: 找个借口关闭通讯链接

texts.en:
"Wonderful," says the administrator as you see $hisOrHer eyes read the transfer confirmation. "Let me just pull up the file on Kelise Astraia... ah, here it is," $heOrShe says with suspiciously little delay.

A personnel file overlays your comms-link, displaying details of the life and employment of Kelise Astraia.

"Not an ideal employee, mmm," says $name, reading the file. "Insubordination. Sloppy infosec. Failure to consistently engage with company morale programs," $heOrShe glances back at you, gauging your interest. "But that's not what you're looking for, is it, captain. You want to find her. I am correct, yes?"

The file scrolls by quickly, manipulated by a combination of the administrator's hands flying over a virtual interface and subtle use of cyberaugs.
texts.zh:
"太棒了。" 当你看到$hisOrHer的眼睛读着转账确认时，这位管理员说，"让我调出 Kelise Astraia 的档案...啊，在这儿。" $heOrShe的话语带着一瞬的迟疑。

一份人事档案盖在了你的通讯画面上，显示着 Kelise Astraia 的生活和工作细节。

"这可不是一个理想的员工，嗯。" $name 读着文件说，"不服从指令，信息安全工作草率。未能持续参与公司的激励计划。" $heOrShe回头看了你一眼，猜测着你的兴趣点，"但这份文件不是您要找的东西，舰长，你想找到她本人，对吧？"

文件滚动得很快，管理员的手在虚拟界面上飞舞，并巧妙地掩盖了浏览的踪迹。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Judging by the credits transfers from 'unknown source', I would suppose that employee 379490509 was contracting on the side for a black project from elsewhere in the Company. Not one of mine. Hm." This seems to annoy the administrator. "If I had to guess, that's why she resigned so suddenly and- oh, look at this."

A noisy holo from a navigation sat pops up showing a weathered Venture-class hull. "It's called the 'Hamatsu'. Surveys, scavenging, ... other jobs. Astraia booked the entire ship and requested some kind of modification installed." The administrator is frowning now, an unusual expression for $himOrHer. "No details. I'll have to have a word with the portmaster for allowing this to proceed without filing a copy with the Company."
texts.zh:
"从 '未知来源' 的星币转移来看，我认为这位 379490509 号员工加入了公司在其它地方的机密项目。不在我的辖区内，啧。" 这似乎惹恼了管理员，"如果要我猜的话，这就是她突然辞职的原因 —— 哦，来看看这个。"

一幅似乎是在导航信标的基座上摄制的布满噪点的全息图像弹了出来，图像上是一艘饱经风霜的 历险-级 星舰。"它叫做 'Hamatsu' 号。负责过探索，拾荒...以及许多其它工作。Astraia 预订了这艘船，并要求进行一些改装。" 管理员现在皱着眉头，这对$himOrHer来说是很不寻常的表情，"没有更多细节了。我得和港务长谈一谈，不知道谁允许在不向公司提交一份材料的情况下就为此船放行的。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"The Hamatsu finished modifications then made to leave the Hybrasil system but turned its transponder off before jumping out." $HeOrShe considers this for a moment, then pages the file ahead.

"Ah. Owned by Callisto Ibrahim." $heOrShe looks up at you, "Heard of her? No? Bit of a reputation. A few junior partners in the Company hired her for a job a while back. She falsified credentials but delivered admirably in the end. She's now operating a few," a derisive sniff, "small fleets out of Agreus in the Arcadia system."

The administrator looks at you now, unsmiling. "If I were you and I wanted to find Kelise Astraia, I would talk to Ibrahim. She'll do business." A pause, "Like we are."
texts.zh:
"Hamatsu 号完成改装后，就启程离开 Hybrasil 星系，但在跳跃前就关闭了应答器。" $heOrShe思考了一会儿，然后继续翻动文件。

"啊。这是 Callisto Ibrahim 的船。" $heOrShe抬头看着你，"你听说过她吗？没有？她以前其实还挺有名的。毕竟公司的几个下级合伙人曾雇过她，虽然她是通过伪造证书才拿到那份工作，但令人钦佩的是，她最后还是出色的完成了任务。现在她在 Arcadia 星系里的 Agreus 运营着..." $heOrShe突然露出了一副嗤之以鼻的表情，"几支小舰队。"

管理员抬头看着你，不苟言笑的说道："如果我是你，想找到 Kelise Astraia 的话，我会先和 Ibrahim 谈谈。我想她不会拒绝生意的，就像我们一样。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"And now you have your lead, so I believe I have earned my fee. I thank you for bringing this little loose end to my attention. Now I have some calls to make." $HeOrShe smiles again at you, entirely falsely. "You never know who you can trust."

"Pleasure doing business, captain. Profitable ventures to you." And with that, $heOrShe closes the comms.
texts.zh:
"现在你有了线索，所以我相信我的报酬是应得的。我很感谢你把这件小事告诉我，现在我得打几个电话。" $heOrShe又对你笑了，那笑容很虚伪，"你永远不知道自己可以相信谁。"

"很高兴做成这笔生意，舰长。我想这是一次对你有利的风险投资。" 说完，$heOrShe关闭了通讯。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: $personName cuts you off before you can finish even an attempt to negotiate, "My fee structure is quite generous, captain, and offered with our special professional connection in mind." The smile remains, but $hisOrHer eyes tell you that you're skirting close to an event horizon.
texts.zh: $personName 在你还没来得及完整地说出谈判开场白之前就打断了你："舰长，我的收费已经相当低廉了，这是考虑到我们特殊的商业合作关系而做出的折扣。" 笑容依旧，但$hisOrHer的眼睛告诉你，应该要避开这个话题黑洞。

options.en: Pay the bribe
options.zh: 支付 "服务费用"

options.en: Make some excuse and close the comm link
options.zh: 找个借口关闭通讯链接

texts.en:
"Hello, this is Callisto Ibrahim of Ibrahim Interstellar Transport and Salvage."

She frowns and looks you over, assessing, "If you're looking for work I've got all the pilots I need right now, but I can take your comms ID in case something comes up."
texts.zh:
"你好，我是 Ibrahim 星际运输与打捞公司的 Callisto Ibrahim。"

她皱着眉头打量了你一会，评估道："如果你在找工作，现在不太合适，我目前手下的飞行员已经足够了，但我可以先记下你的通讯 ID，以后有需求再联系。"

options.en: Ask about the Hamatsu
options.zh: 询问 Hamatsu 号的事

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
She narrows her eyes.

"Is this about Kelise Astraia? It is, isn't it."
texts.zh:
她眯起眼睛。

"你是来找 Kelise Astraia 的，对吧？"

options.en: It is.
options.zh: 没错。

options.en: How'd you know?
options.zh: 你怎么知道的？

texts.en:
"Don't even get me started." Ibrahim seethes, "She chartered my ship for some hush-hush salvage operation. Supposedly," she stresses that word with disbelief, "And she comes in demanding highly unusual modifications with potentially dangerous hyperdrive field interactions!"

"Well, I got her to throw in a fair chunk of hazard pay, a rush fee, and a bit more to keep quiet about it like she wanted."
texts.zh:
"提到这事我就来气。" Ibrahim 生气地说，"她包下我的船去搞什么秘密打捞行动。据说是这样，" 她把这个词拉得老长，摆明了信不过她，"结果呢？她要求对舰船进行可能导致超空间驱动场冲突的古怪改装！"

"所以我让她付了一大笔危险津贴，一笔加急费用，还有一笔封口费 —— 按她的要求。"

options.en: ...You don't sound very quiet.
options.zh: ...看起来你的口没被封上。

texts.en:
"Yeah," she scowls, "Because disappearing with my favorite starship is a pretty big breach of contract. I'll tell whoever I damn well please. For all I know she ran my Hamatsu into a black hole in some Tri-Tachyon boondoggle search for a more efficient drive field to license back to us poor spacers just trying to get by."

Ibrahim takes a couple deep breaths, then turns to you, a little calmer. "What's your interest in all this?"
texts.zh:
"是啊，" 她皱着眉头，"因为我觉得带着我最喜欢的星舰玩失踪是相当严重的违约行为，所以我想跟谁说就跟谁说。据我所知，她把我的 Hamatsu 号开进了一个黑洞，就为了某种 速子科技 的无聊探索任务。据说那是为了寻找一个更有效的驱动场，以便让我们这些只是想谋生的可怜太空船员去申请使用他们的专利，然后狠狠地赚上一笔。"

Ibrahim 做了几次深呼吸，然后看向你，稍微冷静了下来："你呢？你为什么会对这些事感兴趣？"

options.en: I need to find out where Kelise Astraia went.
options.zh: 我得知道 Kelise Astraia 去哪了。

texts.en:
"I'll tell you what; I want to find her too. There'll be something in it for you if you can get me anything to go on. I'd go looking myself, but," Ibrahim waves a hand through the air; business, bureaucracy, other commitments.

"Better yet, find the Hamatsu and bring it back to me," she closes her eyes, looking pained, "in one piece, I hope. I've got a lot of memories in that old piece of space-junk."

"Let me get you started. My captain on the Hamatsu sent an encrypted flight plan before they left spacedock, after finishing the modifications." She taps at a desk console.
texts.zh:
"我会告诉你详细情况的，毕竟我也想找到她。我可以给你提供线索，但你得帮我个忙。我原本想亲自前往，但是，" Ibrahim 在空中挥挥手，生意，政治，或是其他什么承诺束缚了她。

"现在情况好多了，至少有人可以帮我了。找到 Hamatsu 号，然后把它带回来给我。"她闭上了眼睛，看起来很痛苦，"希望它完好无损，毕竟我在那艘老旧的太空垃圾里留下了很多回忆。"

"让我们开始吧。Hamatsu 号的舰长在完成舰船改装离开太空船坞之前，向我发送了一份加密的航行计划。" 她敲了敲桌上的控制台。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
A hyperspace nav overlay appears, "Hybrasil is here. The Hamatsu fueled up and planned to travel to $gaPZ_relaySystem. Whether they made it, I don't know. Outer Fringe, no hypercomm coverage. They could have changed course. That rad-addled Tri-Tach engineer was tight-lipped about her intentions and ensured that the contract had my captain bound to follow changes in flight plan by her order."

Ibrahim swipes the display away, and it is replaced by a schematic of the Hamatsu, with certain additions to the drive field inductors highlighted. "These are the modifications she had done. If we're agreed that you'll find the Hamatsu for me, captain... "

She looks to you, waiting for an answer.
texts.zh:
一份超空间导航数据出现了："Hybrasil 星系在这里，Hamatsu 号已经加满了燃料，计划前往 $gaPZ_relaySystem。我不知道他们是否去了那里，因为那是边缘星区，没有通讯网络覆盖。他们可能中途改变了路线。那个脑袋像被辐射烤坏了的速子工程师对她的意图守口如瓶，但我们的合同确保了舰长必须按照她的命令，随时进行航行计划的变更。"

Ibrahim 将显示出的地图移走，取而代之的是 Hamatsu 号的示意图，驱动场感应器上做出的改动已经被高亮标记了出来。"这些就是她所做的改装。帮我找回 Hamatsu 号，舰长，拜托了..."

她看着你，等着你的回答。

options.en: I'll find it.
options.zh: 我会找到它的。

options.en: I can't make any promises.
options.zh: 我不一定能找到它。

options.en: I can't commit to that.
options.zh: 我不能做出保证。

texts.en: Ibrahim nods, frowning. "It would mean a lot."
texts.zh: Ibrahim 点点头，皱着眉头："这对我而言意义重大。"

texts.en:
She returns her focus to the schematics, zooming in.

"I've had my techs have a look. It seems to be an addition, an enhancement, to the drive field. Press a button and it pumps in a lot of energy all at once, pushes the envelope into a strange harmonic. Theoretically it won't do anything hazardous to the ship, but messing with the default settings of the hyperdrive is never a good way to stay in this business."

"Or alive."
texts.zh:
她把注意力放回了图纸上，并将屏幕聚焦在了高亮的修改部分

"我已经让技术人员看了一遍。这里似乎对驱动场进行了补充，更准确地说，加装了一个增强装置。按下激活按钮，它就会立刻注入大量能量，把覆盖舰船的驱动场变成一种奇怪的谐波。理论上它不会对舰船造成任何危险，但擅自改动超空间引擎的默认设置，可不是在这行长久干下去的好方法。"

"或者说，活命的方法。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Ibrahim shakes her head, "I figured, Tri-Tachyon engineer? Maybe she knows what she's doing and I could get a cut in on it. What a fool I was. Anyway, I've sent you the schematics in case it helps with the search."

"That's all I have, captain," she says, not hopeful, but not resigned. "All I can say is burn hard, burn bright."
texts.zh:
Ibrahim 摇摇头："我曾以为，这可是个 速子科技 的工程师，也许她知道自己在做什么，我也可以分一杯羹，真是太傻了。不管怎么说，我已经把结构图发给你了，这说不定会对我们的搜寻有点帮助。"

"这就是我所有的资料了，舰长。" 她说，听起来并非满怀希望，但也没有放弃，"我只能说，愿你航行无阻。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Ibrahim nods. "I would not expect it. I only ask that you try."
texts.zh: Ibrahim 点点头："我没抱什么期待，只是希望你能试一试。"

texts.en: Ibrahim looks at you, frowning. After what feels like a half minute of thought, she finally sighs and says "I'll take a chance with you, captain. It's not like any faction authorities are going to help me with this one."
texts.zh: Ibrahim 皱着眉头看着你，大概想了半分钟后，她终于叹了口气，说："我愿意在你身上赌一把，舰长，毕竟没有谁愿意帮我了。"

options.en: Tell Baird about the Hamatsu hyperdrive modifications
options.zh: 告诉 Baird 关于 Hamatsu 号超空间引擎改装的事

texts.en:
Baird listens without reaction to your explanation of your findings: following the lead on Kelise Astraia to speaking with Callisto Ibrahim, acquiring specifications to the modifications done to the Hamatsu hyperdrive.

After only a moment's pause, the provost says "Take these specifications to Coureuse. She'll have my authorization to devote all necessary resources to the matter. We must move quickly if Tri-Tachyon has produced a reliable device to exploit Transverse Jump capability." She frowns, then turns quickly to start tapping at her desk console.
texts.zh:
Baird 面无表情地听完了你关于调查结果的汇报：跟随 Kelise Astraia 的线索，与 Callisto Ibrahim 谈话，最终获取了 Hamatsu 号超空间引擎改动的细节。

短暂的停顿之后，院长开口了："把这些细节说明拿给 Coureuse。我会授权她动用一切必要资源来处理此事。如果 速子科技 已经制造出一种可靠的横轴跳跃设备，我们就必须加快脚步了。" 她皱了皱眉头，然后迅速转过身去，开始轻敲她的桌面控制台。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Baird speaks, her attention divided "If this... Captain, I suspect that you will have to search for a non-standard hyperspace access point to find the Tri-Tachyon black site. Retrace the route of the Hamatsu from Hybrasil to $gaPZ_relaySystem."

Face illuminated by a newly-summoned display, Baird says "Go now, captain," and disconnects the comms.
texts.zh:
Baird 继续说道，这时她的注意力已经有些分散了："如果这...舰长，我猜你得先找到一个特殊的超空间跳跃点，那样你才能找到 速子科技 的秘密研究站。沿着 Hamatsu 号从 Hybrasil 到 $gaPZ_relaySystem 的路线走一趟试试。"

板着一张被刚刚调出的图像照亮的脸，Baird 说："舰长，现在就出发。" 她随即切断了通讯。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"$playername. Why are you still here? Follow Kelise Astraia, follow the Hamatsu. Find out what Tri-Tachyon was up to at this 'Alpha Site' then return here," Baird removes her spectacles in an uncharacteristic display.

"Understand, captain, that you are not a subtle implement. You are gaining something of a reputation. I concede that your abilities and accomplishments are impressive."
texts.zh:
"$playername，你怎么还在这里？去追查 Kelise Astraia，追查 Hamatsu 号。去弄明白速子科技到底在 '阿尔法研究站' 做了什么，然后再回来。" 有些一反常态地，Baird 摘下了她的眼镜。

"舰长，你要明白，你不再是一个没什么存在感的工具人了。你要继续做些有出息的事才能出人头地。就你的能力和成就而言，我觉得你有这个能力。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She leans forward, her eyes falling into shadow, "And you've impressed many of the powerful factions of the Sector. In your wake there follows a small army of spies, informants, and opportunists. They will catch up to you."

Provost Baird leans back again, and replaces her spectacles, "Grand designs are coming together, captain. We will change the world."
texts.zh:
她向前倾着身子，眼眶被阴影覆盖："你给星域中许多强大的势力留下了深刻的印象。在你身后，有一小群间谍、线人和机会主义者，随时准备着抓住你。"

Baird 院长又向后靠了靠，把眼镜放回原处："伟大的计划正在酝酿，舰长，我们将会改变世界。"

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Tell Coureuse about the Hamatsu hyperdrive modifications
options.zh: 告诉 Coureuse 关于 Hamatsu 号超空间引擎改装的事

texts.en:
Coureuse listens carefully to your recounting of the search for Kelise Astraia, of speaking with Callisto Ibrahim, and the strange Hamatsu hyperdrive modifications.

"Interesting," says Coureuse as the upload is completed.

The engineering diagrams of the Hamatsu flicker back and forth across her face as she scrolls through the specs. "This confirms a few theories we've been working on. And my thesis advisor- um, well if I'm not mistaken-" she freezes the display on a page of equations, "Ah! See right here? They used our work. I wonder how Tri-Tachyon got this. Provost Kallichore, I expect."
texts.zh:
Coureuse 仔细听你讲述了搜寻 Kelise Astraia 的过程，与 Callisto Ibrahim 的交谈，以及 Hamatsu 号超空间引擎的异常改动。

"很有意思，" 数据上传完毕后，Coureuse 说道。

她滚动浏览着详细设计参数，各种 Hamatsu 的工程图纸在她的脸上一闪而过。"这证实了我们正在研究的一些理论。还有我的博士论文导师的，呃，如果我没搞错的话 ——" 她把一整页的方程式停在了显示屏上，"啊！看到这个了吗？他们利用了我们的研究成果。我倒想知道速子科技是怎么得到这个的。是前任院长 Kallichore，我猜。"

options.en: It's a Transverse Jump device, right?
options.zh: 这是个横轴跳跃装置，对吗？

texts.en: "Yes!" Coureuse looks surprised and pleased, "It's all rather over-engineered when a simple software patch will do. It's fascinating to see how they've applied these principles to, ah, the hardware application. Experimentation and instrumental aspects of research were never my strong point," Coureuse admits. "I was into theory. Now that I'm back at the Academy, with the resources Baird is giving me..."
texts.zh: "没错！" Coureuse 看起来又惊又喜，"当一个简单的软件补丁就能解决问题时，所有的设计都是多余的。看他们把这些原则应用到，呃，硬件应用上，这很有意思。实验和操作从来都不是我的强项，" Coureuse 承认道。"我钻研的是理论。现在我回到了学院，有了 Baird 给我的资源..."

options.en: So about the Hamatsu.
options.zh: 那，关于 Hamatsu 号的事。

texts.en: "Right. This ship, the Hamatsu. They went through all the trouble to modify the hyperdrive. That tells me that it went somewhere specific," Coureuse looks at you intensely, "If you found out where they used this, some special jump-point associated with a nascent gravity well that's... special, somehow. Unique? Hyperspatially-speaking?" Coureuse looks off somewhere, thinking again. "Perhaps not unique, but special."
texts.zh: "对。这艘船，Hamatsu 号，他们费了很大的劲来修改超空间引擎，我能从这一点看出它是被用来航向某个特别的地方的，" Coureuse 用热切的目光看着你，"你有在哪里发现他们用了这个装置吗，与亚临界重力井相关的特殊跳跃点？那从某种角度来说应该很... 特别。或者说独一无二的？用多维空间的话来说这对吗？" Coureuse 望向别处，再次思考了起来。"也许并不是独一无二的，但至少它很特别。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: She puts down her datapad and stares into the distance, "How would such a phenomenon occur naturally? Gravitational slingshot of a planet that formed near a hyperspace-accessible primary launched away from its primary? I'd have to check with Astrometrics if..." Coureuse realizes you're still on the comms-call, "Oh, captain! My apologies. I think we're all done? I have a lot of- I need to talk to the rest of the team," she waves a hand, trying to express something inexpressible, "... Ideas. Bye."
texts.zh: 她放下数据平板，凝视着远方，"这种现象怎么能自然生成呢？是一颗可由超空间抵达的恒星附近形成的一颗行星，被引力弹弓甩离了那颗恒星吗？我得去问一下懂天体测量学的人，如果..." Coureuse 突然意识到她还在和你通话，"哦，舰长！非常抱歉。我想我们谈完了？我有很多 —— 我需要和团队的其他成员谈谈，" 她挥挥手，试图表达一些似乎根本表达不出来的东西，"... 一些想法。再见。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: I understand you've been funding Cornelius Elek. Giving him ideas.
options.zh: 据我所知，你一直在资助 Cornelius Elek，还为他出了许多主意。

texts.en:
The Director's face creates a smile.

"He wasn't supposed to tell anyone. But this is Cornelius Elek, so I cannot be surprised."

Her face, and tone, go blank again.

"You have something more to say about Elek. Proceed."
texts.zh:
总监的脸上勉强挤出一个微笑。"他不该告诉任何人的。不过 Cornelius Elek 就是这样，总管不住自己的嘴。"

她的表情和语调平淡下去。

"关于 Elek，你还有什么想问的就问吧。"

options.en: He was looking into an old sensor array. It found the Onslaught Mk.I.
options.zh: 他在调查一个老旧的传感器阵列。而这传感器阵列带我找到了 攻势 Mk.I。

texts.en: "Oh?" The Director's face is immobile.
texts.zh: "哦？" 总监的面容纹丝不动。

options.en: Yes. I thought you might be involved.
options.zh: 是的，我觉得你可能会牵涉其中。

texts.en: "What made you think that, I wonder," she says.
texts.zh: "是什么让你这么想的，我很好奇。" 她说道。

options.en: Because you're Tri-Tachyon's Director of 'Special Acquisitions'.
options.zh: 因为你是 速子科技 的 '特殊采购部' 总监

texts.en:
Glamor-Rotanev creates a smile for you.

"Yes, I was admiring your new acquisition." Her eyes flicker oddly, and you detect what might be a rare spark of genuine amusement.

"Or perhaps I should call it your very, very old acquisition."
texts.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 向你展示出一个微笑。

"不错，我方才正在欣赏你的新藏品。" 她的眼眸不自然地闪烁着，你察觉到其中或许夹杂着一丝罕见的真切趣味。

"或许我该称之为你极其、极其古老的藏品。"

texts.en:
Glamor-Rotanev creates a smile for you.

"And you acquired something special indeed. Elek was distraught, I am to understand."

Her eyes flicker oddly, and you detect what might be a rare spark of genuine amusement.
texts.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 向你展示出一个微笑。

"然后你找到了它。" 她对这消息听起来并不惊讶，"据我所知，Elek 当时悲痛欲绝。"

她的眼眸不自然地闪烁着，你察觉到其中或许夹杂着一丝罕见的真切趣味。

texts.en:
Glamor-Rotanev creates a smile for you.

"And you found what he didn't know he was looking for." She sounds unsurprised. "Elek was distraught, I am to understand."

Her eyes flicker oddly, and you detect what might be a rare spark of genuine amusement.
texts.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev为你展露一个微笑。

"而你找到了那件东西，那件他不曾自知在寻找的东西。" 她的语气毫无意外，"据我所知，Elek 当时悲痛欲绝。"

她的眼眸不自然地闪烁着，你察觉到其中或许夹杂着一丝罕见的真切趣味。

options.en: Elek prefers his science abstract and very far away, I think.
options.zh: 我觉得 Elek 更偏爱抽象且十分遥远的科学。

options.en: You prompted him. How did you know what that sensor array found?
options.zh: 是你推动了他。你怎么知道那个传感器阵列发现了什么？

options.en: Do you want to buy the Onslaught Mk.I from me?
options.zh: 你想从我这儿买下 攻势 Mk.I 吗？

options.en: I've been thinking about your offer concerning the Onslaught Mk.I.
options.zh: 我一直在考虑你是否会提出一些关于 攻势 Mk.I 的提议。

options.en: Let's talk about something else.
options.zh: 我们还是谈谈别的事吧。

texts.en:
She nods slowly, once.

"It will take some time, and credits, for him to become a useful asset again. It is much as any investment."
texts.zh:
她缓缓地点了一下头。

"让他重新成为可用的资产需要时间，也需要星币。这与任何投资都无异。"

options.en: So was the payoff worth the investment?
options.zh: 那么你的投资是否得到了相称的回报？

options.en: That's a cold way to put it. He's a human being, even if he's.. him.
options.zh: 这种说法真是冷酷。他也是人类，即便他...是那样的人。

texts.en: "I cannot answer, as that investment has not fully matured," she says. "Which brings me to business."
texts.zh: "我无法回答，因为这项投资尚未完全成熟，" 她说道，"这便引出了正题。"

texts.en: Her eyes fix upon you through the link. "And that business is the Onslaught Mk.I, which you found."
texts.zh: 她的目光透过通讯链接锁定着你。"而正题便是 攻势 Mk.I，也就是你所发现的那艘舰船。"

texts.en: Her eyes fix upon you through the link. "And that business is acquisition of additional samples from the Abyss."
texts.zh: 她隔着链接定定地看着你。"那桩差事，就是从深渊再多弄些样本回来。"

texts.en: "Your impulse to moralize is irrelevant to my interests," she says. "Let us return to business."
texts.zh: "你道德化的冲动与我的利益无关，" 她说道，"让我们回归正题。"

texts.en:
"Old records," she says.

"The Galatia Academy doesn't know what it has, much less how to make good use of it. They lack appropriate motivation to exploit their own resources."
texts.zh:
"旧档案，" 她简短地说道。

"Galatia 学院根本不清楚自己拥有什么，更别说善加利用。他们缺乏主观能动性的事实显而易见。"

texts.en:
She laughs with a buzz like a malfunctioning agrav plate.

"Oh, no. That'd be far too provocative to..." She gives a little flick of the hand, indicating enemies too irrelevant to bother acknowledging in speech.

The Hegemony, maybe.

"However," she fixes upon you. "I would gladly pay for the opportunity to have my people take a close look at it. And take a few samples, very small, nothing damaging."
texts.zh:
她的笑声像故障的反重力板般震颤作响。

"哦，不。那未免过于挑衅..." 她轻轻摆手，示意某些敌人不值一提，甚至不配被言语提及。

那或许是指 霸主。

"不过，" 她的目光锁定于你，"我很乐意为我的团队争取近距离研究的机会，并提取少量样本 —— 极其微小，绝无损害。"

options.en: You can't detect them, can you. That's what you want.
options.zh: 你无法探测到它们，对吧。这就是你想要的。

texts.en:
She blinks. "Detect them?"

Her voice is emotionless.
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼。"探测它们？"

她的声音没有任何情绪。

options.en: The Threat. They're all but invisible to you.
options.zh: '威胁'，它们对你而言几乎不可见。

texts.en:
Her face arranges itself into a shape suggesting dismissive amusement.

"What an interesting theory, captain. Whatever my motives, will you agree to my proposal? A simple look, a few scans. A few samples."
texts.zh:
她的脸上显露出一种轻蔑的趣味。

"多么有趣的理论，舰长。无论我的动机如何，你是否同意我的提议？只需要简单的观察，几次扫描，以及少许样本。"

options.en: One million credits.
options.zh: 一百万星币。

options.en: Let's discuss this later.
options.zh: 之后再谈吧。

texts.en:
A long pause. Her eyes flicker, accessing. Calculating.

"This is possible." She speaks with an emotion suddenly present - quiet displeasure, presumably at your maneuvering.

"You ask for much, captain."
texts.zh:
通讯陷入了漫长的沉默。她眼眸闪烁，表明她正在访问数据，计算权衡。

"这是可行的。" 她的语气突然有了一些情绪 —— 一种平静的不悦，大概由于你的迂回策略。

"你要价不菲，舰长。"

options.en: Tri-Tachyon's Director of Special Acquisitions can afford a mere million credits. I accept.
options.zh: 速子科技 的特殊采购部总监还是出得起一百万星币的。我接受。

options.en: Let's discuss this later.
options.zh: 等会再说。

texts.en:
"Done," she says, her voice as empty as the Abyss.

Almost instantly, your TriPad pings with several alerts - credits transfer, but also notification from your tactical officer concerning an approaching Tri-Tachyon portside-tender, swarming with engineering drones, and your comms, forwarding certain docking requests directly to the Onslaught Mk.I.

"Take a moment to ensure your affairs are in order, captain," Glamor-Rotanev says.

You'd think she enjoys overwhelming your officers with the speed of her response.
texts.zh:
"成交，" 她的声音像深渊一样空洞。

几乎同时，你的 TriPad 接连弹出数条通知 —— 星币到账，而你的战术军官也发来警示：一艘 满载工程无人机的 速子科技 泊位服务艇正逐步靠近，同时通讯系统也开始将某些对接请求直接转发至 攻势 Mk.I。

"请花些时间确认事务已安排妥当，舰长，" Glamor-Rotanev 说道。

你不禁怀疑她很享受用这种迅捷的回应让你的部下疲于应付的快感。

options.en: Make the arrangements
options.zh: 着手安排

texts.en:
Director Glamor-Rotanev takes a moment to turn and appear to look out over her spectacular view of the Xanadu Geodivision.

You're certain she's watching her teams as they board the Onslaught Mk.I through what are no doubt top-of-the-line cybernetic implants and neural integrations.

And, doubtless, watching your comms. Because just as you are finished, she turns back, resettling her facial muscles with a twitch.
texts.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 总监稍作停顿，随即便转身望向窗外 Xanadu 地质区划那壮丽的景色。

你确信她正通过顶级的赛博植入体与神经集成系统，监控着她的团队登上 攻势 Mk.I 的过程。

并且，毫无疑问，她也正在监视着你的通讯。因为就在你刚刚结束事务时，她便转回身，面部肌肉抽动着重新调整着表情。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I am satisfied, $playerName."

It's not that her tone is warm, more that it lacks a certain otherwise ubiquitous contempt perceivable only now by its absence.

Presumably temporary, of course.
texts.zh:
"我很满意，$playerName。"

并非是她的语气变得温暖，而是缺少了某种无处不在的轻蔑 —— 这种轻蔑此刻因缺席而格外明显。

当然，这大概只是暂时的。

texts.en:
Her eyes flicker subtly, her expression more glazed and vacant than before.

"Very... good, captain," she says.
texts.zh:
她的眼睑微微地颤动着，神情比先前更加呆滞与空洞。

"非常...好，舰长，" 她说道。

texts.en:
Her eyes flicker subtly, her expression more glazed and vacant than before.

"Very... good, captain," she says. Her words come more rapidly. "You've seen them. The Threat. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss. And you lived."

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她的眼睑微微地颤动着，神情比先前更加呆滞与空洞。

"非常...好，舰长，" 她说道，语速明显加快，"你见过它们了。'威胁'。深渊深处古老的自动化作战舰队。而你活了下来。"

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

texts.en:
"As I was saying, I have a great interest in... specimens. Artifacts. Like yours. And like what I presume it was built to fight," she says.

"You have been far more successful than the others. I would propose you repeat that success."
texts.zh:
"正如我所说，我对...标本有着浓厚的兴趣。遗物，像你拥有的那种，以及我推测它被制造出来所要对抗的那种东西。" 她说道。

"你比其他人成功得多，而我提议你应该重现那份成功。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en: "So you are open to dealing," she says. "Good."
texts.zh: "所以你愿意交易，" 她说道，"很好。"

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for."
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"有意思，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"没错，这正是我所寻找的。"

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for."
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"有意思，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"没错，这正是我所寻找的。"

options.en: So you know what it is. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 所以你已经知道那是什么了，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

options.en: So you know what it is. Was there another expedition that succeeded?
options.zh: 所以你已经知道那是什么了，难道还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

texts.en:
"'Was there another...'" she says, repeating your words.

"Dozens! Some returned with nothing, others not at all. I won't conceal the fact from you. Maybe you'll find them, though don't feel compelled to render assistance on behalf of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation. These were independent contractors who accepted and assumed the risk. Then failed."

"If anything," she says quietly, "we have grounds to sue them if they ever manage to get back to the Core Worlds."
texts.zh:
"'还有另一支...' 她重复你的话。

"还有几十支！他们有的空手而归，有的杳无音信，我不会对你隐瞒事实。或许你会遇到他们，但不必代表 三一速子科技公司 施以援手。这些都是接受并承担了风险的独立承包商，然后失败了。"

"甚至可以说，" 她低声道，"如果他们能侥幸返回核心世界，我们完全有理由起诉他们。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Return with something useful," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
texts.zh:
"带回有价值的东西，" 她转身背对你，望向地平线上如水晶般的，从 Eochu Bres 贫民窟生长而出的闪亮生态都市群。

"之后我就将让你光芒万丈。"

texts.en:
"Bring me more... samples. From the Abyss," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
texts.zh:
"再给我多带些...样本。从深渊里带，" 她说着背过身去，望向窗外——Eochu Bres 的贫民窟里，群峰与闪亮的生态巨城像水晶一样拔地而起。

"我会让你也闪闪发光。"

texts.en:
"Return with more finds," she says, turning her back to you to look upon the vista of mountaintops and shining arcologies growing like crystals from the slums of Eochu Bres.

"And I'll make you glitter."
texts.zh:
"带回更多的发现，" 她转身背对你，望向地平线上如水晶般的，从 Eochu Bres 贫民窟生长而出的闪亮生态都市群。

"之后我就将让你光芒万丈。"

options.en: What are you offering to pay me. Specifically.
options.zh: 你打算给我多少报酬？具体讲讲。

options.en: I could use fuel. Lots of fuel. And tankers to carry it.
options.zh: 我需要燃料。大量的燃料。还有运载燃料的油轮。

options.en: I'm going to need supplies. And a freighter to carry them.
options.zh: 我需要补给，以及一艘运载它们的货舰。

options.en: I believe we've come to an arrangement.
options.zh: 我相信我们已经达成了共识。

options.en: I'll consider your offer.
options.zh: 我会考虑你的提议。

options.en: I've considered your offer. One million credits for scan and samples from the Onslaught Mk.I. Agreed?
options.zh: 我考虑过你的提议了。一百万星币，用于扫描 攻势 Mk.I 并进行采样。同意吗？

texts.en: "Credits. Next question."
texts.zh: "星币。下一个问题。"

texts.en:
"Done." She speaks without turning.

Your TriPad pings a notification from your purser.
texts.zh:
"成交。" 她头也不回地说道。

你的 TriPad 响起事务长发来的通知。

texts.en:
She looks at you over her shoulder.

"You'll find that my charity is a shallow well, captain. I will trust in your boundless initiative," $personLastName says.
texts.zh:
她侧过头看向你。

"你会发现我的慷慨不过是口浅井，舰长。我将仰赖你无限的进取心，" $personLastName 说道。

texts.en:
"Can't let you starve on the road to glory, can we." She speaks without turning.

Your TriPad pings a notification from your purser.
texts.zh:
"总不能让你在通往荣耀的路上挨饿吧。" 她头也不回地说道。

你的 TriPad 响起事务长发来的通知。

texts.en: "You'll find that my charity is a shallow well, captain. I shall trust your initiative on this matter," $personLastName says, rocking on her heels impatiently.
texts.zh: "你会发现我的慷慨不过是口浅井，舰长。在这件事上我将仰赖你的进取心，" $personLastName 说道，一边不耐烦地轻轻摇晃着鞋跟。

texts.en:
* * *

You expect the Director will shed no tears if you and your crew perish. But she has a reputation for effective, if shadowy, investment and development.

And for brutally cutting underperforming elements while rewarding success.

You could make good money and powerful connections. Or die in the Abyss, screaming to yourself in a darkness blacker than space.
texts.zh:
* * *

你能够预料，如果你和你的团队全军覆没，那位总监也不会掉半滴眼泪。但她以高效 —— 尽管隐秘 —— 的投资开发能力而著称。

同时也以残酷地剔除低效元素，同时重赏成功者而著称。

你能借此赚取丰厚报酬并建立强大的人脉，又或是在深渊中嘶吼着死去，沉入比太空更浓稠的黑暗。

texts.en:
"You'll get no better," she says, her tone a dismissal.

* * *

You expect the Director will shed no tears if you and your crew perish. But she has a reputation for rewarding success and effective, if shadowy, investment and development.

And for brutally cutting underperforming elements.

You could make good money and powerful connections. Or die in the Abyss, screaming to yourself in a darkness blacker than space.
texts.zh:
"你找不到更好的条件，" 她说道，语气已是在下逐客令。

* * *

你能够预料，如果你和你的团队全军覆没，那位总监也不会掉半滴眼泪。但她以高效 —— 尽管隐秘 —— 的投资开发能力而著称。

同时也以残酷地剔除低效元素，同时重赏成功者而著称。

你能借此赚取丰厚报酬并建立强大的人脉，又或是在深渊中嘶吼着死去，沉入比太空更浓稠的黑暗。

texts.en:
"Perhaps," she says coldly, meaning 'perhaps not'.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring specimens of the type described."
texts.zh:
"或许吧，" 她冷冰冰地说道，言下之意是 '或许没有'。

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对此类样本的收购意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

texts.en:
"Perhaps," she says coldly, meaning 'perhaps not'.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring specimens of the type described."
texts.zh:
"或许吧，" 她冷冰冰地说道，言下之意是 '或许没有'。

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对此类样本的收购意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

texts.en:
"Perhaps," she says, repeating you rather frostily.

"And disappointing. It would be useful to compare your data to our baseline. I must emphasize my interest - my financial interest - in procuring more information about the Threat."
texts.zh:
"或许吧，" 她颇为冷淡地重复着你的话。

"真是令人失望，将你的数据与我们的基线进行比较本会很有效用。我必须强调我对 '威胁' 有关的更多信息的获取意愿 —— 以及背后可以提供的财务利益。"

options.en: You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

options.en: You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

options.en: You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '比较'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

texts.en:
"Then this topic serves no more purpose," she says frostily.

"Anything else?"
texts.zh:
"那么这个话题已经没有继续的必要了，" 她冷冰冰地说道。

"还有其他事吗？"

texts.en:
She leans back ever so slightly, but makes no outward response.

Her expression hasn't changed, but it feels somehow more impatient.
texts.zh:
她极其轻微地向后靠了靠，但未流露出任何外在反应。

她的表情虽无变化，却莫名透出更多的不耐烦。

texts.en: "Fine," she says briskly.
texts.zh: "很好，" 她干脆地回应道。

texts.en: "Fine," she says briskly.
texts.zh: "很好，" 她干脆地回应道。

texts.en:
"Fine," she says, the spite cold in her voice.

"You've seen them. The Threat. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss. And you lived." She is quite collected, suddenly, as she speaks.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
"很好，" 她说道，声音里的恶意冰冷而刺骨。

"你见过它们了。'威胁'。深渊深处古老的自动化作战舰队。而你活了下来。" 在陈述时，她突然变得异常冷静。

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

texts.en:
"As I was saying, I have a great interest in... specimens. Artifacts. Like yours. And like what I presume it was built to fight," she says.

"You have been far more successful than the others. I would propose you repeat that success."
texts.zh:
"正如我所说，我对...标本有着浓厚的兴趣。遗物，像你拥有的那种，以及我推测它被制造出来所要对抗的那种东西。" 她说道。

"你比其他人成功得多，而我提议你应该重现那份成功。"

texts.en: She says nothing, her disapproval resounding in the silence.
texts.zh: 她不置一词，异议在沉默中掷地有声。

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

options.en: So there was another expedition before me?
options.zh: 所以在我之前还有另一支科考队？

texts.en: "I am particularly interested in the hull you recovered from the Abyss. The Onslaught Mk.I is... unmistakable."
texts.zh: "我对你从深渊打捞的那艘舰船尤其感兴趣，那艘 攻势 Mk.I 的特征...无可混淆。"

options.en: Why? Are you going to make me an offer for it?
options.zh: 为什么？难道你要出价买它吗？

options.en: I've considered your offer. One million credits for access and scanning of the Mk.I.
options.zh: 我考虑过你的提议了。一百万星币，换取接触并扫描 Mk.I 的权利。

options.en: Select specimens to turn in
options.zh: 选择上交的样本

options.en: I have nothing for you right now.
options.zh: 我目前没有能提供给你的东西。

texts.en: Glamor-Rotanev gives you a frosty look.
texts.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 向你投来了冰冷的一瞥。

texts.en:
Her eyes flicker oddly.

"You've revised your position?"
texts.zh:
她的眼睛异样地闪动着。

"你改变主意了？"

options.en: My position is one million credits.
options.zh: 我的主意是一百万星币。

options.en: Let's discuss this later.
options.zh: 之后再谈吧。

texts.en:
She leans back ever so slightly, but makes no outward response.

Her expression hasn't changed, but it feels somehow more impatient.
texts.zh:
她极其轻微地向后靠了靠，但未流露出任何外在反应。

她的表情虽无变化，却莫名透出更多的不耐烦。

texts.en: She makes no response.
texts.zh: 她没有回答。

options.en: An Academician Elek said something funny- that he was being funded by Tri-Tachyon.
options.zh: 一位叫 Elek 的院士说了件有趣的事 —— 他说自己在接受 速子科技 的资助。

options.en: Academician Elek. You funded his research. And directed it.
options.zh: Elek 院士。你资助了他的研究，并且主导了研究方向。

texts.en:
Glamor-Rotanev creates a smile for you.

"I am a patron of the sciences. Didn't you hear?"
texts.zh:
Glamor-Rotanev 向你展示出一个微笑。

"我是科学的赞助人。你没听说吗？"

options.en: I've been thinking about your offer concerning the Onslaught Mk.I.
options.zh: 我一直在考虑你是否会提出一些关于 攻势 Mk.I 的提议。

options.en: I've found some 'interesting' specimens for you...
options.zh: 我为你找到了一些 '有趣的' 样本...

texts.en: "I am particularly interested in the hull you recovered from the Abyss. The Onslaught Mk.I is unmistakable."
texts.zh: "我对你从深渊打捞的那艘舰船尤其感兴趣，那艘 攻势 Mk.I 的特征无可混淆。"

texts.en: "My strategic predictors tagged you with reasonable odds of success," she says. "I must congratulate their operators."
texts.zh: "我的战略预测系统曾以合理的概率标注你具备成功的潜力，" 她说道，"我必须祝贺那些算法工程师。"

texts.en: "Oh?" Her eyes give a disconcerting twitch. "I should like to examine your discoveries."
texts.zh: "哦？" 她的眼睑令人不安地抽动了一下，"我倒想看看你的发现。"

texts.en: For a moment her brow develops a wrinkle. "More?" she says, and it disappears.
texts.zh: 片刻间她额头浮现出一道皱纹。"更多？" 她说道，那皱痕也随即消失。

options.en: Why? Are you going to make me an offer for it?
options.zh: 为什么？难道你要出价买它吗？

texts.en: "I should like to discuss the hull you recovered from the Abyss, the Onslaught Mk.I."
texts.zh: "我想谈谈你从深渊打捞回来的那具舰体，攻势 Mk.I。"

options.en: Why? Are you going to make me an offer for it?
options.zh: 怎么？要开价买？

options.en: I have questions about the 'specimens' I've sold you...
options.zh: 关于卖给你的那些 '样本'，我有些问题想问...

texts.en:
She says nothing, but her eyebrow raises fractionally. It is not an invitation to continue.

Nonetheless.
texts.zh:
她一言不发，只是微不可察地挑了挑眉毛。沉默便是她的回应。

...尽管如此。

texts.en: "You've asked quite enough for today," she says. "Captain."
texts.zh: "你今天的问题已经够多了，" 她说道，"舰长。"

options.en: What are you going to do with the 'Threat' artifacts?
options.zh: 你打算如何处理这些 '威胁' 遗物？

options.en: Does exploitating this technology not risk another AI War?
options.zh: 开发利用这项技术，是否可能会引发另一场 AI 战争？

options.en: Do you know what the 'Threat' are, or where they came from?
options.zh: 这些 '威胁' 到底是什么东西，又是从何而来？

options.en: So the 'Threat' are not alive, not intelligent?
options.zh: 这么说，'威胁' 并不是活体，也不具备智能？

options.en: The 'other' specimens- what do you intend to do with them?
options.zh: 那些 '其他' 的样本 —— 你打算如何处置它们？

options.en: Do you know what these 'other' specimens... are?
options.zh: 你知道这些 '其他' 样本...是什么吗？

options.en: That's all I wanted to ask.
options.zh: 我要问的就是这些。

options.en: Actually, never mind.
options.zh: 算了，当我没说。

texts.en:
"Research and development," she says. Her expression isn't quite a smirk.

"These components are obviously derived from a neglected branch of Domain-era technology. This makes them fundamentally human technology. The path to profitable exploitation is fundamentally open, albeit complex. The Tri-Tachyon corporation is ideally placed to exploit them."
texts.zh:
"研究与开发，" 她说道，那神情算不上讥讽。

"这些组件明显源自某个被忽视的 人之领 时代技术分支，这使它们本质上属于人类技术。虽然过程复杂，但盈利性开发的道路在根本上是敞开的。而 速子科技 正处于开发利用它们的理想位置。"

texts.en:
"These are not artificial intelligences," she says decisively.

"Not that such distinction is necessary to Hegemony regulators. Whatever future war the Hegemony initiates, whatever new oppressions they conceive, it will be a consequence of leadership as paranoid as their masses are ignorant."

"Besides," she says, self-satisfied, "if I am right about everything, there will be no need for a war."
texts.zh:
"这些东西并非是人工智能，" 她斩钉截铁地说道。

"当然这对 霸主 的监管机构而言无关紧要。无论 霸主 在未来发动何种战争，构想何种新的压迫手段，都将是其领导层的偏执与民众的蒙昧所共同作用的产物。"

"况且，" 她自得地补充道，"若我关于一切的推测都正确，战争将不再会有必要。"

texts.en:
"In the simplest terms," her voice contains more than a hint of condescension, "they are autonomous self-fabricating, self-modifying constructs derived from ancient Domain designs. Their intent, so far as they could be said to have intent, is destructive toward our technological base."

"'Why' is a more difficult question."

Her dead eyes move oddly. "I find it amusing that the Luddics would recoil in horror, but they could not find a better ally to their cause."
texts.zh:
"用最简单的话说，" 她的语气中透露着毫不掩饰的居高临下感，"所谓 '威胁'，本质上是一群不断自我复制、自我改写的无人构造体，它们的设计可追溯至 人之领 时期。如果你喜欢更拟人的说法，它们的目的无非是：摧毁我们现有的科技体系。

"至于其敌对行为的原因，那就无从得知了。"

她的眼睛怪异地动了动。"不觉得很有意思吗。卢德信徒们见了这些东西只会本能地惊惶逃窜，却没能意识到他们双方追求的结果并无二致。"

texts.en:
"Is a machine alive? Is a virus?" She pauses for a fraction of a second before providing her own answer.

"I don't care."
texts.zh:
"机器算是活的吗？病毒又算是活的吗？" 她停顿了一瞬，随后给出了自己的答案：

"我不在乎。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Functionally the 'Threat' phenomenon demonstrates no attempt to present a sense of selfhood, collective or otherwise. What passes for communication is hostile and garbled; the loose ends of automatic warnings and obsolete Domain decrees. If it is conscious in any form, it is impossibly solipsistic."

"Which is just as well," the Director produces a robotic half-smile. "It will be a better tool that way."
texts.zh:
"仅从功能上看，'威胁' 现象并未表现出任何自我意识的迹象，无论是个体层面还是集体层面。它们仅有的沟通，充其量只是充满敌意的噪声：残缺的自动化警告音和过时的 人之领 法令。即使它们在某种意义上真的具备意识，那这种意识也是彻底的唯我论。"

"这样也很好，" 她露出一个机械般的、几乎无法称之为笑容的笑容，"工具不需要有意识。"

texts.en:
"Research and development."

The Director releases a deliberate breath.

"We know it isn't human. We know it is powerful. The return on investment, therefore, is beyond human imagination."

She looks satisfied with the thought.
texts.zh:
"研究与开发。"

总监长吁了一口气。

"我们知道那不是人类。我们知道它力量强大。因此，投资的回报将超乎人类的想象。"

她对这番构想显得心满意足。

texts.en:
"That is speculation for the research division. Or perhaps you would care to ask a philosopher? Or a curate?" This last idea appears to amuse her, insofar as she is capable of expressing that, or any, emotion.

"My interest is in what these specimens, these phenomena, can DO. For me. Or the Company."

She pulls her glassy eyes back to the comm-link.

"For humanity. At least that small percentage of it willing to accept the radical and necessary future."
texts.zh:
"那是研究部门的推测范畴。或许你更倾向于询问哲学家？或是祭司？" 最后这个念头似乎令她感到有趣 —— 在她所能表达的情绪范围内。

"我的兴趣在于这些样本，这些现象，能 '做什么'。为我，为公司。"

她将玻璃般的眼睛重新聚焦到通讯链接上。

"为人类。至少是为那些愿意接受这激进而必要的未来的那少数人。"

texts.en: "Good," she says.
texts.zh: "很好"，她说道。

options.en: I found Gargoyle. There may be some expenses.
options.zh: 我找到 Gargoyle 了。兴许要花点钱。

texts.en:
Arroyo looks even less pleased to see you after this statement.

"I see," he says.

He raises a gold-ringed finger, "Don't tell me a single word. It's Gargoyle. I know very well that I don't want to know what that absurd vandal is planning. I'll pay the bills that show up, that's the deal." He grimaces, "And I'll forward my invoice to Provost Baird so that ivory-torus puppetmaster can appreciate how much she's wringing me for."

"Now get off my comms."

He terminates the connection.
texts.zh:
这话一出，Arroyo 脸上的不悦更重了几分。

"原来如此，" 他说道。

他竖起一根戴金戒指的手指，"一个字也别跟我讲。是 Gargoyle 干的。我清楚得很，那个荒唐的捣蛋鬼在盘算什么，我一点都不想知道。账单来了我照付，说好的就是这样。" 他做了个苦脸，"回头我把发票转给 Baird 院长，好让那位象牙塔里牵线的主儿掂量掂量，她从我这儿榨走了多少。"

"现在，从我的通讯上滚开。"

他掐断了链接。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: I found Gargoyle. There may be some expenses.
options.zh: 我找到 Gargoyle 了。兴许要花点钱。

texts.en:
You enter the comms ID, hand hovering over a glowing 'confirm' sigil. Your comms officer nods, ready to respond to whatever surprises Gargoyle thinks would be amusing to send through the link this time.

The display resolves from a mesmerizing fractal battleground to a familiar face grinning impishly at you. "Oh $playerFirstName, are you having trouble finding Nova Maxios? Let me help, I'll send you a copy of Baby's First Star Chart."

Your TriPad chimes softly.

"Go on, read it. Find 'M is for Magec'. You can figure it out! I believe in you." Gargoyle turns away and waves you off as your comms seem to disconnect of its own accord.
texts.zh:
你输入通讯 ID，手悬停在发光的 "确认" 标志上。通讯军官点了点头，对方已经准备好应对任何 Gargoyle 可能为了找乐子而发过来的惊喜内容了。

你的主屏幕从迷人而支离破碎的电子战场变成了一张神态夸张，顽皮地向你咧嘴笑着的脸。"喔，$playerFirstName，你找不到 Nova Maxios 了？让我帮帮你吧，我会给你一张婴儿都能看懂的星际地图。"

你的 TriPad 响起了轻柔的铃声。

"读下去，读下去。找到 'M 开头的 Magec'。你能搞明白的！我相信你。" Gargoyle 转过身去并挥手示意你离开，接着你的通讯链接自动断开了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You enter the comms ID, hand hovering over a glowing 'confirm' sigil. Your comms officer nods, ready to respond to whatever surprises Gargoyle thinks would be amusing to send through the link this time.

The display resolves without incident to a familiar face grinning impishly. "Ah, Captain $playerFirstName! You must have forgotten my simple instructions."

Gargoyle counts off fingers, "Step one, collect the device. You did that, hurray! Step two, install it on the Aztlan Relay in - pay attention now, maybe get your scowly comms officer to take a memo - in the Aztlan system. Step three, come back to me for your precious data archive."

The hacker waves the remaining two fingers at you in a rude gesture. "And that's how it's done. Bye bye, busy now."

Your comms disconnect seemingly of their own accord.
texts.zh:
你输入通讯 ID，手悬停在发光的 "确认" 标志上。你的通讯军官点了点头，他已经准备好应对任何 Gargoyle 认为有趣的通讯内容了。

你的主屏幕上显示出了一张神态夸张，顽皮地向你咧嘴笑着的脸，没有发生任何意外。"啊，$playerFirstName 舰长！你一定是忘了我简单的提示。"

Gargoyle 数着手指，"第一步，收集设备。你做到了，万岁！第二步，把它安装在位于 Aztlan 星系的 —— 现在注意了，也许你该让你愁眉紧锁的通讯军官做个备忘录 —— Aztlan 中继站里。第三步，回到我这里来拿你宝贵的数据档案。"

黑客用剩下的两根手指粗鲁地朝你挥了挥。"事情就是这样。再见，我现在很忙。"

你的通讯链接自动断开了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Tell Baird about Gargoyle's plan to hack a Hegemony relay
options.zh: 告诉 Baird 关于 Gargoyle 黑掉 霸主 通讯中继站的计划

texts.en:
Provost Baird listens patiently as you explain. When you are finished, she waits a moment, then says crisply "I do not need to know your every move, captain, provided that you carry out your ultimate objective. If this 'Gargoyle' is the one I've heard so much about, then we have a good chance of acquiring the Kallichore Archive."

"Your course of action is obvious: help the hacker do it by whatever means are necessary, at whatever cost is required." She adopts the tone of a disappointed teacher, "Surely you don't need me to tell you this."
texts.zh:
Baird 院长耐心地听着你的解释。当你说完时，她等了一会儿，然后干脆地说："舰长，我只需要你完成任务，不关心你的每一步行动，如果这个 'Gargoyle' 是我久仰大名的那个，那么我们得到 Kallichore 的档案的可能性就很大了。"

"你的行动方针很明显：帮助黑客，用任何必要的手段，不惜任何代价。" 她的语气就像失望的老师，"你肯定不需要我来告诉你这些。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Tell Baird about Gargoyle's plan to hack a Hegemony relay
options.zh: 告诉 Baird 关于 Gargoyle 黑掉 霸主 通讯中继站的计划

texts.en:
Provost Baird listens patiently as you explain. When you are finished, she waits a moment, then says crisply "I do not need to know your every move, captain, provided you carry out your ultimate objective."

"Your course of action is obvious: help this 'Gargoyle' by whatever means are necessary, at whatever cost is required." Baird turns to her desk display, scanning for her next appointment. A dismissal.

You reach to disconnect the comms when she adds, "Do have a copy of the specifications of this hack device sent to my office. I am intrigued."
texts.zh:
Baird 院长耐心地听着你的解释。当你说完时，她等了一会儿，然后干脆地说："舰长，我只需要你完成任务，不需要知道你的每一步行动。"

"你的行动方针很明确：帮助黑客，用任何必要的手段，不惜任何代价。" Baird 看向了她桌上的显示屏，确认着她的日程表。看起来你该走了。

你伸手想切断通讯，这时她补充道，"务必把这个黑客设备的规格参数发到我的办公室，我很感兴趣。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Tell Baird about the installation of the hack device
options.zh: 告诉 Baird 黑客装置已经安装完成了

texts.en:
"You installed this hack device, and did not get the decrypted Kallichore Archive from Gargoyle before returning here?"

Baird pulls off her spectacles and stands, her usual cool quite broken, and shouts, "Go now! Get the archive before someone else does! Why are you waiting, go!"
texts.zh:
“你安装了黑客装置，回来之前却没有从 Gargoyle 那里拿到解密的 Kallichore 的档案？”

Baird 摘下眼镜站起身来，她平时的冷静消失得无影无踪，“现在快去！抢在别人之前拿到档案！你还等什么，快！”

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"The automated transmitter returns worked perfectly. It's-," a series of expressions crosses Coureuse's face, and she begins to speak in half-starts at least three times before giving up. Instead, she laughs. "It's amazing, captain," she says, her eyes tracking back to the holo display, focusing back on the data.

"I have... so much to do," she says, distracted.
texts.zh:
"自动发信器传回的结果堪称完美。这可以说是..." Coureuse 的表情五味杂陈，她好像想解说些什么，但还是放弃了。她转而笑起来。"这数据真是太美妙了，舰长，" 她一边说一边看向全息显示屏，兴致满满地盯着扫描数据。

"我还有...很多要做的，" 她心不在焉地说道。

texts.en:
Coureuse looks up from her console, a cloud of holo data shifting to adjust to her gaze, "Oh, it's you! The research team, ah, we're processing the data you've collected from the Gates."

"We've- we can't really talk about it until Provost Baird gives the go-ahead," she says. "But between you and me, the results are... exciting, but there are risks."
texts.zh:
Coureuse 的目光越过面前的控制台看向你，她面前一团团的全息数据为她的视线让开道路，"哦，是你啊！研究小组，嗯，正在分析你从星门上扫描到的数据。"

"我们现在已 —— 哎，在征得 Baird 院长同意前，我只能保持沉默，" 她说道。"不过，私下里给你透露一点，目前得出的结果... 很是令人兴奋，但也伴随着风险。"

options.en: Risks?
options.zh: 风险？

texts.en: She looks off grimly, somewhere beyond her terminal's pick-up. "I shouldn't talk about it. Like this. I'll raise my concerns in the meeting with Provost Baird. Hopefully she listens."
texts.zh: 她目光阴沉地移开视线，向终端机以外的地方看去。"我不该说这些事情的。至少不该在这里说。我会在之后的会议中向 Baird 院长提出我的要求。希望她能听进去。"

texts.en:
Baird taps at her desk console. "With the Gate scans completed and Daud's assurance that the Hegemony will not interfere, we may proceed to the implementation phase."

The provost allows herself a small smile as she turns to you. "This is Scylla's moment, of course. Let me link her in."
texts.zh:
Baird 点了一下桌子上的控制台。"现在我们完成了对星门的扫描，Daud 也保证了 霸主 不会进行干涉，我们可以进入实行阶段了。"

院长露出微微一笑，转过身看向你。"到 Scylla 大显身手的时候了，我把她的通讯接进来。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Provost Baird. Captain $playerName," Coureuse greets you.

"Explain the Janus Device," Baird says, "For the captain here."
texts.zh:
"Baird 院长，$playerName 舰长，" Coureuse 向你们问好。

"解释一下 '双面神' 装置 吧，" Baird 说，"这位舰长对此还一无所知呢。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She looks nervous. "The prototype device," she begins, "Yes. In the um broad strokes, to scan for the Gate aperture, we direct a self-modifying phased hyperwave pulse which causes a resonation in lower dimensions which-"

She looks up from the projected schematic and notices she's losing her audience. "Let's skip ahead to the application section." The schematics flicker through several labyrinthine arrangements and settle on an action flowchart. "Here we are."

"The principle of the Janus prototype is similar to the scanner, but far more energetic. By tuning the pulse to the unique resonant signature of a particular Gate aperture, one might - theoretically - activate that link. A second input would then target a known Gate egress, though avoiding destructive interference in the Calabi-Yau manifold is tricky..."
texts.zh:
她看上去有些紧张。"这台原型设备是，" 她开口道，"是的，大体来讲，为了扫描星门圆环，我们使用的是一束能自修改的相位超空间脉冲波，这个脉冲波能在低维度引发共振，然后共振会导致 —— "

她抬头看向投影图，注意到你应该完全没有听懂，"我们直接说这装置该怎么用。" 示意图在几个迷宫般的界面中闪烁，最终停在了一张运行流程图上。

"这台 '双面神' 装置 原型机的原理和星门扫描仪很相似，不同之处在于它输出的能量远远超过任何普通扫描仪。如果我们对这束脉冲波进行微调，让它完美符合某个特定的星门圆环的共振特征，我们就能 —— 理论上能 —— 激活那个链接。另一个输入数据可以是任何已知的星门出口，不过想要在卡拉比-丘流形中避免毁坏性的干扰还是有些困难的..."

options.en: So this would reopen the Gate network?
options.zh: 所以这东西能重启星门网络？

texts.en:
Baird cuts in, "Not exactly. Thank you for your attention to detail, Scylla, but if I may summarize: at this level of energy input, a temporary link should be created between two Gates."

The provost gets a distant look, "Then, with sufficient energy in stable resonance injected into the entire Gate system..."
texts.zh:
Baird 打断道，"倒也没那么困难。谢谢你细心的讲解，Scylla，不过我想总结一下：利用如此高的能量输入，我们应该能在两座星门之间建立暂时的连接。"

院长眺望着远方，"然后，如果我们对整个星门网络灌进足够多的，能够稳定共振的能量..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
This time, Coureuse interrupts, "But the data! It shows that the system, the resonance, it is fundamentally chaotic! There are clearly some other, some factors... we're seeing results the model doesn't account for, and at higher magnitudes the results could be, be-" She searches for words, some way to bind chaos and destruction into quantified language.

"That's enough, academician," Baird says forcefully. "The captain is a highly skilled professional and doesn't need to hear all of this to do their job."
texts.zh:
这次换 Coureuse 插话了，"但是这些数据！数据显示星门系统，这些共振从根本上就是混沌的！一定还有其他的什么影响因素... 我们观测到的一些结果根本就不符合我们建立的模型，而且在更大尺度上，结果可能会，会是 ——" 她寻找着一些能量化描述混乱和破坏的词语。

"够了，院士，" Baird 厉声说道。"我们的舰长是一位训练有素的专业人士，不用听你的长篇大论，也能做好他们的工作。"

options.en: Well...
The Provost is right, I am more of a big-picture type leader.
options.zh: 院长是对的，我是个大局型的领导者。

options.en: Academician, what exactly does 'chaotic' mean in this context?
options.zh: 院士，你说的 '混沌' 具体是什么意思？

texts.en:
Baird turns to you, leaving Coureuse cowed, "Academician Coureuse will return to work refining the details as more data is gathered. As a great man once said, 'Technological advance is an inherently iterative process.'"

"Captain," she says, "The first prototype Janus Device is being transferred to your $shipOrFleet. Test it on a Gate manifold you have scanned. Record everything with your sensor suite and the modified instruments we have provided. This may be the most important experiment in the history of the Persean Sector."
texts.zh:
Baird 转向你，不顾看上去有些畏畏缩缩的 Coureuse，"Coureuse 院士会继续她的工作，从更多数据中提炼更有用的信息。一位伟人曾说过，'技术进步本质上是一个迭代过程。'"

"舰长，" 她说，"我们的第一台 '双面神' 装置 原型机现在正被转移到你的$shipOrFleet上。找一个你已经扫描过的星门流形测试一下它吧。用你的传感器和我们提供的设备记录一切数据。这可能是英仙座星域历史上最重大的实验了。"

options.en: The... manifold. Of course.
options.zh: 星门... 流形。当然了，没问题。

texts.en:
Coureuse speaks up one last time, "Just, just don't use it in an inhabited system. Like the incident when Kallichore... the Hegemony... it wouldn't be good."

"Thank you," Baird says acidly, "For the reminder. Academician."

The provost turns to you now, "Obviously we shall not repeat my predecessor's mistake. Test this somewhere quiet." She turns from the holodisplay, a dismissal "I await your results, captain."

Baird terminates the comms.
texts.zh:
Coureuse 最后一次开口，"只是，只是别在有人居住的星系里试用。想想 Kallichore 时期的那次事故... 然后霸主... 恐怕没有好事的。"

"谢谢你，" Baird 尖刻地说，"你的温馨提示很有用。院士。"

院长现在转向了你，"我们当然不能重蹈前任院长的覆辙。还是找个安静的地方测试这设备吧，" 她的注意力回到了全息显示屏上，给出了逐客令，"我等着你的结果，舰长。"

Baird 关闭了通讯。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接
