texts.zh: Your $shipOrFleet maintains its position near $entityName.

texts.en: The armored asteroid-station bristles with weapons, targeting arrays active and hungry. Small warships flit about like hornets, and the comms channels are flooded with the screech of electronic warfare.
texts.zh: The armored asteroid-station bristles with weapons, targeting arrays active and hungry. Small warships flit about like hornets, and the comms channels are flooded with the screech of electronic warfare.

texts.en: Doing any kind of business here will not be possible until things calm down.
texts.zh: Doing any kind of business here will not be possible until things calm down.

options.en: Consider your military options
options.zh: 考虑可以采取的军事行动

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

options.en: Ask where you could find the office of Cornelius Elek
options.zh: 询问在哪里能找到 Cornelius Elek 的办公室

texts.en:
A strange expression crosses the junior agent's face at your question, but it is instantly replaced by a return to bland pleasantness.

"Of course, captain. I presume you have an appointment? Academician Elek can be... busy."
texts.zh:
接待员因你的问题闪过了一副奇怪的表情，但立刻回到原本平和又愉悦的样貌。

"当然了，舰长。您应该有过预约了？Elek 院士可能... 会很忙。"

texts.en:
A strange expression crosses the junior agent's face at your question, but it is instantly replaced by a return to bland pleasantness.

"Of course, captain. I presume you have an appointment? Academician Elek can be... busy."
texts.zh:
接待员因你的问题闪过了一副奇怪的表情，但立刻回到原本平和又愉悦的样貌。

"当然了，舰长。您应该有过预约了？Elek 院士可能... 会很忙。"

options.en: He sent me a personal invitation.
options.zh: 他给我发了私人邀请。

options.en: I found his... experiment in the Fringe. I'm returning it to him.
options.zh: 我在边缘星区发现了他的...某种实验品。我要把它还给他。

texts.en:
"Of course, $playerSirOrMadam," the agent says. "If you'll come right this way."

You are led through the station's primary transport hub and are soon deposited in an airy plaza halfway around the ring of the station. Your junior agent leads you through crowds of students and past a few tight-lipped academicians who scurry by, clutching datapads.

The junior agent fills the air with the sort of patter they must have saved for first-cycle students, pointing out landmarks and remarking upon departments and figures of interest to niche fields of study.
texts.zh:
"当然，$playerSirOrMadam，" 接待员说道，"请跟我来。"

你穿过学院空间站的主要交通枢纽，很快到了围绕着交通站的宽敞广场。初级代理引导你穿过成群的学生们，其中夹杂着几个紧握着数据平板，抿着嘴且匆匆走过的学者。

初级代理说着些准备给第一个星历年学期的学生听的闲聊，不断介绍着各种学院地标，并对各个学院部门和前沿研究领域侃侃而谈，填补着路程中的氛围。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You arrive in a quiet hall off the main concourse, only a couple decks above the station rim. An open volume ringed by railings provides a dizzying view of the clouds of Pontus 'below' you.

"Third door on the right, $playerSirOrMadam." The junior agent makes a tight smile then disappears.
texts.zh:
你来到了主广场外一个寂静的大厅，此处只比学院空间站的外缘高了几层。一片围绕着栏杆的开阔空间能让人低头望见 Pontus 的云层，这视角下的景色令人眩晕。

"左侧第三个门，$playerSirOrMadam。" 初级代理紧张地微笑了下，之后就离开了。

options.en: Enter
options.zh: 进入

texts.en:
A man in academician's robes is buried in a holodisplay. Several moons appear to orbit his head.

"What have I told you hooligans about office hours?" he shouts out. "They don't start until-"

He finally looks and realizes you aren't one of his students.

"Ah." He adopts a look of stern prognostication, cradling his hands together as glowing orbs circle above. "I suppose greetings are in order. I am Academician Cornelius Elek, senior vice-chair of the Planetology Department of the Galatia Academy."

"And you are?"
texts.zh:
一个穿着学者袍的人被全息投影所包围，几个卫星的影像环绕着他的头。

"我是怎么和你们这群小流氓说的？" 他大叫道，"答疑时间是 —— "

他抬起头并意识到你不是他的学生。

"啊。" 他立刻换上一副严肃预言家的神态，双手交握，几颗光球在头顶缓缓盘旋，"我想我该介绍下自己，我是 Cornelius Elek 院士，Galatia 学院行星学部门的高级副主任。"

"那么你是谁？"

options.en: I'm $playerName. We've spoken before. I returned your datacore.
options.zh: 我是$playerName。我们见过面：我找回了你的数据核心。

options.en: I'm $playerName. I tried to contact you via comms...
options.zh: 我是 $playerName。我试过用通讯联系你...

options.en: I'm $playerName. You invited me to see you.
options.zh: 我是 $playerName。你邀请过我来见你。

options.en: I'm $playerName. I found your modified sensor array on the Fringe.
options.zh: 我是 $playerName，我在边缘星区找到了你改装过的传感器阵列。

options.en: I'm $playerName. We've spoken before. I returned your datacore.
options.zh: 我是$playerName。我们见过面：我找回了你的数据核心。

options.en: I'm $playerName, remember? I've found your sensor array on the Fringe.
options.zh: 我是 $playerName，还记得吗？我在边疆找到了你的传感器阵列。

options.en: I'm $playerName. I found your modified sensor array on the Fringe.
options.zh: 我是 $playerName。我在边疆找到了你那座改装过的传感器阵列。

texts.en:
Elek stares at you, the spark of recognition failing to ignite.

"I'm afraid I don't recall," he says. "What, may I ask, is the purpose of your visit?"
texts.zh:
Elek 盯着你，看不出一点认识你的样子。

"恐怕我不记得了。" 他说道，"请问你为什么来这？"

options.en: You sent a message about doing a job.
options.zh: 你发消息说有个活儿要干。

options.en: You sent a message about 'an old mystery'. I'd like to help solve it.
options.zh: 你发了关于一个 '远古谜团' 的消息给我，我希望帮忙解决。

options.en: You sent me a message. I was interested in the 'vast fortune'.
options.zh: 你给我发了消息。我对提到的 '大笔星币' 很感兴趣。

texts.en:
"Oh yes, of course. You should have simply said so."

He rushes out of his holodisplay to pick up a datapad, then places himself behind a large desk, waving you toward a chair. Unfortunately it is occupied by a battered datacore, the sort used in long-range probes.

"Now then," he taps at his datapad, failing to notice your obstacle.

"The mystery concerns a very old dataset which has been in the Galatia Academy archives for somewhat more than two hundred cycles. I stumbled upon it in the course of my studies - well, in fact, I was discussing the old archives with... a friend, a wealthy patron of the sciences. A comment they made reminded me of its existence."
texts.zh:
"哦。对的，是那件事。你本可以直接说就是。"

他冲出那堆全息投影，捡起一个数据平板后坐在一张大桌子后面，一边对着你向一张椅子招手示意。不幸的是，那张椅子已被一个破旧的数据核心所占用，看上去是从一个远距离探测器里取出来的。

"现在，" 他点着他的数据平板，没注意到你的椅子上已经有客了。

"这个谜团涉及到 Galatia 学院档案中大概两百个星历年前的古老数据集。我是在一项研究 —— 实际上我是在和... 一个学术赞助人朋友讨论旧档案时偶然发现的，和他的讨论让我想起来这个数据集。"

options.en: Remain standing
options.zh: 继续站着

texts.en:
"As it happens, this dataset is a recording of telemetry from a Domain-era sensor array out on what we now call the Fringe. It was somewhat more civilized back when this data was captured, though not perhaps by much."

Elek chuckles softly at his wit.

"As for the dataset, we only really have a complete sourcing header. Our copy is mostly corrupted due to anomalous  degradation during hyperwave transmission and then over 200 cycles of low-priority storage."

He shakes his head with deep disappointment at the mistakes made by someone else.
texts.zh:
"碰巧，这份数据包是 人之领 时代位于我们现在称为边缘星区的传感器阵列的一份遥测数据。在它采集数据时，那片星区或许文明程度稍高些，但可能也没好到哪儿去。"

Elek 为自己的才智得意一笑。

"至于数据包本身，我们保存完整的只有来源头文件。大多数副本已经损坏，原因在于超波传输过程中的异常衰减，以及随后长达 200 个星历年的低优先级存储。"

对于那些人为错误，他非常失望地摊了摊手。

options.en: This chair has a datacore in it.
options.zh: 这张椅子上有个数据核心。

options.en: Cough pointedly and look toward the chair
options.zh: 刻意咳嗽并看向椅子

options.en: Remain standing
options.zh: 保持站立

texts.en:
He snaps out of his reverie and looks at the chair.

"So it does," he says. "Please don't touch it."
texts.zh:
他从沉思中回过神，看向那把椅子。

"确实如此。" 他说道，"请不要碰它。"

texts.en:
"In any event," Elek cradles his hands, looking into an imagined middle-distance. "This patron and, ah, friend offered to fund a project to recover an intact copy of the data."

"From the source." He smiles, quite pleased with himself. "An expedition shall be made to the original sensor array! Your name came up, captain."
texts.zh:
"总之，" Elek 双手交叉，看向远处。"这位赞助者和，呃，他的朋友，愿意出钱来恢复一份完整的数据副本。"

"从源头开始。" 他自得地笑着，"组建一支科考队前往那个传感器阵列！舰长，你的名字也在名单上。"

options.en: Find the sensor array, extract the data. Sounds simple.
options.zh: 找到传感器阵列，提取数据。听上去挺简单。

texts.en:
"When put like that, yes." He stands, placing his hands together behind his back, and begins pacing.

"I shall provide you with a scientific hardware package my students have prepared. It is far from simple, I assure you of that! Have your technicians attach it to the sensor array and it will carry out the necessary operations."

"That's not all, however." He pauses to look at you with a sly smile.
texts.zh:
"这么说，确实。" 他站起身，双手背在身后踱步。

"我的学生之前准备的科学设备包，可以给你一份。我向你保证，这绝非易事！让你的技师把它装到传感器阵列上，它能自行完成必要的步骤。"

"不过，我还没说完呢。" 他露出狡黠的微笑。

options.en: Oh?
options.zh: 哦？

options.en: I haven't agreed to anything yet, Elek.
options.zh: 我还没答应你呢，Elek。

texts.en:
"I propose that once you acquire the data and my algorithm extracts the targeting coordinates, you then travel to the indicated location which lies at the heart of all of this effort. Explore what is to be explored, find what is to be found. You will bring back no mere long-range scan, but a thorough investigation!"

"Think of the science, think of the glory! And," he winks, "You must be thinking of that 'vast fortune'. I do believe that Director Gla... that my 'friend' will be more than delighted by this fait accompli."
texts.zh:
"我建议一旦你获取数据，并且我的算法也解析出目标坐标，就前往这所有努力指向的核心地点。探索需要探索的，发现应该发现的。你带回的将不只是远程扫描结果，而是彻底的实地勘察！"

"想想科学价值，想想这份荣耀！而且，" 他眨眼示意，"你一定在惦记那 '大笔星币'。我相信总监 Gla...我的那位 '朋友'，会对这份既成事实感到欣喜若狂的。"

options.en: Why is this data so important? What did this sensor array find?
options.zh: 这些数据为什么那么重要？这个传感器阵列究竟发现了什么？

options.en: In your message, you mentioned a reward. The words 'vast fortune' were used.
options.zh: 你在消息里你提到了酬劳，并用了 '大笔星币' 这个说法。

options.en: I didn't get a clear answer about this reward. How much is it?
options.zh: 关于这份酬劳，我还没得到明确的答复。具体数额是多少？

options.en: Who exactly is this 'friend' of yours?
options.zh: 你的这位 '朋友' 究竟是什么人？

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: I'm not interested right now.
options.zh: 我目前没兴趣。

options.en: I told you, I'm not working for Tri-Tachyon.
options.zh: 我告诉过你，我不会为 速子科技 工作。

texts.en:
"An excellent question." Elek taps at his datapad, and turns toward his holodisplay.

The spinning moons have disappeared to be replaced by a map of the Persean Sector, a broad swath of stars. The Core Worlds are highlighted, the fringe stars somewhat dimmed.

"Here you see - or do not see, for it is in the crudest sense a sort of absence - the Orion-Persean Abyss. It is far from a nothingness, however. And it is that not-nothingness with which we are concerned."
texts.zh:
"问得好。" Elek 点了点数据平板，一边转向他的全息显示屏。

旋转的卫星模型消失了，取而代之的是英仙座星域的星图 —— 一片广阔的星群。核心星区被高亮显示，边缘星系则略显暗淡。

"你可以看到 —— 或者说看不到，因为它本质上是某种虚无 —— 猎户-英仙座深渊。然而，它远非空无一物，而我们关注的正是这种 '非虚无'。"

options.en: So... there's something in the Abyss.
options.zh: 所以...深渊里确实有什么东西。

options.en: Aren't you a planetologist? This seems outside your field.
options.zh: 你不是行星学家吗？这似乎超出了你的专业领域。

texts.en:
"Correct, dear captain!" Elek sounds pleased that you have followed the trajectory of his lesson.

"There are indeed planets to be found there. Cold, dark, and alone; bereft of their parent stars, flung into the sparse wastes between the arms of our galaxy."
texts.zh:
"没错，亲爱的舰长！" Elek 因你跟上了他的授课思路而显得相当愉悦。

"那里确实能找到行星。寒冷、黑暗、孤独；被剥离母恒星，抛入我们银河系旋臂之间稀疏的荒芜地带。"

texts.en:
"I theorize that it is one of these planets our sensor array was targeting."

His tone grows less heated. "Or, rather, an unknown energetic event involving or concerning one such planet. We are not certain exactly which, however, and it is exceedingly difficult - and expensive - to perform any kind of broad analysis of these wayward children from afar. And with our sadly reduced means compared to the grand days of the old Domain... alas, alack."
texts.zh:
"我推测，这颗行星正是我们的传感器阵列锁定的目标之一。"

他的语气稍缓。"或者更准确地说，是涉及或关于这样一颗行星的未知高能事件。但我们尚不能确定具体推测出是哪颗，而从遥远距离对这些流浪天体进行任何形式的广泛分析都极为困难 —— 且成本高昂。与过去 人之领 的鼎盛时期相比，我们如今的资源是如此可悲的匮乏...唉，可叹啊。"

texts.en:
"Pah," Elek waves a dismissal.

"I shan't fully enumerate the errors in your statement. It is enough that there are indeed planets to be found there. Cold, dark, and alone; bereft of their parent stars, flung into the sparse wastes between the arms of our galaxy."
texts.zh:
"啧，" Elek 挥了挥手表示不屑。

"我无需详述你陈述中的错误。只需知道那里确实能找到行星就足够了。寒冷、黑暗、孤独；被剥离母恒星，抛入我们银河系旋臂之间稀疏的荒芜地带。"

texts.en:
"Indeed," He looks at you brightly. "Though I'm certain mere credits shall pale in comparison to the illumination of the unknown. Knowledge, after all, is the greatest treasure."

Elek waves a hand, "Don't misunderstand me. I may be a man whose domain is of the mind, but I appreciate that those such as yourself have baser concerns. Trust that you will be rewarded! This project is funded by an excellent patron of the sciences for whom I vouch quite entirely."
texts.zh:
"诚然如此，" 他神采奕奕地看着你，"但我确信，在照亮未知面前，区区星币将黯然失色。毕竟，知识才是最珍贵的宝藏。"

Elek 挥了挥手，"别误会。我虽然崇尚精神富足，但也理解像你这样有更基础需求的人。相信你必将会获得酬谢！这个项目由一位杰出的科学赞助人资助，我完全可以为其作担保。"

texts.en: "I, I don't know," he sputters. "I'm sure it's plenty. 20,000 credits maybe?"
texts.zh: "我，我不知道，" 他支吾道，"肯定够多的。也许 20,000 星币？"

options.en: Are you sure? Sounds low for a trip to the Fringe, much less the Abyss.
options.zh: 你确定？这点钱去边缘星区都不够，更别说深渊了。

options.en: Uh, thank you. That seems... sufficient.
options.zh: 呃，谢谢。听起来...够用了。

options.en: That sounds absurdly, even insultingly low.
options.zh: 这少得离谱，甚至有点侮辱人了。

texts.en: "It does?" Elek is taken aback. "I was sure that was enough. Maybe it was 50,000?"
texts.zh: "是吗？" Elek 愣住了，"我原以为那足够了。或许 50,000 ？"

options.en: 100,000 would be the baseline. And a large hazard fee for the Abyss.
options.zh: 100,000 是底线。深渊探索还需要额外的高额危险津贴。

options.en: Uh, thank you. That seems... sufficient.
options.zh: 呃，谢谢。听起来...够用了。

texts.en:
"Um, I'm sure, that uh," he stammers, looking annoyed.

"I'm sure my patron will cover all expenses," he declares finally. "We are, after all, dealing with Tri-"

His mouth shuts and he looks intently at you. Hoping that you didn't hear the obvious.
texts.zh:
"呃，我确信，那个，" 他结结巴巴地说，面露不悦。

"我确信我的赞助人会承担所有开销，" 他最终宣布道，"毕竟，我们是在与速 ——"

他猛然住口，一边专注地看向你，希望你没有听清那个明显的字。

texts.en:
"Um, I'm sure, that uh," he stammers, looking annoyed.

"I'm sure my patron will cover all expenses," he declares finally. "We are, after all, dealing with Tri-"

He pauses, recovering his composure. "We are, as I mentioned, dealing with a patron who can mobilize great wealth to fund the sciences."
texts.zh:
"呃，我确信，那个，" 他结结巴巴地说，面露不悦。

"我确信我的赞助人会承担所有开销，" 他最终宣布道，"毕竟，我们是在与速 ——"

他停顿片刻，随即恢复了镇定。"如我所说，我们是在与一位能为科学事业调动巨额资金的赞助人合作。"

options.en: Tri-Tachyon is backing your project?
options.zh: 速子科技 在支持你的项目？

options.en: Glad to hear it. I expect more than 100,000 credits, plus hazard.
options.zh: 很高兴听到这个消息。我希望有超过 100,000 星币的报酬，外加危险津贴。

options.en: Glad to hear it. I expect more than 100,000 credits, plus hazard.
options.zh: 很高兴听到这个消息。我希望有超过 100,000 星币的报酬，外加危险津贴。

options.en: Tri-Tachyon can afford at least 200,000 credits, plus hazard.
options.zh: 速子科技 至少能提供 200,000 星币，外加危险津贴。

options.en: I won't work for Tri-Tachyon.
options.zh: 我可不会为 速子科技 工作。

texts.en:
"I, um. Don't be absurd! I could have been starting to say any number of words."

He doesn't look confident.
texts.zh:
"我，呃。别胡扯！我可能正准备说无数个不同的词。"

他看起来毫无底气。

options.en: So it is Tri-Tachyon. They can afford at least 200,000 credits, plus hazard.
options.zh: 速子科技 至少能提供 200,000 星币，外加危险津贴。

options.en: I won't work for Tri-Tachyon.
options.zh: 我可不会为 速子科技 工作。

texts.en:
He rolls his eyes and lets out a long sigh.

"Fine, fine. I'm... sure it won't be a problem. Probably."

"That's a lot of credits." He looks at you accusingly. "It should be spent on primary research, not gilding rocket ships, but." He holds up a hand, as if to contain the outburst he presumes will come. "I will hold my tongue. If the expedition is as much of a success as I believe it will be, the dear price shall be worth it."
texts.zh:
他翻了个白眼，一边长叹一声。

"好吧，好吧。我...相信这不成问题。大概。"

"这可是很大一笔钱。" 他用责备的眼神看向你，"这笔钱本该投入基础研究，而不是装饰那些火箭舰船，但是。" 他抬起手，似乎是压制预想中的反驳，"我会持保留意见。如果此次考察能如我所料般成功，这昂贵的代价将物有所值。"

texts.en:
"Whyever not? Say what you will about business ethics, they're unmatched in their commitment to advancing unrestricted basic research. And Director Glamor-Rotanev has a particular understanding of the importance of..."

He stops, and licks his lips, seeming to realize that he's giving even more away.

"Let's agree on 200,000 credits, yes?" He looks at you accusingly. "It should be spent on primary research, not gilding rocket ships, but." He holds up a hand, as if to contain the outburst he presumes will come. "I shall hold my tongue, and so will you. If the expedition is as much of a success as I believe it will be, the dear price shall be worth it and I'm certain that... that my patron will pay."
texts.zh:
"有何不可？不论你对他们的商业道德作何评价，他们在推进无限制基础研究方面的投入都是无与伦比的。而且 Glamor-Rotanev 总监尤其深谙它的重要性..."

他停了下来，一边舔了舔嘴唇，似乎意识到自己泄露了更多信息。

"那就约定 200,000 星币，如何？" 他用责备的眼神看向你，"这笔钱本该投入基础研究，而不是装饰那些火箭舰船，但是。" 他抬起手，似乎是在压制预想中的反驳，"我会持保留意见。如果此次考察能如我所料般成功，这昂贵的代价将物有所值，而且我确信...我的赞助人会付这笔钱。"

texts.en: "Fine." He sighs, rolling his eyes. "I'm sure it'll be... no problem."
texts.zh: "行吧。" 他叹道，一边翻了个白眼，"我相信这...不成问题。"

texts.en: "Excellent!" Elek beams, apparently fully ignorant of the true cost of fleet logistics.
texts.zh: "太好了！" Elek 喜形于色，显然对舰队的实际后勤成本一无所知。

texts.en: "Excellent!" Elek beams, apparently fully ignorant of the true cost of fleet logistics.
texts.zh: "太好了！" Elek 喜形于色，显然对舰队的实际后勤成本一无所知。

texts.en: "It is?" Elek is taken aback. "I was sure that was enough. Maybe it was 50,000?"
texts.zh: "是吗？\" Elek 一怔，\"我原以为那已经够了。也许是 50,000？"

texts.en:
"Mm," he frowns, carefully maintaining a thoughtful expression.

"They have asked me not to reveal their identity. I believe, if anything, the humility they show in not taking public credit for their contributions to this great academy - and my department in particular - are a sign of dedication to pure scientific advancement. Truly, it is a noble undertaking."
texts.zh:
"嗯，" 他皱起眉头，谨慎地保持着沉思的表情。

"对方要求我不要透露其身份。我认为，恰恰相反，对方不为对这座伟大学院 —— 尤其是我所在的院系 —— 的贡献而公开邀功，这种谦逊正是献身纯粹科学进步的标志。诚然，这是一项崇高的事业。"

options.en: More noble, by far, is your willingness to take up this cause. (lie)
options.zh: 远为可贵的是你愿意承担这项使命。 (说谎)

options.en: As I am key to this expedition, I'd like to know more of your patron and my benefactor.
options.zh: 作为我是此次考察的关键人物，我也想更多了解你的赞助人 —— 也就是我的资助者。

texts.en:
"You're too kind, $playerSirOrMadam." Elek smiles, quite pleased with himself. "I believe that Director- that my patron expressed a similar sentiment."

He looks up and away, "Not that I have not had to make sacrifices. Great sacrifices, indeed. It is a lonely calling at times, but I hearten myself with the knowledge that I am enriching the..."

Despite your attempt at winning his favor, he's lost the thread and taken a whole new course. Eventually he drifts off into what looks like thoughtful silence.
texts.zh:
"你过奖了，$playerSirOrMadam。" Elek 微笑着，显然十分自得，"我想总监 —— 我的赞助人也表达过类似的看法。"

他抬眼望向远处，"我并非没有作出牺牲。实际上，我也做出了巨大的牺牲。这份使命有时很孤独，但我以 '我正在丰富...' 的认知来激励自己。"

尽管你试图赢取他的好感，但他却已经偏离主题，转向全新的话题。最终他陷入了看似深思的沉默。

texts.en:
"A not unreasonable request," Elek says, making a show of thinking over your words.

"You will, after all, be bound bodily to the project more than any other, even if you do not possess the theoretical background to fully understand its importance. I suppose it is the least I could do. After all, girding with knowing of the greater purposes you serve might enhance and embolden your spirit of exploration..."
texts.zh:
"这并非是不合理的要求，" Elek 说道，一边刻意做出正在斟酌你话语的姿态。

"毕竟，你将比其他任何人都更切身地投入这项计划，即便你缺乏充分理解其重要性的理论背景。我想这至少是我该做的。毕竟，了解你所服务的更高目标，或许能增强并激励你的探索精神..."

options.en: Nod enthusiastically as if you are entranced by his words
options.zh: 热情地点点头，仿佛自己真的被他的话语深深吸引

texts.en:
Something breaks in his expression.

"Zunya Glamor-Rotanev, the Director of Special Acquisitions for the Tri-Tachyon corporation, in fact, is the patron of my project. She is a woman of great vision, far greater than I would have expected from such a lofty position in an ostensibly profit-driven enterprise."

"By revealing this to you, captain, I am trusting in your discretion," he says with a solemn nod.
texts.zh:
他神色骤变。

"Zunya Glamor-Rotanev，速子科技的特殊采购部总监，其实是她在赞助我的项目。她是一位极具远见的女性，远超我对这样一家表面以盈利为导向的企业中居高位者的预期。"

"我把这些知道的透露给你，舰长，就是相信你会守口如瓶。" 他说道，郑重其事地点了头。

texts.en:
"Excellent. I'll have the hardware package transferred to your $shipOrFleet immediately," he taps at a datapad, connecting comms and reels off some imperious orders at some poor support staff.

"Off you go! We made the package installation idiot-proof. So I'm sure you...r technicians will be capable of installing it."
texts.zh:
"好极了。我会立即将硬件套件传输至你的$shipOrFleet，" 他点击数据平板接通通讯，并对某位可怜的后勤人员下达了一连串专横的指令。

"出发吧！我们把这套件的安装做得连新手都能操作。所以我相信你...的技术团队能胜任安装工作。"

options.en: I'm sure we'll manage.
options.zh: 我们会搞定的。

options.en: Wait, which end goes in the sensor array again?
options.zh: 等等，是哪头朝着传感器阵列来着？

texts.en:
"Good."

He turns back to his holodisplay and begins arranging moons again.

"I await your return, captain," he says over his shoulder.
texts.zh:
"很好。"

他转了回去，对着全息显示屏继续排列着那些卫星模型。

"我会在这等着你，舰长。" 他头也不回地说道。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en: You return to the academy concourse.  A junior academy agent - a different one - greets you in a landing lounge with promotional paraphernalia in hand.
texts.zh: 你回到学院港区，一名初级学院事务代理 —— 换了另一个人 —— 在一个着陆休息室迎接了你，手里拿着宣传品。

texts.en: "Greetings, captain. Perhaps you are an alumni? Have you considered donating to a scholarship trust with the Academy?"
texts.zh: "您好，舰长。也许您是本校校友？您考虑过向学院的奖学金信托捐款吗？"

texts.en: The agent smiles brightly. "Have you given some thought to setting up that scholarship fund with the Academy?"
texts.zh: 代理人笑得很灿烂。"你有没有考虑过与学院一起设立奖学金？"

texts.en:
"The attached specifications will..." Elek pauses, then squints at you.

"I see. You're engaging in a bit of jocularity. Well, I can't exactly disapprove of high spirits at the outset of the expedition provided you mind the technical details."

He turns back to his holodisplay and begins re-arranging moons. "I await your return, captain," he says over his shoulder.
texts.zh:
"附带的规格说明将..." Elek 顿了顿，随即眯起眼开始打量你。

"我明白了。你这是在开个玩笑。嗯，既然你注意技术细节，我倒也不好反对探险伊始时保持高昂的士气。"

他转了回去，对着全息显示屏继续排列着那些卫星模型。"我会在这等着你，舰长。" 他头也不回地说道。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
"Excellent, we'll start by..." He pauses, processing your words.

"What? Don't be ridiculous," Elek huffs irritably. "Take the time to think it through, captain. I'm sure reason will win out eventually."

"Or, at least, greed," he says more quietly as he turns back to his holodisplay in a huff and begins arranging moons, a clear indication that he believes the conversation is over.
texts.zh:
"好极了，我们首先要..." 他顿了顿，消化着你的话语。

"什么？别荒唐了，" Elek 烦躁地哼了一声，"花时间好好想想，舰长，我相信你的理性终将占据上风。"

"或者，至少是贪婪，" 他低声嘀咕着，气呼呼地转回全息显示屏那边开始排列卫星模型，显然认为谈话已结束。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en: "Mm? That's 'Academician Elek', if you please. And of course you haven't agreed, I haven't explained the task fully. Now where was I..."
texts.zh: "嗯？请叫我 'Elek 院士'。你当然还没同意，因为我尚未完整阐述任务内容，刚才说到哪了..."

texts.en: He either doesn't notice or doesn't acknowledge your signal.
texts.zh: 他要么没注意，要么压根没搭理你的示意。

texts.en:
"The array, it was intact? You said it was modified? So they installed it successfully."

He looks up, now, hopefully.
texts.zh:
"那个阵列，它完好无损？你说它被改装过？所以他们成功安装了。"

他现在抬起头，带着期盼的神色。

texts.en:
"The array, it was intact? You said it was modified? So they installed it successfully."

He looks up, now, hopefully.
texts.zh:
"那个阵列，它是完好无损的？你说它被改装过？所以他们成功装上去了。"

他抬起头，现在看上去充满期盼。

options.en: Yes. It worked. It gave me coordinates in the Abyss and I went there.
options.zh: 是的，它生效了。它给了我深渊中的坐标，而我前往了那里。

options.en: Yes. I think this is a good time to discuss payment.
options.zh: 是的。我认为现在是时候讨论报酬了。

options.en: Yes. And it worked. It gave me coordinates for something in the Abyss.
options.zh: 是的，而且它生效了。它给了我深渊中某物的坐标。

options.en: Yes. I think this is a good time to discuss payment.
options.zh: 是的。我认为现在是时候讨论报酬了。

texts.en:
"You... went there? The scan coordinates?" His eyes are wide.

"It was a rogue planetoid, yes? What did you find? Did you collect data? I must have it."
texts.zh:
"你...到了那里？那些扫描坐标？" 他瞪大了双眼。

"那是颗流浪小行星对吧？你找到了什么？有记录数据吗？把数据传给我。"

texts.en:
"You... went there? The scan coordinates?" His eyes are wide.

"It was a rogue planetoid, yes? What did you find? Did you collect data? I must have it. And yes, yes, I'll pay for it. But I need to know that the data is good."
texts.zh:
"你...到了那里？那些扫描坐标？" 他瞪大了双眼。

"那是颗流浪小行星对吧？你找到了什么？有记录数据吗？把数据传给我。是是是，我会给你付款的，但是让我先看眼数据"

options.en: First, I want to talk about what I found. It was... hazardous.
options.zh: 首先，我想先谈谈我的发现。它...充满了危险。

options.en: Transmitting data now...
options.zh: 现在传输数据...

options.en: Transmitting data now...
options.zh: 现在传输数据...

options.en: Let's talk about payment first. Then the data.
options.zh: 让我们先谈谈报酬，再讲数据的事。

texts.en:
Academician Elek seems to pick up on the tone in your voice.

"Yes? Very well, do elaborate." He places his hands together in a well-practiced pose of attentive contemplation, though his impatience shines through quite unambiguously.

You tell Elek about finding the sensor array, processing the data, then travelling into the Abyss. Elek nods along, fascinated enough to only interrupt occasionally to correct some pedantic detail or other.
texts.zh:
Elek 院士似乎察觉到你语气中的意味。

"是吗？很好，详细说说吧。" 他双手交握，娴熟地摆出全神贯注的姿态，尽管那不耐烦的情绪已经明确流露。

你向 Elek 讲述了发现传感器阵列、处理数据，然后深入深渊的经历。Elek 频频点头，听得十分入迷，只偶尔打断你以纠正某些繁琐的细节。

options.en: Tell him about the Onslaught Mk.I
options.zh: 告诉他关于 攻势 Mk.I 的事情

texts.en:
He goes quiet when you get to the Onslaught Mk.I - and begins shaking his head as you describe the Threat.

"No, this is terribly unlikely," he says. "The imaginings of some absurd holo-novel. Which of my students put you up to this jape?"
texts.zh:
当你提及 攻势 Mk.I 时，他陷入了沉默 —— 而当你描述威胁时，他开始摇头。

"不，这太难以置信了，" 他说道，"这简直是某部荒唐全息小说的幻想。是我的哪个学生怂恿你开这种玩笑的？"

options.en: My combat recordings and sensor data prove it. Transmitting now.
options.zh: 我的战斗记录与传感器数据可以作证，我现在就进行传输。

options.en: My combat recordings and sensor data prove it. I'll transmit after payment.
options.zh: 我的战斗记录与传感器数据可以作证，而有了报酬后我自然会进行传输。

texts.en: "Excellent," says Elek, confirming the transmission request with a tap. "Tell me, what did you find? What's behind all the excitement 200 cycles ago?"
texts.zh: "好极了，" Elek 说道，一边点击屏幕确认传输请求，"告诉我，你发现了什么？两百多个星历年前的那阵骚动究竟是怎么回事？"

texts.en: Elek turns his attention to the datapad. "It's coming through," he says, confirming the transmission request with a tap.
texts.zh: Elek 将注意力转向他的数据平板。"正在接收，" 他说道，一边点击屏幕确认传输请求。

texts.en: Elek turns his attention to his datapad. "It's coming through," he says, confirming the transmission request with a tap.
texts.zh: Elek 将注意力转向他的数据平板。"正在接收，" 他说道，一边点击屏幕确认传输请求。

options.en: Tell him about the Onslaught Mk.I and the Threat
options.zh: 告诉他关于 攻势 Mk.I 和威胁的事情

options.en: Now, about hazard pay.
options.zh: 现在，谈谈危险津贴吧。

options.en: Now, about payment.
options.zh: 现在，谈谈报酬吧。

options.en: Have a look. There's your proof.
options.zh: 看看吧，这就是你要的证据。

texts.en: You tell Elek about finding the sensor array, processing the data, then travelling into the Abyss. Elek nods along, fascinated enough to only interrupt occasionally about some phenomenon or other.
texts.zh: 你向 Elek 讲述了发现传感器阵列、处理数据，然后深入深渊的经历。Elek 频频点头，听得十分入迷，只偶尔打断你，问些关于某个现象的问题。

texts.en: You tell Elek about travelling into the Abyss to the coordinates, to the rogue planet. Elek nods along, fascinated enough to only interrupt occasionally about some phenomenon or other.
texts.zh: 你向 Elek 讲述了深入深渊前往坐标点，并抵达那颗流浪行星的经历。Elek 频频点头，听得十分入迷，只偶尔打断你以纠正某些繁琐的细节。

texts.en: He goes quiet when you get to the Onslaught Mk.I - and begins shaking his head as you describe the Threat.
texts.zh: 当你提及 攻势 Mk.I 时，他陷入了沉默 —— 而当你描述威胁时，他开始摇头。

texts.en: "No, this is terribly unlikely," he says. "The imaginings of some absurd holo-novel. Which of my students put you up to this jape?"
texts.zh: "不，这太难以置信了，" 他说道，"这简直是某部荒唐全息小说的幻想。是我的哪个学生怂恿你开这种玩笑的？"

texts.en: Elek gives an amused huff, as if at a student giving an excuse for not completing coursework by his deadline.
texts.zh: Elek 发出忍俊不禁的鼻息，仿佛在听学生为未按时完成课业而找借口。

texts.en: "I, I don't see how this can be," he says. "It's like the imaginings of some absurd holo-novel. If, if it were true, my patron... the provost, Hegemony COMSEC..."
texts.zh: "我，我不明白这怎么可能，" 他说道，"这简直像某部荒唐全息小说的幻想一样。如果，如果是真的，我的赞助人...院长，霸主 的 COMSEC..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Elek begins shuffling through your data, accessing his larger holodisplay with his datapad. Images, charts, holoclips start appearing around him. You watch his face turn from exasperated skepticism to simply fearful.

He slaps his datapad, and the holos disappear.

He turns to you, struggling to maintain his composure. "Th-thank you captain, for-"
texts.zh:
Elek 开始用数据平板打开他那块更大的全息显示屏来查看你的数据。图像，图表和全息影像开始在他周围浮现。你看着他的表情从夹杂着恼怒的怀疑转变为完全的恐惧。

他猛地拍了一下数据平板，全息影像消失了。

他转向你，努力保持镇定。"谢 —— 谢谢你舰长，对 ——"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He touches his forehead. "Your hazard pay!"

Elek remembered. He must be truly out of sorts.
texts.zh:
他拍了拍额头。"你的危险津贴！"

Elek 想起来了，他肯定不太舒服。

texts.en: He touches his forehead. "Your hazard pay!"
texts.zh: 他拍了拍额头。"你的危险津贴！"

texts.en: He touches his forehead. "Your payment!"
texts.zh: 他拍了拍额头。"你的报酬！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: That won't be necessary. I'm satisfied with my profits.
options.zh: 那就不必了，我对自己的报酬很满意。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: That won't be necessary. I'm satisfied with my profits.
options.zh: 那就不必了，我对自己的报酬很满意。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: That won't be necessary. Knowledge is it's own reward.
options.zh: 那就不必了，知识本身就是回报。

texts.en:
He lets out an upset noise, but no objection as he taps again at his datapad, hands shaking. He has to perform the command twice before getting it right.

"Yes... there. Good-day, captain. Please keep this... I'll take care of everything."
texts.zh:
他发出沮丧的声响，但并未反驳，只是颤抖着再次点击数据平板。他不得不重复操作了两次才成功执行了命令。

"是的...好了。日安，舰长。请保密此事...我会处理一切。"

texts.en:
He lets out an upset noise, but no objection as he taps again at his datapad, hands shaking. He has to perform the command twice before getting it right.

"Yes... there. Now. Tell me about your discovery. I've certainly paid dearly for it."
texts.zh:
他发出沮丧的声响，但并未反驳，只是颤抖着再次点击数据平板。他不得不重复操作了两次才成功执行了命令。

"是的...好了。现在，告诉我你的发现。我已经为此付出了高昂的代价。"

texts.en:
He looks sick, the affect of the confident academic completely shot.

Perhaps there is some knowledge that the academician would have been happier to have never learned.

Elek cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
他面如死灰，昔日的自信学者风范荡然全无。

或许有些知识，是这位院士宁愿自己永远都不去揭晓的。

Elek 切断了通讯。

texts.en:
He looks sick, the affect of the confident academic completely shot. Elek sits down at his desk to stare at his blank datapad.

Ignoring you.
texts.zh:
他面如死灰，昔日的自信学者风范荡然全无。Elek 坐在桌前，死死盯着空白的数据平板。

他全然忽略了你。

options.en: Tell him about what you found
options.zh: 告诉他你发现了什么

options.en: Cut the commlink
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en: "If..." He gives you an odd look. "If you say so."
texts.zh: "如果..." 他用异样的眼神看着你，"如果你这么说的话。"

texts.en:
"I... I suppose it is."

Elek briefly attempts a sad smile before giving up.
texts.zh:
"我...我想是这样的"

Elek 短暂地苦笑一声，放弃了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: With trembling hand, he taps at his datapad. He looks relieved when the payment confirms - your TriPad gives a corresponding satisfied chirp.
texts.zh: 他用颤抖的手敲着数据平板，在付款完成后明显松了一口气 —— 你的 TriPad 发出了满意的蜂鸣。

texts.en: "There. We can put this all... behind us. I'll handle it. My patron... it's going to be fine." He manages a sickly smile.
texts.zh: "好了，我们可以把这一切都...放一边了，我会处理的。还有我的赞助人...一切都没问题。" 他勉强挤出一个笑容。

options.en: That's good, thank you.
options.zh: 很好，谢谢。

options.en: ... And the hazard pay.
options.zh: ...那么危险津贴的事。

texts.en: He gives you an unconvinced look. "I'm not angry, I'm... disappointed," he says.
texts.zh: 他向你投来不以为然的目光。"我并没有生气，只是...感到失望，" 他说道。

texts.en:
Elek gives an amused huff, as if at a student giving an excuse for not completing coursework by his deadline.

"I'm not angry," he says. "I'm disappointed."
texts.zh:
Elek 发出忍俊不禁的鼻息，仿佛在听学生为未按时完成课业而找借口。

"我并没有生气，" 他说道，"只感到失望。"

texts.en:
"I'm not angry," he says. "I'm disappointed. That's your story? I'd need some very good data indeed if I am to believe a word of it."

He taps his datapad, opening a stream for you, then fixes you with a skeptical glare.

"I say, $playerSirOrMadam - prove yourself."
texts.zh:
"我并没有生气，"他说道，"只是感到失望。这就是你的说辞？除非有非常确凿的数据，不然我可不会相信其中的任何一个字。"

他点了点数据平板，为你开放了数据流，随即投来怀疑的目光。

"我说，$playerSirOrMadam —— 自己证明吧。"

options.en: Just look at the data.
options.zh: 看看数据就知道了。

options.en: Just look at the data.
options.zh: 看看数据就知道了。

options.en: Transfer the data
options.zh: 传输数据

texts.en:
Elek gives you a skeptical glare then begins shuffling through your data, accessing his larger holodisplay with his datapad. Images, charts, holoclips start appearing around him.

The Onslaught Mk.I, salvors exploring its bizarre corridors. The sensor modifications, 'Threat Detected'. The words burned into your memory.

He stares for a long moment with an unsure expression.

Then he quite consciously resettles his composure, and speaks. "Tired, sophomoric japery. Nothing more."
texts.zh:
Elek 开始用数据平板打开他那块更大的全息显示屏来查看你的数据。图像，图表和全息影像开始在他周围浮现。

攻势 Mk.I，打捞员探索其怪异通道的过程。传感器改装记录，'侦测到威胁'。这些词语烙刻在你的记忆中。

他带着不确定的表情凝视了良久。

随后他刻意地重整了仪态，再开口道，"乏味的、稚气的恶作剧。仅此而已。"

options.en: Look at my $shipOrFleet. The Onslaught Mk.I is in orbit.
options.zh: 看看我的$shipOrFleet，攻势 Mk.I 就在轨道上。

options.en: I've been entirely honest with you, Elek.
options.zh: 我一直对你完全坦诚，Elek。

texts.en:
He says nothing, motionless for several seconds, then taps at his datapad. His expression is grim as he sets his datapad deliberately onto his desk. Is it your imagination, or are his hands trembling?

"A holofeed hack, nothing more," he insists. "It's trivial to fake, with resources and, and t-time. It's nothing at all."

"I'm... we're done here, captain." Elek's eyes wander around his office, as if searching for escape. "G-good day, $playerSirOrMadam."
texts.zh:
他一言不发，沉默了几秒，然后敲了敲数据平板，面色凝重且动作僵硬地把它放在桌上。似乎是你眼花了，他的手居然在颤抖。

"伪造的全息影像，仅此而已。" 他坚持道，"只要有足够的资源和...和时...时间，想伪造这种东西轻而易举。没什么大不了的。"

"我...我们到此为止吧，舰长。" Elek 的目光在办公室里四处游移，仿佛在寻找逃离的出口。"再...再见，$playerSirOrMadam。"

texts.en: He catches you with a desperate look before hitting the cut-off.
texts.zh: 他在切断通讯前，向你投来了绝望的一瞥。

texts.en:
Elek firmly invites you to leave, his voice breaking with a barely-contained desperation. He falls into the chair behind his desk and stares at his blank datapad.

Ignoring you.
texts.zh:
Elek 顽固地请你离开，声音里带着难以掩盖的绝望。他颓然地跌坐在办公桌后的椅子上，死死盯着空白的数据平板。

他全然忽略了你。

options.en: Hold on- we're not done 'til I get paid.
options.zh: 等等 —— 在我拿到报酬前就别想结束。

options.en: I will forgo payment. Advancement of knowledge is wealth enough.
options.zh: 我放弃报酬，知识的进步已是足够丰厚的财富。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
"Oh!" From his surprise, you'd swear he hadn't even thought of paying you.

"I... yes. Good. We can put this all... behind us. My patron... it's going to be fine." Elek manages a sickly smile.
texts.zh:
"哦！" 看那惊讶的神情，他肯定根本没想过要付钱给你。

"我... 好的，很好，我们可以把这一切都... 抛在脑后了。指使我的人... 一切都没问题。" Elek 勉强挤出一个笑容。

texts.en:
"Will you be so 'honest' with COMSEC when they come smashing down your airlock? Will you?" His eyes are fiery.

He holds the fierce look for just a moment longer, then visibly deflates. "It'll be... fine. My patron... it was all fakery, of course. A misunderstanding..."

"I'll... we're done here, captain." Elek's eyes wander around his office, as if searching for escape. "G-good day, $playerSirOrMadam."
texts.zh:
"等 COMSEC 的人冲进你的气闸舱，你还会这么 '坦诚' 吗？你会吗？" 他的眼睛似要喷出火来。

他维持着那凶狠的表情片刻，然后明显地泄了气。"没事的...指使我的人...这一切当然都是假的，一场误会..."

"那么...到此为止吧，舰长。" Elek 的目光在办公室里四处游移，就像是要伺机逃跑。"再见，$playerSirOrMadam。"

texts.en: "Yes, yes, of course. Credits, always about the..." he mutters to himself as he taps and swipes at his datapad.
texts.zh: "是，是，当然。星币，总是离不开..." 他一边低声自语着，一边敲击滑动着他的数据平板。

texts.en:
"Here we are," he says, raising his eyebrows at you. "What I would have paid the other freelancer I hired had they returned. And promptly surrendered the research data that would be useless to anyone but me."

Your TriPad pings softly as Elek gives you a cold look.
texts.zh:
"发给你了，" 他说道，一边朝你扬起眉毛。"这是本应付给我雇佣的另一位自由佣兵的酬劳 —— 如果他能返回，并即刻交出那对除我之外的任何人都无用的研究数据的话。"

你的 TriPad 轻响了一声，而 Elek 也向你投来了冰冷的一瞥。

texts.en:
"Here we are. The payment."

Your TriPad pings softly.
texts.zh:
"发给你了。报酬。"

你的 TriPad 轻响了一声。

texts.en:
"Here we are," he says, raising his eyebrows at you.

Your TriPad pings softly.
texts.zh:
"发给你了，" 他说道，一边朝你扬起眉毛。

你的 TriPad 轻响了一声。

texts.en:
He lets out a breath, then meets your eyes. "A princely sum. I hope the value of your data will be its equal."

His finger hovers over the confirmation for a full second before he presses it down. Your TriPad pings softly to itself.
texts.zh:
他呼出一口气，随后迎上你的目光，"一笔巨款，但愿你的数据价值相当。"

他的手指在确认键上悬停了足足一秒，才终于按下。你的 TriPad 随即轻响了一声。

texts.en:
He sighs melodramatically, then his eyes meet yours, "This had better be worth it."

His finger hovers over the confirmation for two full seconds before he presses it. Your TriPad pings softly as if it were rather pleased with itself.
texts.zh:
他夸张地叹了口气，随后迎上你的目光，"这最好物有所值。"

他的手指在确认键上悬停了整整两秒，才终于按下。你的 TriPad 随即自得般地轻响了一声。

texts.en:
"Here we are," he says, raising his eyebrows at you. "What I would have paid the other freelancer I hired had they returned. And promptly surrendered the research data that would be useless to anyone but me."

Your TriPad pings softly as Elek gives you a cold look.
texts.zh:
"发给你了，" 他说道，一边朝你扬起眉毛。"这是本应付给我雇佣的另一位自由佣兵的酬劳 —— 如果他能返回，并即刻交出那对除我之外的任何人都无用的研究数据的话。"

你的 TriPad 轻响了一声，而 Elek 也向你投来了冰冷的一瞥。

options.zh: 好，现在传输数据。

options.zh: 外加 25% 的危险津贴。

options.zh: 告诉他关于 攻势 Mk.I 和威胁的事情

options.en: Well? What do you think of the data?
options.zh: 那么？你觉得这数据如何？

texts.en:
"What?" He looks appalled. "Stars above, you spacers... we'll discuss it after I review the data you collected. It is only logical to establish the degree of hazard before I make some potentially spurious additional payment."

"Speaking of precisely that," he taps his datapad impatiently.
texts.zh:
"什么？" 他震惊不已，"群星在上，你们这些太空佬...等我查阅完你收集的数据再讨论。在作出可能不当的额外支付前，先评估危险程度才是合乎逻辑的。"

"说到这个，" 他不耐烦地敲击着数据平板。

texts.en:
"What?" He looks surprised. "Stars above, you spacers... we'll discuss it after I review the data you collected. It is only logical to establish the degree of hazard before I make some potentially spurious additional payment."

"Speaking of precisely that," he taps his datapad impatiently.
texts.zh:
"什么？" 他面露诧异，"群星在上，你们这些太空佬...等我查阅完你收集的数据再讨论。在作出可能不当的额外支付前，先评估危险程度才是合乎逻辑的。"

"说到这个，" 他不耐烦地敲击着数据平板。

options.zh: 告诉他关于 攻势 Mk.I 的事情

texts.en:
"What?" He lets out an impatient huff.

"For your nonsense story? I'll need to examine the data itself before I believe a word of it."

He taps his datapad, opening a stream for you, then fixes you with a skeptical glare.

"I say, $playerSirOrMadam - prove it."
texts.zh:
"什么？" 他发出不耐烦的鼻音。

"就凭你这通胡言乱语？我得先检查数据本身，才会相信其中的任何一个字。"

他点了点数据平板，为你开放了数据流，随即投来怀疑的目光。

"我说，$playerSirOrMadam —— 证明给我看。"

options.en: Transmit the data
options.zh: 传输数据

texts.en: "Excellent," says Elek, confirming the transmission request with a tap. "Tell me, what did you find? What's behind all the excitement 200 cycles ago?"
texts.zh: "好极了，" Elek 说道，一边点击屏幕确认传输请求，"告诉我，你发现了什么？两百多个星历年前的那阵骚动究竟是怎么回事？"

texts.en: "What?" He lets out an impatient huff. "I already paid you for recovering the data from the sensor array."
texts.zh: "什么？" 他发出不耐烦的鼻音。，我已经付过钱让你恢复传感器阵列的数据了。"

texts.en: He lets out an impatient huff.
texts.zh: 他不耐烦地哼了一声。

options.en: Then I went to the Abyss. I'm due hazard pay.
options.zh: 然后我就去了深渊，我应该得到危险津贴。

options.en: You're right, we made no additional agreement.
options.zh: 你说得对，我们没有约定额外的报酬。

texts.en: Elek raises his eyebrows and gives you a skeptical look.
texts.zh: Elek 挑起眉毛，带着几分怀疑看着你。

options.en: First, I want to talk about what I found. It was... hazardous.
options.zh: 首先，我想先谈谈我的发现。它...充满了危险。

options.en: Transmitting data now...
options.zh: 现在传输数据...

options.en: Let's talk about payment first. Then the data.
options.zh: 让我们先谈谈报酬，再讲数据的事。

texts.en:
Academician Elek seems to pick up on the tone in your voice, for once.

"Yes? Very well, do elaborate." He places his hands together in a well-practiced pose of attentive contemplation.
texts.zh:
目前首次，Elek 院士似乎察觉到你语气中的意味。

"是吗？很好，详细说说吧。" 他双手交握，娴熟地摆出全神贯注的姿态，尽管那不耐烦的情绪已经明确流露。

texts.en: You tell Elek about finding the sensor array, processing the data, then travelling into the Abyss. Elek nods along, fascinated enough to only interrupt occasionally to correct some pedantic detail or other.
texts.zh: 你向 Elek 讲述了发现传感器阵列、处理数据，然后深入深渊的经历。Elek 频频点头，听得十分入迷，只偶尔打断你以纠正某些繁琐的细节。

texts.en: You tell Elek about travelling into the Abyss to the coordinates, to the rogue planet. Elek nods along, fascinated enough to only interrupt occasionally about some phenomenon or other.
texts.zh: 你向 Elek 讲述了深入深渊前往坐标点，并抵达那颗流浪行星的经历。Elek 频频点头，听得十分入迷，只偶尔打断你以纠正某些繁琐的细节。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He goes quiet when you get to the Onslaught Mk.I - and begins shaking his head as you describe the Threat.

"No, this is terribly unlikely," he says. "The imaginings of some absurd holo-novel. Which of my students put you up to this jape?"
texts.zh:
当你提及 攻势 Mk.I 时，他陷入了沉默 —— 而当你描述 威胁 时，他开始摇头。

"不，这太难以置信了，" 他说道，"这简直是某部荒唐全息小说的幻想。是我的哪个学生怂恿你开这种玩笑的？"

options.en: My combat recordings and sensor data prove it. Transmitting now.
options.zh: 我的战斗记录与传感器数据可以作证，我现在就进行传输。

options.en: My combat recordings and sensor data prove it. I'll transmit after payment.
options.zh: 我的战斗记录与传感器数据可以作证，而有了报酬后我自然会进行传输。

texts.en:
"Payment?" He looks as irate as he does bewildered.

"I didn't hire you, $playerSirOrMadam. You were telling me about my discovery!"
texts.zh:
"报酬？" 他看起来既愤怒又困惑。

"我可没有雇佣你，$playerSirOrMadam，你刚才在向我汇报的是我的发现！"

options.en: Right. It worked, gave me coordinates in the Abyss, and I went there.
options.zh: 没错。它生效了，并给了我深渊中的坐标，而我则前往了那里。

options.en: Fine. We can talk about MY discovery first. Then payment.
options.zh: 好吧。我们可以先谈谈 '我 的' 发现，然后再说报酬。

options.en: It's MY discovery. And we'll talk about payment if you want any part in it.
options.zh: 这是 '我 的' 发现。如果你想参与其中，我们就谈谈报酬。

texts.en:
Elek narrows his eyes. "You presume much, $playerSirOrMadam."

"But if the data is as valuable as I expect - to science, that is..." He gives you a skeptical look, then taps at his datapad, opening a datalink.

"Prove it."
texts.zh:
Elek 眯起眼睛。"你假定得太多了，$playerSirOrMadam。"

"但如果那些数据确实如我所料那般有价值 —— 对科学而言..." 他投来怀疑的目光，随即点击数据平板，并开启了一道数据链接。

"证明给我看。"

options.en: Transfer the data
options.zh: 传输数据

texts.en:
"You're a heartless mercenary with no appreciation for science," Elek says, his tone growing heated.

"You'd never have found... whatever you found... without me!" He seems to realize in the moment how weak this sounds, and recomposes himself.

"This is practically piracy, you know."
texts.zh:
"你就是个没心没肺的雇佣兵，对科学毫无敬意，" Elek 说道，语气渐趋激烈。

"没有我，你根本找不到...不管你找到了什么！" 他似乎瞬间意识到这说辞是多么无力，随即重整了神态。

"你这简直是海盗行径，明白吗。"

options.en: No, this is business. And I took on great risk to see it done.
options.zh: 不，这是正经的生意，而我也是承担了巨大风险才完成任务。

options.en: Yes, it is. And if you don't pay me, you'll never get your precious data.
options.zh: 没错。如果你不支付报酬，就永远别想得到你那宝贵的数据。

texts.en:
Academician Cornelius Elek forms a tight, unkind smile.

"I see you are an unyielding negotiator, $playerSirOrMadam. I bow to the inescapable logic of your proposal."

With trembling hand, he taps at his datapad.

"I shall pay you 50,000 credits for the data. It is the amount I promised the freelancer who installed the modifications and... failed to return."
texts.zh:
Cornelius Elek 院士露出一个紧绷而冷漠的微笑。

"我看出你是个不屈不挠的谈判者了，$playerSirOrMadam，我屈服于你提案中无可辩驳的逻辑。"

他用颤抖的手点了点数据平板。

"我将为数据向你支付 50,000 星币。这是我承诺给那位安装改装件却...未能返回的自由佣兵的酬劳。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: That's a failure's rate. I DID return, and from the Abyss. 100k.
options.zh: 那是失败者的价码。我回来了，而且是从深渊回来。我要 100,000。

texts.en:
"Here we are," he says, raising his eyebrows at you.

Your TriPad pings softly.
texts.zh:
"成交，" 他说道，一边朝你扬起眉毛。

你的 TriPad 轻响了一声。

options.en: Correct. Transferring data now.
options.zh: 好，现在传输数据。

options.en: Plus 25% for hazard.
options.zh: 外加 25% 的危险津贴。

texts.en:
"A heartless mercenary," he says coldly. "I stand by my words. But if you truly have found what you claim... it is the dictate of logic."

His fingers strike the device somewhat harder than necessary.
texts.zh:
"没心没肺的佣兵，" 他冷冷地说道，"我坚持我的判断，但如果你真的找到了你声称的东西...这是逻辑的必然。"

他的手指在设备上敲击得略显用力。

options.en: Correct. Transferring data now.
options.zh: 好，现在传输数据。

options.en: Plus 25% for hazard.
options.zh: 外加 25% 的危险津贴。

texts.en:
"What? Stars above, you spacers! I give a centimeter and you try to take a parsec!"

"We'll..." His tone softens as he seems to recall your threat.

"We'll discuss it after I review the data. It is only logical to establish the degree of hazard before I make a potentially spurious additional payment."

"Speaking of which," he taps his datapad impatiently.
texts.zh:
"什么？群星在上，你们这些太空佬！我让一厘米，你们就想占一光年！"

"嗯..." 他似乎想起了你的威胁，语气缓和下来。

"等我重新看一遍数据再说。在支付可能是冤枉的额外一笔钱之前，我有理由确认风险。"

"说起这个，" 他不耐烦地敲了敲数据平板。

options.en: Transfer the data
options.zh: 传输数据

texts.en:
He takes a deep breath and looks at you for a long time. He begins, but does not speak as he thinks better of it once, twice. You can see the anger in his eyes.

But you hold the data.

How many cycles of his academic career has he invested already? How many more will he get out of these results? He is a man of science, of reason. And of pride. But can he set it aside for a few minutes?
texts.zh:
他深吸一口气，一边长久地凝视着你。反复两次，他都欲言又止。你能看见他眼中的怒火。

但数据在你手里。

他已经为自己的学术生涯投入多少个星历年？这些成果又能支撑他走多远？他是个崇尚科学与理性的人，也是个自负的人。但他能否为此暂时放下尊严片刻？

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Indeed it would," he says. "For that's where it was looking when it picked up something unusual a little over 200 cycles ago."

"Would you be so good as to transfer the data you collected? It is very valuable." He picks up his datapad and taps at it, then looks at you pointedly. "Um. Valuable to science, that is. Abstract knowledge, not much use to the likes of... to freelancers like yourself, I should say."
texts.zh:
"确实如此，" 他说道，"因为在大约 200 多个星历年前，它正是在那里探测到了异常现象。"

"能否请你传输收集到的数据？这非常宝贵。" 他拿起数据平板并点击了几下，然后意味深长地看着你。"呃。准确来说，对科学很宝贵。抽象的知识，对你这样的...自由佣兵来说没什么用处，我是说。"

options.en: Transfer the data recovered from the sensor array
options.zh: 传输从传感器阵列中恢复的数据

options.en: Valuable, you say? Yes, we should discuss payment.
options.zh: 你是说很宝贵？很好，我们该谈谈报酬了。

texts.en:
"Yes, good. It's working!" Elek watches the progress on his datapad with greedy anticipation.

"...Finally, my data."
texts.zh:
"好，很好！在运行了！" Elek 盯着数据平板上的进度，眼中充满贪婪的期待。

"...终于，我的数据。"

texts.en:
"Yes, good. It's working!" Elek watches the progress on his datapad with greedy anticipation.

"...Finally, my data."
texts.zh:
"好，很好！在运行了！" Elek 盯着数据平板上的进度，眼中充满贪婪的期待。

"...终于，我的数据。"

options.en: What is it? What were you looking for?
options.zh: 这是什么？你究竟在找什么？

options.en: Now the payment, please.
options.zh: 现在请谈谈报酬。

texts.en:
"Ah," he tears his eyes from the datapad.

"It's a mystery surrounding a very old dataset which has been in the Galatia Academy archives for a very long time. I stumbled upon it in the course of my studies - I was discussing the breadth of the archives with... a friend, a wealthy patron of the sciences, in fact. A comment they made reminded me of this half-corrupted enigma..."

Elek has transitioned fully into lecturing mode. He cradles his hands, occasionally pointing at abstract concepts or or waving them when hitting a particularly important detail.
texts.zh:
"啊，" 他将目光从数据平板上移开。

"这是一个围绕着一份非常古老数据集的谜团，它已在 Galatia 学院档案馆尘封许久。我在研究过程中偶然发现 —— 当时我正与...一位朋友，事实上是一位科学事业的慷慨赞助人，讨论档案馆的广度。他们的一句评论让我想起这个半损坏的谜题..."

Elek 已完全进入了授课模式。他双手交握，时而指点抽象的概念，或在提及关键细节时挥手强调。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"...And that dataset consisted of telemetry from a Domain-era sensor array out on what we now call the Fringe. It was somewhat more civilized back when the data was captured, though not perhaps by much."

Elek chuckles softly at his wit.

"As for the data, only the sourcing header is intact. Our copy is mostly corrupted due to anomalous  degradation during hyperwave transmission followed by 200 cycles of low-priority storage."
texts.zh:
"...而那个数据集包含了来自 人之领 时代传感器阵列的遥测数据，那个阵列正位于我们现在称为边缘星区的区域。在它进行数据采集时那片区域或许文明程度稍高些，但也未必好多少。"

Elek 为自己的幽默得意一笑。

"至于数据本身，只有来源标头保存完整。我们的副本大多已经损坏，原因在于超波传输过程中的异常衰减，以及随后长达 200 个星历年的低优先级存储。"

texts.en: "But your copy," he smiles, "is complete! Um," he taps at his datapad for a moment. "Mostly, anyway. Significantly more than the old one. This is a fabulous find!"
texts.zh: "但你的副本，" 他微笑道，"是完整的！呃，" 他在数据平板上点击片刻，"至少大部分是。总之远比旧版本完整，这真是惊人的发现！"

texts.en:
"But if I'm right," he smiles, "your copy of the data is uncorrupted! Um, theoretically, anyway." He taps at his datapad for a moment, opening a datastream.

"If you would be so kind?"
texts.zh:
"但如果我的推测正确，" 他微笑道，"你的数据副本应该是完好的！呃，至少在理论上是这样。" 他在数据平板上点击片刻，开启了数据传输流。

"方便传输吗？"

options.en: So what is at those coordinates in the Abyss?
options.zh: 那么深渊中的坐标处究竟有什么？

options.en: So about payment...
options.zh: 所以关于报酬...

options.en: Transfer the data
options.zh: 传输数据

texts.en:
"Well." He pauses to make a thoughtful expression.

"That's a complex question to answer. The data," he manipulates his datapad, pulling up charts and diagrams in his large holodisplay, "It provides the opportunity for many interpretations, often contradictory..."

He proceeds like this with little sign of stopping. It's soon clear to you that he doesn't know.
texts.zh:
"这个。" 他停顿作思考状。

"这是个复杂的议题。这份数据，" 他操作着数据平板，在大尺寸全息屏上调出图表，"提供了多种往往相互矛盾的解读方向..."

他如此滔滔不绝，毫无停止迹象。你很快意识到：他其实并不知道答案。

options.en: My people say it's pointing at a rock in the Abyss. Something happened there.
options.zh: 我的人说它指向深渊中的一颗岩质星球。那里发生过什么。

texts.en:
"-Yes, of course." You see a flash of annoyance as his lecture is interrupted, but Elek manages to adjust to a new line of discourse.

"A rogue planet, a singular celestial body bereft of a stellar primary - or any other, for that matter. Cold, dark, and alone; bereft of parent star, flung into the sparse wastes between the arms of our galaxy."

"There are many such bodies although, unfortunately, we only rarely have the opportunity to study them closely these days..."

He begins speaking at length on the study of rogue planets.
texts.zh:
"—— 是的，当然。" 你看到他因讲演被打断而闪过一丝恼怒，但 Elek 成功调整了话题方向。

"一颗流浪行星，一个缺乏主恒星的孤立天体 —— 事实上也没有其他伴星。寒冷、黑暗、孤独；没有母恒星，被抛入银河系旋臂之间稀疏的荒芜地带。"

"这类天体数量众多，遗憾的是，如今我们鲜有机会进行深入研究..."

他开始长篇大论地阐述流浪行星的研究。

options.en: If you don't know what, then why? Why this array data? Why these coordinates?
options.zh: 如果你不知道是什么，那为什么？为什么是这些阵列数据？为什么是这些坐标？

texts.en:
"I didn't say I- it's a, presumably, unexplored-" Elek is caught off-balance again. "The point is..."

He sighs, surrendering a small battle.

"It was... my friend, the patron of the sciences. Given their, ah, extreme wealth and interest in acting as a sponsor of pure discovery, they had the notion to fund an expedition to solve my little mystery. I thought it was a capital notion! All was arranged. Then, of course... and you found... well."

He goes quiet, finally.
texts.zh:
"我没说我 —— 那是，推测为，未经勘探的 ——" Elek 再次措手不及，"重点是..."

他叹了口气，在这场小交锋中缴械投降。

"是...我的朋友，那位科学赞助人。鉴于对方，呃，极度的财富，且热衷于资助纯粹的探索，对方提议资助一支科考队来解决我的小谜团。我认为这主意棒极了！一切准备就绪。然后，当然...而你发现了...呃。"

他终于陷入了沉默。

options.en: Who is your patron? If they're so wealthy, I'm sure I've heard of them.
options.zh: 你的赞助人是谁？既然那个人那么富有，我肯定听说过。

options.en: Are you sure your patron is only interested in pure discovery?
options.zh: 你确定你的赞助人只对纯粹的科学发现感兴趣吗？

texts.en:
"Mm," he frowns, carefully recomposing an expression of lofty erudition.

"They have asked me not to reveal their identity. I believe, if anything, the humility they show in not taking public credit for their contributions to this great academy - and my department in particular - are a sign of dedication to pure scientific advancement. Truly, it is a noble undertaking."
texts.zh:
"嗯，" 他皱起眉头，精心重塑着高深莫测的学者表情。

"对方要求我不要透露其身份。我认为，恰恰相反，对方不为对这座伟大学院 —— 尤其是我所在的院系 —— 的贡献而公开邀功，这种谦逊正是献身纯粹科学进步的标志。诚然，这是一项崇高的事业。"

texts.en:
"Mm," he frowns, carefully maintaining a thoughtful expression.

"They have asked me not to reveal their identity. I believe, if anything, the humility they show in not taking public credit for their contributions to this great academy - and my department in particular - are a sign of dedication to pure scientific advancement. Truly, it is a noble undertaking."

He lets only a moment pass. "Not unlike your own refusal to accept payment - a brave, unexpected act."
texts.zh:
"嗯，" 他皱起眉头，谨慎地保持着沉思的表情。

"对方要求我不要透露其身份。我认为，恰恰相反，对方不为对这座伟大学院 —— 尤其是我所在的院系 —— 的贡献而公开邀功，这种谦逊正是献身纯粹科学进步的标志。诚然，这是一项崇高的事业。"

他只停顿了片刻。"就像你拒绝接受报酬一样 —— 一个勇敢而出人意料的举动。"

options.en: Are you sure you can't tell me?
options.zh: 你确定你不能告诉我吗？

options.en: I feel they are a kindred spirit. Indeed, are not we three all?
options.zh: 我觉得他们与我志趣相投。实际上，我们三者不都是如此吗？

texts.en: "Alas." He shakes his head, "It would be unthinkable."
texts.zh: "可惜。" 他摇头道，"这是无法想象的。"

texts.en:
"Regardless," he sweeps his arm, "You have the opportunity of a lifetime before you - with your capabilities, you can travel to those coordinates deep in the Abyss and discover its secrets."

"Just... bring me back a record of what you find." Elek's eyes are fixed on you now, greedily.

"Recordings, telemetry, deep scans. A series of high-energy events happened there over 200 cycles ago, and these sort of phenomena simply don't occur on their own on these lone planetoids."
texts.zh:
"无论如何，" 他挥舞着手臂，"你面前摆着千载难逢的机遇。以你的能力，可以前往深渊深处的坐标，揭开它的秘密。"

"只要...把你发现的记录带回来给我。" Elek 眼睛在此刻凝视着你，目光贪婪。

"录音、遥测数据、深度扫描。200 多个星历年前那里发生了一系列高能事件，而这类现象绝不会在孤立的行星体上凭空发生。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
His gaze wanders off toward abstraction.

"Spontaneous eruption of a hyperspace dark-matter agglomeration upon interaction with a gravity well at sufficient velocity? A simple collision between celestial bodies? It would be an astoundingly rare event - one in a billion cycles..."

Academician Elek begins to lose himself in hypothetical scenarios, mapping them into his holodisplay and comparing simulated interactions with the dataset you provided.

His vision is bound to the walls of his ivory torus - while yours may soon look upon that which lies at the heart of this mystery, in the darkness beyond the dark.
texts.zh:
他的目光游离至抽象的领域。

"超空间暗物质团在与足够速度的重力井相互作用时自发喷发？单纯的天体碰撞？那将是极其罕见的事件 —— 亿万星历年都难遇..."

Elek 院士开始沉浸于假设情景，一边将其映射到全息显示屏上，并将模拟互动与你提供的数据集进行比较。

他的视野局限于象牙塔的高墙之内 —— 而你的目光或许即将投向谜团的核心，投向黑暗之外更深邃的幽冥。

options.en: Leave him to his musing
options.zh: 留他继续沉思

texts.en: You're not sure Elek even noticed you leave.
texts.zh: 你不确定 Elek 是否意识到你的离去。

texts.en: "Indeed," he gives a tight smile, not taking the bait.
texts.zh: "确实，" 他勉强挤出一个笑容，并没有上钩。

texts.en:
"Most certainly!" he sputters, "She assured me, at length, and despite her position in Tri-"

His mouth shuts and he looks intently at you. Hoping that you didn't hear the obvious.
texts.zh:
"当然如此！" 他急促地说道，"她详尽地向我保证过，尽管她在速 ——"

他猛然住口，一边专注地看向你，希望你没有听清那个明显的字。

options.en: I shall say nothing, of course.
options.zh: 我当然不会多说半句。

options.en: Tri-Tachyon is backing your project?
options.zh: 速子科技 在支持你的项目？

texts.en: "Good. That's... very good of you, captain." An extra wrinkle remains on his forehead.
texts.zh: "很好。这真是...非常难得，舰长。" 他的额头上仍留着多余的皱纹。

texts.en:
"I, um. Don't be absurd! I could have been starting to say any number of words."

He doesn't look confident.
texts.zh:
"我，呃。别胡扯！我可能正准备说无数个不同的词。"

他看起来毫无底气。

options.en: I shall say nothing, of course. (lie)
options.zh: 我当然不会多说半句。 (说谎)

options.en: I shall say nothing, of course.
options.zh: 我当然不会多说半句。

texts.en:
"Payment?" Elek narrows his eyes. "I cannot comprehend your mercenary impulse in the face of such a discovery."

He sighs, then softens his tone. "But, yes, the logic of our economic arrangements dictate that scientific service ought be compensated."

A datapad appears in his hands and he taps something on, a little harder than strictly necessary. "I shall pay you 50,000 credits for recovering the data. Rather generous, I think."
texts.zh:
"报酬？" Elek 眯起眼睛，"我无法理解你面对如此发现时会有这种佣兵式的冲动。"

他叹了口气，语气稍缓。"但是，没错，我们经济安排的逻辑确实规定科学服务应当获得补偿。"

一个数据平板出现在他手中，他以一种不必要的力度敲击了几下。"我将为数据回收支付你 50,000 星币。这相当慷慨了，我认为。"

options.en: I accept your offer.
options.zh: 我接受你的报价。

options.en: More like 100k, due to hazard. I made it, unlike your freelancer.
options.zh: 考虑到风险，应该是 100,000 才对。我可不像你雇的自由佣兵，我成功了。

options.en: I will forgo payment. Advancement of knowledge is wealth enough.
options.zh: 我放弃报酬。知识的进步已是足够丰厚的财富。

options.en: I will forgo payment. Advancement of knowledge is wealth enough. (lie)
options.zh: 我放弃报酬。知识的进步已是足够丰厚的财富。 (说谎)

texts.en: He taps his datapad. "There. With that bit of unpleasantness out of the way, we can focus on what is truly important- the data."
texts.zh: 他点了点数据平板。"好了。这点不愉快解决后，我们可以专注于真正重要的事物 —— 数据。"

options.en: So, what does the data mean?
options.zh: 所以，这些数据意味着什么？

texts.en:
"That's sheer piracy! I'll offer 75,000 and not a credit more, $playerSirOrMadam," he says, growing heated.

"This petty haggling is beneath the station of a respected academician such as myself."
texts.zh:
"这简直是海盗行径！我最多就给你 75,000，不可能再多半个星币，$playerSirOrMadam。" 他激动地说道。

"这种斤斤计较的讨价还价，实在有损我这样一位受人尊敬的院士的身份。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: 100k or I walk.
options.zh: 100,000，否则我就走人。

texts.en: He almost strikes his datapad as he enters the transfer command - with a deep frown and judgmental look for you.
texts.zh: 他几乎是在数据平板上砸下了转账指令 —— 同时皱着眉头，用审视的目光盯着你。

texts.en:
"Out, get out of my office!" he shouts. "I'll call security!"

He continues shouting, and you see heads appear at the door then quickly duck away. It seems you've pushed him too far; there is no reasoning with him in this state.
texts.zh:
"出去，滚出我的办公室！" 他吼道，"我要叫警卫了！"

他继续叫喊着，你看见门口有人探头又迅速缩回。看来你把他逼得太紧；在这种状态下已无法和他沟通了。

texts.en: The only way forward is to investigate the coordinates in the Abyss yourself.
texts.zh: 唯一的出路就是亲自去调查深渊中的坐标了。

texts.en:
It is unsurprising that an ivory torus academician like Elek would lack an appreciation for your need for compensation to reward undertaking a hazardous mission, but so it goes. He is unlikely to reveal the motivation behind his project to analyze the particular sensor array which was looking at the location of the Onslaught Mk.I.

Elek can't have acted alone. Someone knew where to look.
texts.zh:
你需要报酬来推动执行危险任务，而像 Elek 这样的象牙塔式学者缺少对这一点的理解，这不足为奇，但世事如此。他不太可能透露自己分析特定传感器阵列的动机，而该阵列正监视着 攻势 Mk.I 的位置。

Elek 不可能单独行动。有人知道该往哪里去找。

texts.en:
His eyes widen. "Truly? That is to say, marvelous! I did not take you for a champion of science, but you may yet force me to re-evaluate my first impression."

Elek smiles, and seems to mean it.
texts.zh:
他睁大了眼睛。"真的？我是说，太好了！我本来并没有将你视为科学的捍卫者，但你可能迫使我重新评估对你的第一印象。"

Elek 微笑着，似乎是发自内心的。

texts.en:
His eyes widen. "Truly? That is to say, marvelous! I did not take you for a champion of science, but you may yet force me to re-evaluate my first impression."

Elek smiles, and seems to mean it.
texts.zh:
他睁大了眼睛。"真的？我是说，太好了！我本来并没有将你视为科学的捍卫者，但你可能迫使我重新评估对你的第一印象。"

Elek 微笑着，似乎是发自内心的。

texts.en:
"Yes, yes, but a moment," he says testily.

A couple taps on the datapad - harder than strictly necessary - and your own TriPad pings greedily.
texts.zh:
"行，行，稍等片刻，" 他不耐烦地说道。

他在数据平板上猛敲几下 —— 力道有些过于大了 —— 你的 TriPad 随即响起了贪婪的提示音。

options.en: So what is it? What were you looking for?
options.zh: 这是什么？你究竟在找什么？

texts.en:
"Payment?" He looks as irate as he does bewildered.

"I didn't hire you, $playerSirOrMadam. You were telling me about my discovery!"
texts.zh:
"报酬？" 他看起来既愤怒又困惑。

"我可没有雇佣你，$playerSirOrMadam，你刚才在向我汇报的是我的发现！"

options.en: Right. It worked. And gave me coordinates for something in the Abyss.
options.zh: 没错，而且它生效了。它给了我深渊中某物的坐标。

options.en: Fine. We can talk about MY discovery first. Then payment.
options.zh: 好吧。我们可以先谈谈 '我 的' 发现，然后再说报酬。

options.en: MY discovery. And we'll talk about payment if you want any part in it.
options.zh: 是 '我 的' 发现。如果你想参与其中，我们就谈谈报酬。

texts.en:
Elek narrows his eyes. "You presume much."

"But if the data, my data, is intact..." He gives you another skeptical look, then taps at his datapad, opening a datalink.
texts.zh:
Elek 眯起眼睛。"你假定得太多了。"

"但如果那些数据，我的数据，完好无损..." 他又一次投来怀疑的目光，随即点击数据平板，并开启了一道数据链接。

options.en: Transfer the data recovered from the sensor array
options.zh: 传输从传感器阵列中恢复的数据

texts.en:
"You're a heartless mercenary with no appreciation for science," Elek says, his tone growing heated.

"You propose that I agree to your theft of my results. This is practically piracy!"
texts.zh:
"你就是个没心没肺的雇佣兵，对科学毫无敬意，" Elek 说道，语气渐趋激烈。

"你竟然要我默许你窃取我的成果？这简直就是海盗行径！"

options.en: No, this is business. Your freelancer failed. Now I can do the job- if you pay.
options.zh: 不，这是正经的生意。你雇的自由佣兵失败了，而现在我可以接替他的工作 —— 如果你付钱的话。

options.en: Yes, it is. And if you don't pay me, you'll never get your precious data.
options.zh: 没错。如果你不支付报酬，就永远别想得到你那宝贵的数据。

texts.en:
He clearly doesn't like it, but your argument seems to take hold.

"A heartless mercenary. I stand by my words, but if you truly have found the sensor array and a complete copy of its data... yes, logic dictates that you ought to be paid for doing the job."

He picks up his datapad, and opens a link. His fingers strike the device somewhat harder than necessary.

"I shall pay you 50,000 credits for the data."
texts.zh:
他明显不怎么高兴，但似乎被你的论点打动了。

"真是个冷酷无情的雇佣兵。我坚持我的说法，但如果你真的找到了传感器阵列然后拿到了数据...是的，你理应得到报酬。"

他拿起数据平板，打开一个链接。他的手指以一种不必要的力度敲击着设备。

"我会付给你 50,000 星币作为报酬。"

options.en: Transfer the data recovered from the sensor array
options.zh: 传输从传感器阵列中恢复的数据

options.en: That's not enough. Make it 100k.

texts.en: "No," he almost growls. "I've made an exception for you, and bent my ethics, to say nothing of my pride, to accommodate your demands. Accept the fair payment which I promised to the other freelancer or remove yourself from my sight."
texts.zh: "不，" 他几乎是从牙缝里挤出了这句话。"我已经为你破例，甚至折损了我的原则 —— 更不必说我的尊严 —— 来满足你的要求。要么接受我承诺给另一位自由佣兵的合理报酬，要么就从我眼前消失。"

options.en: Transfer the data recovered from the sensor array
options.zh: 传输从传感器阵列中恢复的数据

options.en: 100k or I walk.
options.zh: 100,000，否则我就走人。

texts.en:
Elek looks you over, the spark of recognition failing to ignite.

"I'm afraid I don't recall," he says. "What, may I ask, is the purpose of your visit?"
texts.zh:
Elek 打量着你，看不出一点认识你的样子。

"恐怕我不记得了。" 他说道，"请问你为什么来这？"

options.en: I found your modified sensor array on the Fringe.
options.zh: 我在边缘星区找到了你那个改装过的传感器阵列。

texts.en:
He stares.

"You did?" he asks. "That was- What happened to... to... we hired a freelancer, a small fleet. A couple of my students were to oversee the work."
texts.zh:
他凝视着你。

"你找到了？" 他问道，"那是 —— 那个...我们雇了个自由职业者，一支小舰队。本该由我的几个学生监督工作的。"

options.en: I don't know about that. But I went into the Abyss, where it scanned.
options.zh: 我对那些并不清楚。但我进入了深渊，而它也在那里进行了扫描。

options.en: I don't know anything about that. I just found the array.
options.zh: 我对此一无所知。我只是找到了阵列。

options.en: They probably didn't make it. I'm sorry.
options.zh: 他们很可能并没有成功。我很遗憾。

options.en: If they're not back yet, they're probably dead.
options.zh: 如果他们至今还没有回来，那他们很可能已经丧生。

options.en: I don't know anything about that. I just found the array.
options.zh: 我对此一无所知。我只是找到了阵列。

options.en: They probably didn't make it. I'm sorry.
options.zh: 他们很可能并没有成功。我很遗憾。

options.en: If they're not back yet, they're probably dead.
options.zh: 如果他们至今还没有回来，那他们很可能已经丧生。

texts.en:
I, hmm, I see." Elek rubs his hands together, distracted.

He stares at the floor. Then, without looking up, begins to speak again.
texts.zh:
"呃，我明白了。" Elek 心不在焉地搓着手。

他盯着地板，然后头也没抬地开口说道。

texts.en:
Elek begins to say something, and fails. He rubs his hands together nervously.

"I... I see. Yes, you're probably... it's very..."

He trails off, staring into space. He looks sad and a little bit confused. Without looking at you, he begins to speak again.
texts.zh:
Elek 似乎要说些什么，但又咽了回去。他紧张地搓着手，"我...我明白了。是的，你可能...这很危险..."

他渐渐压低声音，目光呆滞地望着太空，看起来既悲伤又有些困惑。没有看你，他又开始说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Elek begins to say something, and fails. He rubs his hands together nervously. "I... I see. Yes, you're probably... it's very dangerous..."

He trails off, staring into space. He looks sad and a little bit confused. Without looking at you, he begins to speak again.
texts.zh:
Elek 似乎要说些什么，但又咽了回去。他紧张地搓着手，"我...我明白了。是的，你可能...这很危险..."

他渐渐压低声音，目光呆滞地望着太空，看起来既悲伤又有些困惑。没有看你，他又开始说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: I gave your proposal some more thought. I accept.
options.zh: 我重新考虑了你的提议。我接受。

options.en: I gave your proposal some more thought. I decline.
options.zh: 我重新考虑了你的提议。我拒绝。

texts.en:
"Excellent. I'll have the hardware package transferred to your $shipOrFleet immediately," he taps at a datapad, connecting comms and reels off some imperious orders at some poor support staff.

"Off you go! We made the package installation idiot-proof. So I'm sure you...r technicians will be capable of installing it."
texts.zh:
"好极了。我会立即将硬件套件传输至你的$shipOrFleet，" 他点击数据平板接通通讯，并对某位可怜的后勤人员下达了一连串专横的指令。

"出发吧！我们把这套件的安装做得连新手都能操作。所以我相信你...的技术团队能胜任安装工作。"

options.en: I'm sure we'll manage.
options.zh: 我们会搞定的。

options.en: Wait, which end goes in the sensor array again?
options.zh: 等等，是哪头朝着传感器阵列来着？

texts.en:
"Good."

He turns his attention away, and you see a holographic moon spin past his head.

"I await your return, captain," he says over his shoulder.
texts.zh:
"很好。"

他移开了注意，你看到一颗全息天体旋转着飞过他的头顶。

"我会在这等着你的，舰长。" 他头也不回地说道。

options.en: Cut the commlink
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"The attached specifications will..." Elek pauses, then squints.

"I see. You're engaging in a bit of jocularity. Well, I can't exactly disapprove of high spirits at the outset of an expedition provided you mind the technical details."

He turns away and begins re-arranging holographic moons that have been floating around him. "I await your return, captain," he says over his shoulder.
texts.zh:
"附带的说明文档里有详细的..." Elek 说到这停了下来，眼睛眯成了一条缝。

"我明白了，你刚才是在开玩笑吧。我不反对你在出发前活跃活跃气氛，只要你们别真的忽略了技术细节就行。"

他转过身去，开始摆弄着身旁漂浮着的全息天体。"我会在这等着你的，舰长。" 他头也不回地说道。

options.en: Cut the commlink
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
"Very well. I'll simply find an adventurer who is interested in the advancement of human knowledge. To say nothing of, of, of wealth and glory!"

"Good day!"

He hits the cut-off, and you're left with the logo of the Galatia Academy Planetology Department.
texts.zh:
"很好。我自然会找到一位对增进人类知识感兴趣的探险家，更不必说对财富与荣耀的兴趣。"

"再见。" 他切断了通讯，你面前只剩下 Galatia 学院行星科学部的徽标。

options.en: Cut the commlink
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: Your $shipOrFleet approaches the $nameInText.
texts.zh: 你的$shipOrFleet靠近了 $nameInText。

options.en: Install the hardware package to read the array's datastores
options.zh: 安装硬件套件以读取阵列的数据存储单元

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
Your operations chief oversees the installation with their usual methodical precision and discipline.

The hardware is interfaced with a secure computing environment on your flagship, and your tech team stands by to oversee the results.
texts.zh:
你的行动长官以一贯的严谨精确与纪律性监督着安装过程。

硬件设备已与你旗舰上的安全计算环境完成对接，技术团队随时待命以监控运行结果。

options.en: Activate the system.
options.zh: 激活系统。

texts.en:
The telemetry streams across space to your flagship by the flicker of the discreet little comms laser your ops team installed.

Your technology officer confirms that while the data isn't perfect, it has a vastly lower corruption rate than Elek's copy from the Galatia Academy archive.
texts.zh:
遥测数据通过行动小组安装的隐蔽小型通讯激光器闪烁着传输至你的旗舰。

你的技术军官确认，尽管数据并非完美，但其损坏率远低于 Elek 从 Galatia 学院档案馆获得的副本。

options.en: What are we looking at?
options.zh: 我们正在观察什么？

texts.en:
"We have a fix on where they were looking," Tech says proudly as they transfer you the coordinates.

"It would appear to be a minor planet in the Abyss. No star, no nebulae; no primary but itself."
texts.zh:
"我们锁定了他们的观测目标，" 技官自豪地说道，同时将坐标传输给你。

"看起来是深渊里的一颗矮行星。没有恒星，没有星云；除了自身之外空无一物。"

options.en: What's so interesting about a nameless rock?
options.zh: 一颗无名的岩质星球有什么特别的？

texts.en:
"Well, $playerSirOrMadam, nothing about the rock itself."

"The Domain Explorarium ordered a non-routine survey of the volume. We don't know what they were looking for, but the survey program found... well, it appears as though something happened, something violent. A series of high-energy events over a short period of time a little over 200 cycles ago. A starless rock is, um, very unlikely to produce such effects naturally."

They pause, then speak tentatively. "A battle, maybe? We can't say for sure. I don't know what would be worth fighting over out there. Or even looking for."
texts.zh:
"嗯，$playerSirOrMadam，与岩质星球本身无关。"

"人之领开拓者 曾下令对该区域进行非常规勘察。我们不清楚他们当时在寻找什么，但勘察程序发现了...呃，似乎发生过某种剧烈的异常事件。在大约两百多个星历年前，短期内爆发了一系列高能现象。一颗无恒星的岩质星球，呃，几乎不可能自然产生此类效应。"

他们顿了顿，然后试探性地补充道，"也许是场战斗？我们无法确定。我不知道那里有什么值得争夺 —— 甚至值得探寻的东西。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
There's only one way to find out.

And it's best done with plenty of extra supplies and fuel. Every spacer knows that the Abyss is not to be trifled with. Of those foolish captains who attempt to find their fortune there, the few who return are often starving, having to mothball ships for fuel and supplies during the long crawl back to the Core Worlds.
texts.zh:
只有一种方法能找到答案。

而最好的做法是备足额外的补给和燃料。每位太空船员都明白：深渊不容儿戏。那些愚蠢的舰长们试图在此寻觅财富，最终归来的寥寥无几，而归来者他们也往往饥肠辘辘，在漫长的返航途中为了燃料和补给而不得不封存舰船，才得以蠕动着回到核心星区。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
This Academician Elek of the Galatia Academy could not have possibly known his sensor data would lead to... this. Could he?

You might be justified to ask him with an urgency proportional to the magnitude of the situation you now find yourself in.

Only if you manage to survive this 'Threat' and make it back to the Core Worlds, of course.
texts.zh:
这位来自 Galatia 学院的 Elek 院士，不可能预料到他的传感器数据会导致...这种情况，对吧？

鉴于你现在所处的境地如此危急，你或许有理由迫切地向他询问此事。

当然，前提是你能从这场 '威胁' 中幸存下来，并返回核心星区。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Your sensors officer finally suppresses the new detector's alerts, then turns to you. The Onslaught Mk.I rotates threateningly in the primary display, an avatar of ancient violence.

"What are your orders, $playerSirOrMadam?" they ask.
texts.zh:
你的传感器技官终于控制住了新探测器的警报，然后转向你。主显示屏上，攻势 Mk.I 威胁性地旋转着，仿佛是远古暴力的化身。

"你有什么指示，$playerSirOrMadam？" 对方问道。

texts.en:
Academician Elek could not have possibly known his sensor data would lead to... this. Could he?

It's too big, too dangerous for a pretentious, if bombastic, academic like Elek to have stumbled upon himself. And based on what you know from the sensor array data, it was someone else's project entirely around 200 cycles ago.

Someone long dead. Probably.
texts.zh:
Elek 院士不可能预料到他的传感器数据会导致...这种情况，对吧？

这玩意太大了，也太危险了，像 Elek 这样自命不凡、甚至有些夸夸其谈的学者，不可能是自己偶然发现。而且，根据你从传感器阵列数据中了解到的情况来看，它在大约 200 个星历年前属于别人的项目。

或许，那个人早就死了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Your sensors officer finally suppresses the new detector's alerts, then turns to you. The Onslaught Mk.I rotates threateningly in the primary display, an avatar of ancient violence.

"What are your orders, $playerSirOrMadam?" they ask.
texts.zh:
你的传感器技官终于控制住了新探测器的警报，然后转向你。主显示屏上，攻势 Mk.I 威胁性地旋转着，仿佛是远古暴力的化身。

"你有什么指示，$playerSirOrMadam？" 对方问道。

texts.en:
Academician Elek could not have possibly known his sensor data would lead to... this. Could he?

It's too big, too dangerous for a pretentious, if bombastic, academic like Elek to have stumbled upon himself. And based on what you know from the sensor array data, it was someone else's project entirely around 200 cycles ago.

Someone long dead. Probably.
texts.zh:
Elek 院士绝不可能料到，他那份传感器数据竟会引向...这般境地。真的不可能吗？

这东西太大、太危险，不像是 Elek 这种自命不凡、又爱夸夸其谈的学者能独自撞上的。而据你从传感器阵列数据里得知的情况，大约 200 个周期之前，它完全是另一个人主导的项目。

一个早已作古的人。多半如此。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Greetings! Captain $PlayerName." Academician Elek is as pleased to see you as you've ever seen.

"I trust your expedition was a success. Please, do me the favor of summarizing your findings while you transmit the data you've collected."

He taps at something, and your comms ping softly to notify you that Elek has opened a datastream for you. He looks at you expectantly.
texts.zh:
"你好！$PlayerName 舰长。" 见到你时，Elek 院士展现出前所未见的高兴。

"你肯定在科考中收获满满。请汇报一下你的发现并把收集到数据传输给我，就当帮我个忙了。"

他敲了敲什么东西，你的通讯设备轻响一声，表明 Elek 已经为你打开了一个数据流。他期待地看着你。

options.en: I found your modified sensor array on the Fringe...
options.zh: 我在边疆找到了你那座改装过的传感器阵列...

texts.en:
"I'm not available for questions right now," he says, cutting you off.

"Office hours are in the syllabus provided by my teaching assistant. Please visit my office at an appropriate time, thank-you and goodbye."

He hits the comms cut-off.
texts.zh:
"我现在没空回答问题，" 他打断你。

"答疑时间写在助教发的课程大纲里。请在合适的时间来我办公室，谢谢，再见。"

他按下了通讯切断键。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Elek. I found your sensor array. There were strange readings.
options.zh: Elek。我找到了你的传感器阵列。上面的读数很奇怪。

texts.en:
"I'm not available right now," he says without looking up. "Office hours are in the syllabus, good-bye."

He hits the comms cut-off.

Perhaps an in-person visit will force him to listen to you.
texts.zh:
"我现在没空，\" 他头也不抬，\"答疑时间看课程大纲，再见。"

他按下了通讯切断键。

或许亲自登门，才能逼他听你把话说完。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: Ask where you could find the office of Cornelius Elek
options.zh: 询问在哪里可以找到 Cornelius Elek 的办公室

options.en: I'm $playerName. I found your modified sensor array on the Fringe.
options.zh: 我是 $playerName，我在边缘星区找到了你改装过的传感器阵列。

options.en: I don't know about that. But I went into the Abyss, where it scanned.
options.zh: 我对那些并不清楚。但我进入了深渊，而它也在那里进行了扫描。

options.en: I don't know anything about that. I just found the array.
options.zh: 我对此一无所知。我只是找到了阵列。

options.en: They probably didn't make it. I'm sorry.
options.zh: 他们很可能并没有成功。我很遗憾。

options.en: If they're not back yet, they're probably dead.
options.zh: 如果他们至今还没有回来，那他们很可能已经丧生。

texts.en:
"The array, it was intact? You said it was modified? So they installed it successfully."

He looks up, now, hopefully.
texts.zh:
"那个阵列，它完好无损？你说它被改装过？所以他们成功安装了。"

他现在抬起头，带着期盼的神色。

options.en: Yes. It worked. It gave me coordinates in the Abyss and I went there.
options.zh: 是的，它生效了。它给了我深渊中的坐标，而我前往了那里。

options.en: Yes. I think this is a good time to discuss payment.
options.zh: 是的。我认为现在是时候讨论报酬了。

options.en: Ask where you could find the office of Cornelius Elek
options.zh: 询问在哪里能找到 Cornelius Elek 的办公室

options.en: I'm $playerName. We've spoken before. I returned your datacore.
options.zh: 我是$playerName。我们见过面：我找回了你的数据核心。

options.en: I'm $playerName, remember? I've found your sensor array on the Fringe.
options.zh: 我是 $playerName，还记得吗？我在边疆找到了你的传感器阵列。

options.en: I'm $playerName. I found your modified sensor array on the Fringe.
options.zh: 我是 $playerName。我在边疆找到了你那座改装过的传感器阵列。

texts.en: "Yes? Aren't you going to the sensor array? I don't see how there can be any confusion about what I asked you to do."
texts.zh: "嗯？你不是要去传感器阵列那儿吗？我不明白我要求你做的事有什么可混淆的。"

texts.en:
"Ah, greetings $playerName!" Elek looks the happiest you've ever seen him.

"I am most eager to learn of your discoveries in the Abyss- perhaps you could summarize them to me while your mission data is transferred." He taps at a datapad, "I've opened a stream."

He awaits your reply, smiling.
texts.zh:
"啊，$playerName 舰长，欢迎！" 你从没见过 Elek 像现在这么开心。

"我迫切地想知道你在深渊的发现 —— 或许你可以在传输任务数据时先为我简述一下。" 他点击着数据平板，"我已经开启了数据流。"

他微笑着等待你的回应。

options.en: I haven't actually gone to the rogue planet yet.
options.zh: 我还没真正意义上地去过那颗流浪行星。

texts.en:
"What?" He's still smiling, but his joy is fading. "Why not? Did you need to pick up more fuel and supplies? Surely the Galatia system doesn't have the best prices..."

The smile has faded by now.

"Regardless, there's no need to check in with me. Go, get moving! I await your results with the utmost anticipation. And, in the meantime, I'm a very busy man. Good day."

He turns as he cuts the comms.
texts.zh:
"什么？" 他仍然保持着微笑，但喜悦正在逐渐褪去，"为什么不去？需要补充燃料和补给吗？Galatia 星系的价格肯定不是最优的..."

此刻笑容已完全消失。

"无论如何，无需向我报备，快去行动吧！我以最大的期待等待你的成果。同时，我事务也很繁忙。再见。"

他转身切断了通讯。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en: "But if you have nothing for me... perhaps another time?"
texts.zh: "不过你要是没东西给我...那就下次再说？"

options.en: Select specimens to turn in
options.zh: 选择要上交的样本

options.en: Maybe later.
options.zh: 改天吧。

texts.en:
Your comms are routed through a secretary, either a holosim or product of uncanny cosmetic and behavior tuning, then, after a brief wait, the link blinks to Director Glamor-Rotanev.

"Captain $playerLastName," she says, then pauses. "You found something, didn't you."
texts.zh:
你的通讯经由秘书转接 —— 可能是全息模拟体，也可能经过精妙外貌与行为调校的仿生体。短暂等待后，链接闪烁切换至 Glamor-Rotanev 总监的画面。

"$playerLastName 舰长，" 她说道，随后顿了顿，"你有所发现，是吗。"

options.en: I found... many things. And an Onslaught Mk.I.
options.zh: 我发现了...许多东西，以及一艘 攻势 Mk.I。

options.en: Nope, nothing yet. (lie)

options.en: I found something... hostile. In the Abyss.
options.zh: 我发现了某些...敌对个体，就在深渊中。

options.en: Nope, nothing yet. (lie)
options.zh: 不，还没有。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"Excellent."

To your shock, her smile is nearly human. The mask is replaced almost instantly, though a slackening echo of the expression remains on her lips.

"I, and my researchers, are most eager to examine your findings. And you to be paid, no doubt."
texts.zh:
"好极了。"

令你震惊的是，她的微笑竟近乎人类。虽然那副面具在转瞬间便恢复原状，但那抹神情的余韵仍在她的唇边萦绕不去。

"我和我的研究员们都十分渴望检视你的发现，而你无疑也渴望获得报酬。"

texts.en:
"It pleases me to hear that." She doesn't smile.

"I, and my researchers, are most eager to examine your findings. And you to be paid, no doubt.
texts.zh:
"这消息让我很高兴。" 她并没有微笑。

"我和我的研究员们都十分渴望检视你的发现，而你无疑也渴望获得报酬。"

texts.en:
Her eyes, previously distant, stare at you through the link for a several seconds before she replies.

"I am eager to reward you for your work." Her tone is not inviting. "CEO Sun is in full agreement. There are extraordinary discoveries and profits to be made. I am uninterested in an obstinate parody of negotiation."
texts.zh:
她原本疏离的目光，此刻透过链接凝视着你数秒之久，才终于回应。

"我也渴望为你的工作支付酬劳。" 她的语气毫无示好之意，"CEO Sun 完全赞同，那其中蕴含着非凡的发现与利润潜力。而我对这种顽固的谈判闹剧毫无兴趣。"

texts.en:
"Don't act this obstinate pretense of negotiation. You $shipOrFleet has been scanned. And we knew what you found well before you arrived anyway." She pauses quite consciously.

"I am... most eager to reward your work."

Despite her words, the tone is icy. "CEO Sun is in full agreement. We may share in extraordinary discoveries and profits."
texts.zh:
"别摆出这副顽固的谈判姿态，你的$shipOrFleet已被扫描。而且早在你抵达之前，我们就已知晓你的发现。" 她有意识地顿了顿。

"而我...也极度渴望酬谢你的工作。"

尽管措辞如此，她的语气却依然冰冷刺骨。"CEO Sun 完全赞同，我们可以共享非凡的发现与利润。"

options.en: And I am eager to be paid. You got me.
options.zh: 我正渴望着报酬呢，你可踩到我的点了。

options.en: Close the link
options.zh: 关闭链接

options.en: What I found was... hostile. And Inhuman.
options.zh: 我发现了...敌对个体，而且是非人的。

options.en: Close the link
options.zh: 关闭链接

texts.en: Her expression remains frozen with disdainful impatience.
texts.zh: 她的表情依然凝固着轻蔑的烦躁。

texts.en: "Tell me what you found."
texts.zh: "告诉我你都找到了什么。"

texts.en: "It was not the 'Threat'," she says. It doesn't sound like a question.
texts.zh: "那不是 '威胁'，" 她说道，这句话听来并非是疑问。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 没什么。

options.en: No. But you already know that, don't you.
options.zh: 没什么。但你早就知道了，不是吗。

texts.en: "Tell me what you found."
texts.zh: "告诉我你都找到了什么。"

texts.en:
She blinks once.

"Tell me what you found."
texts.zh:
她眨了一下眼。

"告诉我你都找到了什么。"

texts.en:
"Something." She raises an eyebrow.

"It was not human or AI-derived." This doesn't sound like a question.
texts.zh:
"某些个体。" 她挑起一侧眉毛。

"那不是人类或 AI 的产物。" 这听来并非是疑问。

texts.en:
The comms flick into an active feed nearly instantly.

"Captain," Director Glamor-Rotanev greets you, simply. "I was just admiring your new acquisition."

Her eyes flicker oddly, and you detect what might be a rare spark of genuine amusement.

"Or perhaps it is better described as your very, very old acquisition."
texts.zh:
通讯几乎在瞬间切入了激活状态。

"舰长，" Glamor-Rotanev 总监简单地打了招呼，"我方才正在欣赏你的新藏品。"

她的眼眸不自然地闪烁着，你察觉到其中或许夹杂着一丝罕见的真切趣味。

"或许称之为你极其、极其古老的藏品更为贴切。"
