options.en: I have more 'interesting' specimens for you...
options.zh: 我为你准备了更多 '有趣的' 样本...

texts.en:
"Fantastic. A priority flight path has been pre-approved for your convenience. The Tri-Tachyon Corporation is pleased to wish you a most profitable meeting with the Director of Special Acquisitions."

The uncanny smile re-appears, perfectly, once more. It's a little unsettling.
texts.zh:
"太好了。为方便您出行，我们已经预先核准了一条优先飞行航线。三一速子科技公司 谨祝您与特殊采购部总监的会晤收获丰硕。"

那瘆人的标准完美笑容再次浮现，略微令人不适。

options.en: Take a shuttle to visit Director of Special Acquisitions Glamor-Rotanev
options.zh: 搭乘穿梭机前往拜访特殊采购部总监 Glamor-Rotanev

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

texts.en:
Your shuttle descends into the young atmosphere of Eochu Bres, through towering battlements of clouds. A spray of rain darkens your viewport for a moment before it is wiped clean by the heat and speed of your descent.

The flight path immediately deviates from the general approach corridor which had started ticking off minor use-fees from the Tri-Tachyon owned flight control: general volume access fee, priority flight lane fee, service fee, customer satisfaction insurance charge, advertisement bypass fee.

The notifications self-delete, their fees automatically refunded, as the towering central arcologies of Xanadu emerge from the mist.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降入了 Eochu Bres 刚形成不久的大气层，在犹如城垛般的高耸云层间穿行。一阵雨雾喷洒在你的视窗上，又随即被降下时的热量和速度擦拭干净。

飞行路线立刻就偏离了一般的进场通道，并引发了一堆来自 速子科技 航空管制的小额扣费：基本空域通行费、优先航路附加费、服务费、客户满意度保险费、广告屏蔽费，

当 Xanadu 高耸的核心生态都市群从薄雾中显现时，这些通知便自行删除了，所有费用也自动进行了退还。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Jagged mountain peaks ring the horizon. Gleaming monoliths glitter, spears of capital upthrust through the glowering flesh of the world. Skyarco II grows before you, prismatic.

Your shuttle alights on a landing pad held at some distance from the facade by an airy support rib. It looks impossibly thin, but on touch down feels as solid as a coherent M-type asteroid.
texts.zh:
锯齿状的山峰环绕着地平线。闪闪发光的石碑群是如此璀璨夺目，如同刺穿星球阴郁躯壳的资本长矛。Skyarco II 在你眼前铺展开来，折射着斑斓的光彩。

你的穿梭机降落在停机坪上，这片平台由轻盈的支撑肋骨托举悬空于建筑立面之外。它看似脆弱得不可思议，但着陆时却坚实如一块完整的 M 型小行星。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You step onto a perfectly dry pad. A shimmer as wind drives a burst of rain into the atmo-field betrays the artifice of this pocket of calm.

You are invited inside by an obsequious corporate usher.
texts.zh:
你踏上保持着完美干燥的停机坪。一阵风将雨水卷进大气防护场时泛起的微光，揭示了这片宁静表象的人工本质。

一位殷勤的企业礼宾员将你引入了室内。

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
The architecture of Skyarco II's interior and its integrated art-installations are titanic in scale and inhuman in affect. Your attention is subtly drawn toward geometric motifs suggestive of a mathematical intricacy which would reward close study with nothing less than delight, and...

"It was designed by an Artificial Intelligence," the cheerful secretary behind the reception desk informs you, breaking the trance. "Before the ban imposed by the Hegemony, of course."

"The piece is explicitly referent-free to reflect the pure universe of interstellar markets which invite every new partner to participate in Tri-Tachyon's enterprise!"
texts.zh:
Skyarco II 的内部建筑与融合在其中的艺术装置，其规模堪称泰坦巨构，氛围却透着非人的冷峻。你的注意力被微妙地引向几何图案 —— 它们暗示着数学般的精妙结构，如果细细品味，必将收获无上的愉悦，并且...

"这是由人工智能设计的，" 前台那位笑容可掬的秘书打破了你的出神状态，"当然是在 霸主 颁布禁令之前。"

"这件作品刻意避免了任何参照物，旨在映射纯粹的星际市场宇宙 —— 它正邀请每位新伙伴加入 速子科技 的商业版图！"

options.en: I'm here to see Director Glamor-Rotanev.
options.zh: 我来这儿是为了见 Glamor-Rotenev 总监。

options.en: Isn't that nice.
options.zh: 真不错呢。

texts.en:
"Of course, $playerSirOrMadam," the secretary says with a smile. "The Director asked that you head right in."

The lighting of the richly furnished entryway - is that a mercury fountain? - warms slightly, inviting you to proceed.
texts.zh:
"当然，$playerSirOrMadam，" 秘书微笑着说。"总监请您直接进去。"

华贵装潢的门厅里 —— 那是个水银喷泉吗？—— 灯光微微转暖，邀请你前行。

options.en: Enter the office of the Director of Special Acquisitions
options.zh: 进入特殊采购部总监的办公室。

texts.en:
A plane of glass - diamond-matrix, naturally - stretches in both directions to the edge of your peripheral vision, its extent blocked only by a set of cyclopean interior columns. Misty mountains and towering arcologies wreathed in rain clouds hang in the vista beyond.

Before you, a figure sits - now stands - behind a monolithic desk stark as a planetoid scraped bare by pulsar beam.

The Director of "Special Acquisitions".

A hand raises, open, to invite you to sit. A seat appears.
texts.zh:
一片玻璃平台 —— 自然是由金刚石方窗组成 —— 向两侧延伸至视野尽头，边界仅被一排独眼巨人般的室内立柱所阻隔。朦胧的群山和耸立的生态都市群间缭绕着雨云，悬垂天边。

在你面前，一道身影端坐 —— 旋即起身 —— 于一张浑如小行星般的巨大办公桌后，桌面光洁如同被脉冲星冲刷过一样。

"特殊采购部" 的总监。

她抬手，手掌打开，邀你入座。一张座椅旋即出现。

options.en: Sit
options.zh: 坐下

options.en: Stand
options.zh: 站着

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName. I offer vast wealth in exchange for your unique facility in navigating exceptional scenarios."

She blinks once. Her gaze is fixed on you, but you can't help but feel it is slightly vague, apparently attentive but not present in spirit. The look of a cyber-aug.

Her tech must be absolutely top-of-the-line, of course.
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。我愿以巨额的财富，换取您于特殊情境中那无可替代的航行才能。"

她眨了下眼，目光锁定在你身上。但你不禁感觉那眼神有点飘忽，看似专注却神游他处 —— 那是神经植入体使用者特有的眼神。

她的技术植入体肯定是最顶级的，毋庸置疑。

options.en: I'll hear you out. What's the proposal?
options.zh: 我洗耳恭听，你的提议是什么？

options.en: What's the catch?
options.zh: 有什么条件？

options.en: Directly to business, huh? No small-talk?
options.zh: 这就直奔主题了，嗯？不先寒暄几下？

texts.en: "Fitting to your talents, I think," she says. "Allow me to iterate your accomplishments briefly so that you know where we stand."
texts.zh: "我认为这符合你的才能，" 她说道，"请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以让你清楚我们现在的立场。"

options.en: Say nothing
options.zh: 保持沉默

options.en: Been spying on me?
options.zh: 一直在监视我？

options.en: My favorite subject, please proceed.
options.zh: 我最爱听这个话题，请继续。

texts.en:
"You're proving useful to Provost Baird - an admirable figure generally - yet one who stubbornly ties herself to the Hegemony bureaucracy."

"If it weren't for Kallichore's blundering..." Her eyes grow distant - more distant - for a moment, then return to their usual unblinking detachment.

"Here at Tri-Tachyon, we put the highest value in unrestrained R&D. Especially its dividends." She smiles coyly. "So, I think, do you."
texts.zh:
"你对 Baird 院长 —— 一位总体而言值得敬佩的人物 —— 很有助益，可惜她固执地将自己捆绑在霸主的官僚体系上。"

"若非 Kallichore 的愚蠢行径..." 她的目光变得遥远 —— 更加遥远 —— 片刻后又恢复惯常的漠然。

"在 速子科技，我们最看重的就是不受束缚的研发。特别是其红利。" 她狡黠一笑，"我想，你也这么认为。"

texts.en:
"You've proven useful to Provost Baird. And your accomplishment with the Gates..."

She puts her hands together, not quite a single clap for all you've done. Her politely mechanical smile contains some bitterness, you sense.

"I admire Baird, truly I do. Her ability to overcome Hegemony stone-walling, and herding those academics with their notions... sadly, though, it appears as though her grip was too tight. Pity to lose top talent."

The bitterness, you see, has left Glamor-Rotanev's smile to be replaced with something more carnivorous.

"Our R&D is cutting-edge, eminently practical, and there's very little risk of runaways. Our results might match your ambitions, I think."
texts.zh:
"你已向 Baird 院长证明了自己。而你在星门方面的成就..."

她双手合十，却未能为你所做的一切拍响掌声。你察觉到她那礼貌机械的微笑中带着一丝苦涩。

"我敬佩 Baird，真心实意。她突破 霸主 阻挠的能力，以及她驾驭那些学者们的理念...可惜，似乎她抓得太紧了。损失顶尖人才总是遗憾。"

你看见那抹苦涩已从 Glamor-Rotanev 的微笑中褪去，取而代之的是某种更食肉性的神色。

"我们的研发是最前沿的，极为务实，且失控风险极低。我想，我们的成果或许能匹配你的抱负。"

texts.en:
"We see you've taken up an interest with the Luddi- pardon me, with the Church of Galactic Redemption. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so otherwise practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
texts.zh:
"我们注意到你开始关注卢德 —— 抱歉，是 银河救赎教会 的事务。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

texts.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more and better than that. I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Do you?"
texts.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。"

她精准地扬起眉毛，"你觉得呢？"

texts.en:
"We've noticed that Mr. Macario - apologies," she laughs like a wind chime, "'The Chief High Inspector' has taken you for one of his pawns."

"You and I both know you're more than that. Better than that. And I believe your innovative perspective could be worth more than his entire tin-pot slum-bully's secret budget of bribes and favors. That silly little battleship he gave you? A child's toy compared to what I offer."

She brushes one hand off with the other.
texts.zh:
"我们注意到 Macario 先生 —— 抱歉，" 她的笑声如风铃般清脆，"'最高检察长' 先生将你视为他的棋子之一。"

"你我都清楚，你远不止于此，且远胜于此。我相信你创新的视野，其价值远超他那套贫民窟恶霸式的秘密预算中的所有贿赂与人情。至于给你的那艘愚蠢的小战舰？与我提供的相比，那不过是孩童的玩具。"

她用一只手拂开另一只手。

texts.en:
"Old reports noted your service to Mr. Macario - sorry, 'The Chief High Inspector' - and took has taken you for one of his pawns. But you've managed both to unseat him and follow through with his elimination. Well done."

"Nonetheless, you and I both know you're more and better than service to that blinkered tin-pot dictatorship. I believe your potential could be worth more than those little bribes and medals they distribute."

Her eyebrows lift precisely. "Don't you agree?"
texts.zh:
"旧档案里记着你替 Macario 先生办过事——抱歉，是'最高检察长'先生——便把你当他的一枚棋子。可你不光把他掀下台，还一路送他上了绝路。干得漂亮。"

"话虽如此，你我心里都清楚，替那个目光短浅的小独裁政权当差，未免埋没了你。我看你的本事，值的可不止他们发的那点贿赂和勋章。"

她精确地挑了挑眉。"你说是不是？"

texts.en:
"Old reports described you as a pawn of Mr. Macario, the former 'Chief High Inspector' of the Sindrian Diktat. But it seems they got you wrong."

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Achilles, I believe it's name is - you've managed to unseat him from his position."

"But Achilles? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and chant of 'reforms'. It soothes the ears of small men with small greeds. But I," she smiles oddly, "am no such man."
texts.zh:
"旧档案把你写成 Macario 先生的棋子——辛达强权的前任'最高检察长'。看来是他们看走眼了。"

她的笑声如风铃般清脆。"看来你借着替 Philip 的克隆体办事——好像叫 Achilles——把他从位子上掀了下来。"

"可 Achilles？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章和'改革'口号。那套话哄得住贪小便宜的小人物，可我，\" 她笑得有些古怪，\"可不是那种人。"

"But Achilles? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and chant of 'reforms'. He soothes the ears of small men with small greeds. But I," she smiles oddly, "am no such man."

"可 Achilles？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章和'改革'口号。那套话他拿来哄贪小便宜的小人物，可我，\" 她笑得有些古怪，\"可不是那种人。"

"Old reports described you as a pawn of Mr. Macario, the former 'Chief High Inspector' of the Sindrian Diktat. But it seems they got you wrong."

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Hector, I believe it's name is - you've managed to unseat him from his position."

"Still. Hector? Really? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and barely-concealed murders."

"旧档案把你写成 Macario 先生的棋子——辛达强权的前任'最高检察长'。看来是他们看走眼了。"

texts.en:

She laughs like a wind chime. "It appears that through your service to Philip's clone - Hector, I believe it's name is - you've managed both to unseat him from his position and follow through with his elimination. Well done."

"Still. Hector? Really? I believe your potential could be worth more than his tin-pot slum-bully's bribes, medals, and barely-concealed murders."

她的笑声如风铃般清脆。"看来你借着替 Philip 的克隆体办事——好像叫 Hector——不光把他掀下台，还一路送他上了绝路。干得漂亮。"

"话说回来，Hector？当真？我看你的本事，值的不止他那套小恶霸式的贿赂、勋章，还有那些几乎不加遮掩的谋杀。"

texts.en:
"I must applaud your patriotism - the Hegemony, the restoration of the Domain!

She makes as if to clap, daintily, but stops her hands before they meet. Then turns her expression toward something far more cynical.

"You may earn the favor of that stubborn 'Old Man Daud'. But is that enough? Surely you tire of that paltry government stipend, the endless regulation? It must stifle your ambition. You must yearn for a truly dynamic enterprise. One in which someone like yourself can change the Sector..."
texts.zh:
"我必须为你的爱国情怀喝彩 —— 为了 霸主，为了 人之领 的复兴！"

她优雅地摆出鼓掌的架势，却在双手相触前停下。随即换上一副远为讥诮的表情。

"你或许能赢得那位固执的 'Daud 老爷子' 的青睐，但这足够吗？你定然已经厌倦那微薄的政府津贴和无尽的规章吧？那必定扼杀了你的雄心。你必然渴望真正充满活力的事业，一个能让你这样的人改变这片星域的事业..."

texts.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you, but not so much that they've invited you to share power as a member," she says.

"Why play the mercenary for below-market rates? You're better than that, I think."
texts.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，但并未邀请你作为成员共享权力，" 她说道。

"为何要以低于市场的价格扮演雇佣兵？我想，你值得更好的待遇。"

texts.en:
"You've a League commission. They see value in you," she looks down, and aside, placing a hand on the empty expanse of her enormous desk.

"But not enough to invite you to become a full member of the League, despite your colonial enterprise." She makes a small sound, halfways between pity and disappointment.

"Consider what you will gain from being a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"你持有联盟的雇佣协议。他们看到了你的价值，" 她垂目侧视，将手放在自己那空阔的巨大桌面上。

"但尽管你有殖民事业，但他们仍未邀请你成为联盟的正式成员。" 她发出轻微的声响，介于怜悯与失望之间。

"不妨想想成为合作伙伴而非从属者后，你将获得什么。"

texts.en:
"You're a member of the League. A junior member, however. Perhaps not in name, but... tell me, do the gens respect you as a peer?"

"Or are you just another vassal to their little empire? Consider your future, captain, and how you might truly achieve greatness."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"你是联盟的一员，尽管只是下级成员。或许名义上不是，但...告诉我，氏族势力可曾将你视为平辈？"

"抑或你只是他们那小小帝国的又一个附庸？考量你的未来吧，舰长，思考你该如何真正地成就伟业。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

texts.en:
"Tell me the truth, are you content to be a mere lackey of our mutual friend Reynard Hannan? He drains you like a leech from atop his so-called League. Let me give you a taste of real business, of real credits."

Her eyes narrow. "As a partner rather than a subject."
texts.zh:
"说实话，你甘于当我们共同朋友 Reynard Hannan 的区区仆从吗？他高踞在所谓的联盟顶端，如蚂蟥般榨取你的价值。不妨让我带你体验真正的生意，真正的星币。"

她眯起眼睛，"以合作伙伴的身份，而非臣属。"

texts.en:
"Tell me, how is Rayan Arroyo? I've always admired his entrepreneurial spirit, but." She forms a little smile that might have been apologetic if it weren't so condescending.

"He doesn't have the killer instinct required for senior leadership. Isn't that funny? But we do need people like him."

"And we need people like you. Go-getters, achievers; builders and destroyers. And what we need, we at Tri-Tachyon pay for. Only the best."
texts.zh:
"告诉我，Rayan Arroyo 近况如何？我一直欣赏他的企业家精神，但是..." 她露出一个本该是歉意的微笑，却透着居高临下的意味。

"他缺乏高层领导所需的杀手本能。这很有趣，不是吗？但我们的确需要像他这样的人。"

"我们也需要你这样的人。行动派，实干家；建设者与毁灭者。而我们 速子科技 对于需要的事物，向来只聘用最顶尖的人才。"

texts.en:
"You cut a deal with the Company after some... assertive negotiations. To our mutual benefit. I applaud your audacity."

Her teeth glisten.

"Such fierce initiative is exactly what Tri-Tachyon needs."
texts.zh:
"经过一番...强势谈判后，你与公司达成了协议。这对我们双方都有利，我赞赏你的胆识。"

她的牙齿闪闪发光。

"如此凌厉的进取心正是 速子科技 所需要的。"

texts.en:
"You've had a taste of working for the Company. A mundane commission, mercenary fare. Boilerplate. Busywork. We'd have automated all that sort of thing long ago, of course, if not for-"

She pulls her gaze back down. "I digress. You're capable of much more. Think of this as the next step."
texts.zh:
"你已浅尝过为公司效力的滋味。无聊的差事，雇佣兵的薪酬。千篇一律。无谓的忙碌。若非某些原因，我们早该将这类工作全面自动化了 ——"

她将视线收回，"好吧，我有些离题了。我相信你有能力成就更多，远不止于此。请将此视为迈向更高层级的阶梯。"

texts.en:
"You're not only an explorer, you're a builder - founding a new colony!"

"It is bold of you to strike out despite the anti-innovation measures sure to fall upon you from the major factions," she says. "I suspect you'll benefit from an injection of capital. For the builder must also ensure that their prosperity cannot be simply seized by the small-minded takers."
texts.zh:
"你不仅是探索者，更是建设者 —— 你正在建立新的殖民地！"

"在各大势力必将施加反创新措施的背景下，你的开拓之举堪称勇毅，" 她说道，"我认为资本的注入将助你一臂之力。因为建设者必须确保自己的繁荣果实不会被眼界狭隘的掠夺者轻易夺取。"

texts.en: "I believe that's enough of that, captain," she says stonily.
texts.zh: "我想这个话题可以到此为止了，舰长，" 她冷硬地说道。

texts.en:
Her expression is blank for a moment.

"On second thought, I feel no need to justify myself," she says stonily.
texts.zh:
她的表情凝固了片刻。

"转念一想，我觉得我无需自证，" 她冷硬地说道。

texts.en: "Now allow me to explain the shape of our partnership."
texts.zh: "现在请允许我阐明我们合作关系的框架。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. You found something very old in the Abyss. Something known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。你在深渊中发现了非常古老的存在，历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. The ship is in your fleet - what is known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。那所正位于你舰队中的舰船 —— 历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "You know my title. I take a portion of surplus capital from the Company and invest it in what we like to call 'black sky initiatives'."
texts.zh: "你知道我的头衔。我从公司提取部分盈余的资本，投入我们称之为 '黑天计划' 的领域。"

texts.en:
"There are unimaginable possibilities out there." She raises an arm, hand extended, fingers like rays into the far, dark corners of the cavernous office.

You sense the lights dim slightly - a dramatic effect triggered by her cybernetic implants, no doubt.
texts.zh:
"那里蕴藏着无法想象的可能性。" 她抬起手臂，伸出手掌，手指如光芒般射向这间巨型办公室深处幽暗的角落。

你察觉到灯光变得略微黯淡 —— 无疑是她的赛博植入体触发的浮夸效果。

texts.en:
"I take the very long shots. There are things," she stresses the word oddly, "Such things out there, captain. Technologies and phenomena the Human Domain hid away, and from. They locked such wonders and treasures up in red-tape concocted by fearful, jealous little minds. They suffocated these opportunities, blinded themselves to unimaginable possibilities."

"The returns from exploitation would be... astronomical. Or perhaps," her eyes glint in the filtered starlight, "They may prove to be of value well beyond that of mere stars."
texts.zh:
"我专攻那些极低概率的机会。那里存在着，" 她异常地重读这个词，"那样的事物，舰长。人之领 曾隐藏 —— 并逃避 —— 的技术与现象。他们用怯懦而狭隘的头脑炮制的官僚程序，将这些奇迹与珍宝禁锢起来。他们扼杀了这些机遇，对无法想象的可能性视而不见。"

"开发这些事物带来的回报将是...天文数字。或者，" 她的眼眸在过滤的星光下闪烁着，"它们可能被证明拥有远超星辰的价值。"

options.en: Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits.
options.zh: 你说回报吗？听起来是笔巨款。

options.en: Exploration and new technology are of interest to me.
options.zh: 探索与新技术正是我的兴趣所在。

options.en: You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone.
options.zh: 你这是在干涉本应该保持原状的事物。

options.en: I found some mercs in the Abyss who appeared to regret their deal with you.
options.zh: 我在深渊里遇到了一些佣兵，他们似乎对和你的交易颇为后悔。

texts.zh: "是的，" 她微笑着，牙齿如珠宝般闪烁，"我会确保你获得应得的份额。"

texts.en: "The Perseus-Orion Abyss is a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, present company excepted. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
texts.zh: "英仙座-猎户座深渊 是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

texts.en: "You know of the Perseus-Orion Abyss; a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, excepting present company. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
texts.zh: "你听说过 英仙座-猎户座深渊 吗？真是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

texts.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You went there, and there you found the Onslaught Mk.I... and the 'Threat'."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"I very much desire to have a look at the Mk.I."
texts.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你去过那里，并在那里发现了 攻势 Mk.I...以及 '威胁'。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"我非常希望能亲自看看 Mk.I。"

texts.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You know of the 'Threat'." She looks away. "A typically non-descriptive name passed to us from some primitive government committee, I'm sure."

"You found Academician Cornelius Elek's enigma, the Onslaught Mk.I... among other things."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"This is what I want."
texts.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你也知道 '威胁'。" 她移开视线，"我敢肯定，这又是某个简陋的政府委员会所传达给我们的一个毫无描述性的名字。"

"你找到了 Cornelius Elek 院士的谜题，攻势 Mk.I...以及其他东西。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"这正是我想要的。"

options.en: You know a lot about what I've been doing.
options.zh: 你很了解我做过的事情。

options.en: You've been prompting Elek. How'd you know where to make him look?
options.zh: 你一直在诱导 Elek，你怎么知道该让他往哪里探索？

options.en: ...You want to buy the Onslaught Mk.I from me?
options.zh: ...你想从我这儿买下 攻势 Mk.I？

options.en: But what IS it?
options.zh: 但它究竟是什么？

options.en: How will I know when I find it?
options.zh: 我怎么知道自己找到了它？

options.en: I've seen them. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss.
options.zh: 我见过它们。那潜伏在深渊深处的，古老的自动化作战舰队。

options.en: I've encountered... entities in the Abyss. Non-material, high energy. Hostile.
options.zh: 我在深渊中遭遇过...一些实体，它们没有物质形态，能量极高，且敌对。

options.en: I've seen ancient warfleets deep in the abyss. And... non-material hostile entities.
options.zh: 我见过深渊深处古老的作战舰队。还有... 非物质态的敌对实体。

options.en: I've never encountered such a thing. (lie)
options.zh: 我从未遭遇过这种东西。 (说谎)

texts.en:
"Crews talk, TriPads listen. There is little I cannot know if I so wish," she says, injecting a tone of boredom into her words.

"Accept it. Now let's speak of business."
texts.zh:
"船员会闲聊，TriPad 会监听。只要我意愿，便鲜有不能知晓之事，" 她的话语中掺入一丝厌倦的腔调。

"接受现实吧。现在让我们谈谈正事。"

texts.en:
"Old records," she says curtly.

"The Galatia Academy doesn't know what it has, much less how to make good use of it. Their lack of self-motivation is self-evident."
texts.zh:
"旧档案，" 她简短地说道。

"Galatia 学院根本不清楚自己拥有什么，更别说善加利用。他们缺乏主观能动性的事实显而易见。"

texts.en: "A threat, presumably. The hostile connotation lives in the name." A quick, bloodless smile. "You'll prepare yourself for anything, I'm sure."
texts.zh: "一种威胁，大概如此，敌意就蕴含在这个名称里。" 她露出一个迅速而苍白的微笑，"我相信你会做好应对任何情况的准备。"

texts.en: "Something which threatened the Domain, presumably." A quick, bloodless smile. "You'll prepare yourself for anything, I'm sure."
texts.zh: "想来是曾危及人之领的什么东西。\" 她飞快地一笑，笑里没有半点温度。\"你必定会做好万全准备，这我信得过。"

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting your expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
texts.zh: "我坚持要求你不计成本地为科考任务配给物资，携带远超预估需求的燃料与补给，以免像那些 —— 算了，不提他们了。你是赢家，而我们只押注赢家。"

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting another expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
texts.zh: "我要求你不惜工本，再备一支探险队。燃料和补给，比你估摸着够用的再多带些，免得落得像那——算了，不提他们。你是赢家，我们只押赢家。"

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting another expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting your expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
texts.zh: "我要求你不惜工本，把队伍装备停当。燃料和补给，比你估摸着够用的再多带些，免得落得像那——算了，不提他们。你是赢家，我们只押赢家。"

options.en: Like the who? Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 像哪些人？难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

options.en: Like the who? Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 像谁？我之前还有过一支探险队？

options.zh: 像谁？我之前还有一支成了事的探险队？

options.zh: 像谁？我之前还有一支成了事的探险队？

texts.en:
"We assume it'll engage in some sort of hostile action against you or your $shipOrFleet," she says indifferently. "Only this won't be pirate, Pather, or tariff patrol."

"Nor," she fixes you with a cool look, "Some remnant AI warfleet. Those, those we know about."

"Disappointing conversationalists," she mutters. "Superintelligence with no mind for business. Simply unbelievable..."
texts.zh:
"我们推测它会对你或你的$shipOrFleet采取某种敌对行动，" 她漠然说道，"但这并非是海盗、左径分子，或关税巡逻队。"

"也并非是，" 她投来冷静的目光，"某支残存的 AI 战争舰队。那些东西，那些我们有所了解的东西。"

"令人失望的对话对象，" 她低语道，"具有超常的智能却毫无商业头脑，简直难以置信..."

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time.

"And you lived to tell it," she says, outwardly cool. You suspect, however, that you've impressed the Director because she pauses a moment to consider your words.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。

"而你活着讲述了它，" 她说道，神色冷酷。然而，你怀疑自己已经给这位总监留下了深刻的印象，因为她停顿了片刻以琢磨你的话语。

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time.

"That does not... quite fit with our working knowledge of the issue. Would you part with recordings of your... encounter with these entities? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。

"这与我们对该问题的现有认知不...甚吻合。你是否愿意出售你与这些实体...遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Fascinating," she says, and releases a breath. "This is unlike previous reports."
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

"令人着迷，" 她说道，一边轻吁一口气，"这与先前的报告截然不同。"

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And she stares for several seconds, motionless.

"You're telling the truth," she says, outwardly cool.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounters with both of these... forces? I offer 150,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。她凝视数秒，纹丝不动。

"你说的是真话，" 她说道，外表依然冷静。

"你是否愿意出售你与这两股...势力遭遇的影像记录？我出 150,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en: "So you are open to dealing," she says. "Good."
texts.zh: "所以你愿意交易，" 她说道，"很好。"

texts.en: "You've been most useful," she says, almost actually smiling. It looks uncomfortable.
texts.zh: "你贡献卓著，" 她说道，几乎真的露出了微笑，看上去极不自然。

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings.
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响了。

texts.en: "Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for... and more."
texts.zh: "Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for... and more."

options.zh: 所以你清楚自己所需要的是什么，难道在我之前还有另一支考察队吗？

options.zh: 所以你清楚自己所需要的是什么，难道还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

texts.en:
She blinks and her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And they narrow slightly.

"Of course not," she says. "But when you do, I'm sure you'll quickly realize why no one else in the Sector is prepared to deal seriously with this... Threat. It is in your interest to work with me."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注，眼睛也微微眯起。

"当然没有，" 她说道，"但等到你真的遇到时，我相信你会立刻明白为何星域内没有其他势力准备认真应对这个...威胁。与我合作符合你的利益。"

texts.en:

"Of course not," she says. "But when you do, I'm sure you'll quickly realize why no one else in the Sector is prepared to deal seriously with this... Threat. It is in your interest to work with me."

options.en: You say 'when'. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '等到'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

texts.en:
"It is true, however, that the Abyss is hostile to our hyperspace technology. That is precisely why the secrets it holds may be all the more profitably disruptive."

She turns to look you full-on, once more. "I want you to go there. I have data... there is something to find. Very old. Very dangerous. Very valuable. Bring me scans, samples. You will be paid handsomely for tangible specimens."
texts.zh:
"但深渊确实对我们的超空间技术充满敌意。而这恰恰意味着其中隐藏的秘密可能带来更具颠覆性的利润。"

她再度转过身来直视着你，"我要你去往那里。我掌握着数据...那里存在值得探查的事物，非常古老，极度危险，也价值连城。为我带回扫描数据，采集样本。对于实体标本，你将获得丰厚的酬劳。"

options.en: You haven't said exactly what I'm looking for. Salvage?
options.zh: 你还没具体说明我要寻找什么。是要打捞物品吗？

texts.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisifed. "Something more valuable."
texts.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

options.en: Is this about remnants of the AI War fleets?
options.zh: 这与余辉的 AI 战争舰队有关吗？

options.en: Is it aliens?
options.zh: 这是外星人吗？

options.en: Yes, but you haven't said what.
options.zh: 是的，但你还没具体说明要找什么。

texts.en:
"Those old things?" She gives her head an abbreviated shake.

"No, we have people for that. Although," she fixes you with a look, "they've made quite a mess of it, haven't they? The wasted possibilities... but no, we're looking for something older... different."
texts.zh:
"那些旧东西？" 她简短地摇了摇头。

"不，我们有专人负责那些。不过，" 她凝视着你，"它们确实搞得一团糟，不是吗？那些被浪费的可能性...但我们寻找的是更古老的...不同的东西。"

texts.en: Sensing the insufficiency of her pep-talk, she begins anew: "What it is, is old. Early Domain. Pre-Persean Frontier, but we have reason to believe some part of it is out... here. Whether it followed us or we followed it. Whatever it is, wherever there is."
texts.zh: 察觉到自己的鼓舞之辞不够有力，她重新开口道："重点是，它很古老。早于 人之领 时期，在英仙座边境形成之前，但我们有理由相信它的某些部分就在...这里。不知是它尾随而来，还是我们追寻至此。无论它是什么，无论它在何处。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisfied. "Something more valuable."
texts.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

texts.en:
"No, nothing like that." She emits a joyless laugh, like a machine, then pauses suddenly.

"Although if you did happen to find alien technology... provide me with exclusive access and I would ensure you credits enough to purchase your own solar system. Or," she waves a hand in an unconscious arc, "Build yourself a new one out of dross, if that's what you enjoy."
texts.zh:
"不，不是那种东西。" 她发出机器般毫无欢愉的笑声，随即突然停顿。

"不过，如果你真的偶然发现了外星技术...那就向我提供独家接触权限，我会确保你获得足以买下一整个恒星系的财富。或者，" 她无意识地挥手划了个弧线，"如果你喜欢，用废料给自己造个新的也行。"

texts.en: "There's no need. Our strategic indicators forecast a reasonably likely chance of your survival if your outlook is unbiased by speculation, so take heart." She trails off.
texts.zh: "没必要。我们的战略指标预测，如果你不受主观臆断影响，那么你的存活概率将相当可观，所以振作些。" 她的声音渐渐低了下去。

texts.en: "Then I think we shall work well together," she says.
texts.zh: "那么我想我们会合作得很愉快，" 她说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Yes. Does that frighten you?" she asks.
texts.zh: "是的。这让你感到恐惧吗？" 她问道。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 不。

options.en: No. (lie)
options.zh: 不。 (说谎)

options.en: Yes. I'd be a fool if I did not fear what's out there.
options.zh: 是的。如果不对那里的存在心怀敬畏，那我才真是愚蠢。

options.en: Yes. Which is why I require adequate compensation.
options.zh: 是的。正因如此，我需要获得充分的补偿。

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your pretense of bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你佯装的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I see," she says after a moment.

"I trust that you shall ensure your executive judgment is merely tempered, not impaired, by such sentiment."
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 她停顿片刻后说道。

"我相信你会确保这种情绪仅仅只会调节，而非削弱你的决策判断力。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Of course," she says, allowing a trace of amusement to enter her voice.
texts.zh: "当然，" 她说道，话音里渗入了一丝玩味。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Her head gives a small twitch.

"Regret, you say."
texts.zh:
她的头部微微抽动了一下。

"后悔，你是说。"

options.en: They used rather stronger language to express the sentiment.
options.zh: 他们表达的措辞可激烈得多。

options.en: They came to a poor end. I should like to avoid that for myself.
options.zh: 他们的结局很糟，我想让自己避免那种下场。

texts.en:
"I see," she says.

"You found them. In the Abyss. And returned." The Director pauses a moment. "This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 她说道。

"你找到了他们，在深渊里，并且回来了。" 总监停顿片刻，"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

options.en: That's one way of looking at it.
options.zh: 这也是其中一种角度。

options.en: It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.
options.zh: 那里很危险，极其危险。

texts.en: She makes no outward reaction to your implication, simply proceeding as if you'd said nothing at all.
texts.zh: 她对你的暗示毫无表露，只是继续着，仿佛你未曾开口一般。

texts.en:
"Evidently, you already have," she says.

"This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
texts.zh:
"显然，你已经做到了，" 她说道。

"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

options.en: That's one way of looking at it.
options.zh: 这也是其中一种角度。

options.en: It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.
options.zh: 那里很危险，极其危险。

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, eyes black.

"I shall make my proposal shortly. First, allow me to elaborate on a shape for our partnership."
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，双眼漆黑。

"我将很快提出我的方案。首先，请允许我进一步阐述我们合作关系的框架。"

options.en: I'm listening.
options.zh: 我在听。

options.en: I don't see how that's your business.
options.zh: 我不认为这与你有关。

options.en: I don't think about it. Like you said, I'm practical.
options.zh: 我不会考虑这个。如你所说，我很务实。

options.en: I do. I stand for the Church and the Church with me.
options.zh: 是的。我支持教会，教会也支持我。

options.en: I do believe, but not as does the Church. I follow Ludd's Word.
options.zh: 我确实信仰，但并非依循教会的信条。我追随卢德的圣言。

options.en: Not as such. My interest is humanitarian.
options.zh: 并非如此。我的关注是出于人道主义。

options.en: No, my interest is purely mercenary.
options.zh: 不，我的关注纯粹出于雇佣关系。

options.en: Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better.
options.zh: 当然不是，这问题太荒谬了。你该更明事理一些。

options.en: Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better. (lie)
options.zh: 当然不是，这问题太荒谬了。你该更明事理一些。 (说谎)

texts.en:
If her look could become any colder without freezing the local atmo, it would.

"An interest in your business is my business if we are to do business. I shall repeat the point for emphasis: it is important that I know where we stand." Her hands, neatly folded, gently draw apart and close. Not clenched into fists, but...

"Do you believe?"
texts.zh:
她的眼神愈发冰冷，而且只要空气还尚未结冰，她就不介意让自己的目光再冰冷几分。

"如果你我还有所关联，那么和你有关的事情就等同于和我有关。我必须重申要点以进行强调：明确我们的立场是至关重要的。" 她交叠的双手缓缓分开又合拢。并未攥成拳，但...

"你相信那些东西吗？"

texts.en:
"I see," she says as if she quite distinctly doesn't.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
texts.zh:
"明白了，" 她的行为和话语截然相反。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I see," she says as if she quite distinctly doesn't.

Her head tilts very slightly, perplexed.
texts.zh:
"明白了，" 她的行为和话语截然相反。

她微微歪着头，一脸困惑。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "How admirable," she says with no attempt to inject sincerity into her words. It is a dismissal; she pauses for but a moment then proceeds.
texts.zh: "真令人钦佩，" 她的言语毫无真诚之意。这已经是逐客令；她仅停顿片刻便继续开口。

texts.en:
"How unexpected," she says, curious.

"I suppose one must concede that the Church is not without some wealth and not without need for services unclouded by... fanatic enthusiasm. I suppose you've found something of a niche market for yourself. However limited."
texts.zh:
"真是出人意料，" 她说道，语气好奇。

"看来我必须承认，教会并非没有财力，也并非不需要那些不受...狂热信仰影响的纯粹服务。你似乎为自己找到了某个利基市场，尽管相当有限。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: A cool smile. "Of course. I just wanted to hear you say it." She pauses for a moment, then proceeds.
texts.zh: 她露出一抹冷淡的微笑。"当然。我只是想听你亲口说出来。" 她停顿片刻，而后继续开口。

texts.en:
"Of course." A cool smile. "I wanted to hear you say it."

Her eyes seem suddenly more engaged - focused and examining you intently, distantly. Like you're a lab experiment pinned to a dissection table.
texts.zh:
"当然。" 她露出一抹冷淡的微笑。"我只是想听你亲口说出来。"

她的目光突然变得锐利 —— 专注而疏离地审视着你，仿佛你是钉在解剖台上的实验样本。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Your interest in matters of the Luddics has been noted. Even working with, perhaps for, an archcurate. I can only assume it's a charity case for one so evidently practical as yourself. Am I wrong? You don't actually believe in that stuff, surely."

She looks cooly astonished at the thought, inviting your denial.
texts.zh:
"你对卢德事务的关注已被记录在案，甚至正在与某位大祭司一同工作，或者可能是受雇于他。我只能认为这对你这种务实之人而言不过是一桩慈善业务罢了。我说错了吗？你总不会真信那些东西吧。"

她对这个想法露出冷淡的惊异表情，仿佛在期待你的否认。

texts.en: The intimation of a smile flits over her expression, though her eyes remain chillingly distant.
texts.zh: 一抹近似微笑的弧度掠过她的面容，但她的双眼依旧保持着令人心寒的疏离感。

texts.en: She gives you a curt look, but no comment.
texts.zh: 她向你投来一个简短的眼神，但未置一词。

texts.en:
"Risk of annihilation," she answers placidly. "For which you'll be appropriately compensated."

"Allow me to iterate your accomplishments briefly so that you know I do not make my offer without consideration."
texts.zh:
"尸骨无存的风险，" 她平静地答道，"对此你也将获得相应的补偿。"

"请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以便你知道我的提议并非是轻率之举。"

texts.en:
"The demand for my time is great, thus its premium."

Her lip quirks; not quite worth a smile.

"You must appreciate what I've already invested in you. Further to that point: allow me to iterate your accomplishments briefly so that you know where we stand."
texts.zh:
"我的时间总是供不应求，因此价格不菲。"

她嘴角微动；但并没有露出微笑。

"你必须感谢我对你作出的那些投入。进一步而言：请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以让你清楚我们现在的立场。"

texts.en: Glamor-Rotanev remains standing to match.
texts.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 保持站立来配合高度。

texts.en: "It is, isn't it?" the secretary agrees cheerfully.
texts.zh: "确实如此，不是吗？" 秘书欢快的附和道。

options.en: Take a shuttle to visit Director of Special Acquisitions Glamor-Rotanev
options.zh: 搭乘穿梭机前往拜访特殊采购部总监 Glamor-Rotanev

texts.en:
Your shuttle descends into the young atmosphere of Eochu Bres, through towering battlements of clouds. A spray of rain darkens your viewport for a moment before it is wiped clean by the heat and speed of your descent.

The flight path immediately deviates from the general approach corridor which had started ticking off minor use-fees from the Tri-Tachyon owned flight control: general volume access fee, priority flight lane fee, service fee, customer satisfaction insurance charge, advertisement bypass fee.

The notifications self-delete, their fees automatically refunded, as the towering central arcologies of Xanadu emerge from the mist.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机降入了 Eochu Bres 刚形成不久的大气层，在犹如城垛般的高耸云层间穿行。一阵雨雾喷洒在你的视窗上，又随即被降下时的热量和速度擦拭干净。

飞行路线立刻就偏离了一般的进场通道，并引发了一堆来自 速子科技 航空管制的小额扣费：基本空域通行费、优先航路附加费、服务费、客户满意度保险费、广告屏蔽费，

当 Xanadu 高耸的核心生态都市群从薄雾中显现时，这些通知便自行删除了，所有费用也自动进行了退还。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Jagged mountain peaks ring the horizon. Gleaming monoliths glitter, spears of capital upthrust through the glowering flesh of the world. Skyarco II grows before you, prismatic.

Your shuttle alights on a landing pad held at some distance from the facade by an airy support rib. It looks impossibly thin, but on touch down feels as solid as a coherent M-type asteroid.
texts.zh:
锯齿状的山峰环绕着地平线。闪闪发光的石碑群是如此璀璨夺目，如同刺穿星球阴郁躯壳的资本长矛。Skyarco II 在你眼前铺展开来，折射着斑斓的光彩。

你的穿梭机降落在停机坪上，这片平台由轻盈的支撑肋骨托举悬空于建筑立面之外。它看似脆弱得不可思议，但着陆时却坚实如一块完整的 M 型小行星。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You step onto a perfectly dry pad. A shimmer as wind drives a burst of rain into the atmo-field betrays the artifice of this pocket of calm.

You are invited inside by an obsequious corporate usher.
texts.zh:
你踏上保持着完美干燥的停机坪。一阵风将雨水卷进大气防护场时泛起的微光，揭示了这片宁静表象的人工本质。

一位殷勤的企业礼宾员将你引入了室内。

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
The architecture of Skyarco II's interior and its integrated art-installations are titanic in scale and inhuman in affect. Your attention is subtly drawn toward geometric motifs suggestive of a mathematical intricacy which would reward close study with nothing less than delight, and...

"It was designed by an Artificial Intelligence," the cheerful secretary behind the reception desk informs you, breaking the trance. "Before the ban imposed by the Hegemony, of course."

"The piece is explicitly referent-free to reflect the pure universe of interstellar markets which invite every new partner to participate in Tri-Tachyon's enterprise!"
texts.zh:
Skyarco II 的内部建筑与融合在其中的艺术装置，其规模堪称泰坦巨构，氛围却透着非人的冷峻。你的注意力被微妙地引向几何图案 —— 它们暗示着数学般的精妙结构，如果细细品味，必将收获无上的愉悦，并且...

"这是由人工智能设计的，" 前台那位笑容可掬的秘书打破了你的出神状态，"当然是在 霸主 颁布禁令之前。"

"这件作品刻意避免了任何参照物，旨在映射纯粹的星际市场宇宙 —— 它正邀请每位新伙伴加入 速子科技 的商业版图！"

options.en: I'm here to see Director Glamor-Rotanev.
options.zh: 我来这儿是为了见 Glamor-Rotenev 总监。

options.en: Isn't that nice.
options.zh: 真不错呢。

texts.en: "It is, isn't it?" the secretary agrees cheerfully.
texts.zh: "确实如此，不是吗？" 秘书欢快的附和道。

texts.en:
"Of course, $playerSirOrMadam," the secretary says with a smile. "The Director asked that you head right in."

The lighting of the richly furnished entryway - is that a mercury fountain? - warms slightly, inviting you to proceed.
texts.zh:
"当然，$playerSirOrMadam，" 秘书微笑着说。"总监请您直接进去。"

华贵装潢的门厅里 —— 那是个水银喷泉吗？—— 灯光微微转暖，邀请你前行。

options.en: Enter the office of the Director of Special Acquisitions
options.zh: 进入特殊采购部总监的办公室。

texts.en:
A plane of glass - diamond-matrix, naturally - stretches in both directions to the edge of your peripheral vision, its extent blocked only by a set of cyclopean interior columns. Misty mountains and towering arcologies wreathed in rain clouds hang in the vista beyond.

Before you, a figure sits - now stands - behind a monolithic desk stark as a planetoid scraped bare by pulsar beam.

The Director of "Special Acquisitions".

A hand raises, open, to invite you to sit. A seat appears.
texts.zh:
一片玻璃平台 —— 自然是由金刚石方窗组成 —— 向两侧延伸至视野尽头，边界仅被一排独眼巨人般的室内立柱所阻隔。朦胧的群山和耸立的生态都市群间缭绕着雨云，悬垂天边。

在你面前，一道身影端坐 —— 旋即起身 —— 于一张浑如小行星般的巨大办公桌后，桌面光洁如同被脉冲星冲刷过一样。

"特殊采购部" 的总监。

她抬手，手掌打开，邀你入座。一张座椅旋即出现。

options.en: Sit
options.zh: 坐下

options.en: Stand
options.zh: 站着

texts.en: Glamor-Rotanev remains standing to match.
texts.zh: Glamor-Rotanev 保持站立来配合高度。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName. I offer vast wealth in exchange for your unique facility in navigating exceptional scenarios."

She blinks once. Her gaze is fixed on you, but you can't help but feel it is slightly vague, apparently attentive but not present in spirit. The look of a cyber-aug.

Her tech must be absolutely top-of-the-line, of course.
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。我愿以巨额的财富，换取您于特殊情境中那无可替代的航行才能。"

她眨了下眼，目光锁定在你身上。但你不禁感觉那眼神有点飘忽，看似专注却神游他处 —— 那是神经植入体使用者特有的眼神。

她的技术植入体肯定是最顶级的，毋庸置疑。

options.en: I'll hear you out. What's the proposal?
options.zh: 我洗耳恭听，你的提议是什么？

options.en: What's the catch?
options.zh: 有什么条件？

options.en: Directly to business, huh? No small-talk?
options.zh: 这就直奔主题了，嗯？不先寒暄几下？

texts.en: "Fitting to your talents, I think," she says. "Allow me to iterate your accomplishments briefly so that you know where we stand."
texts.zh: "我认为这符合你的才能，" 她说道，"请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以让你清楚我们现在的立场。"

"Risk of annihilation," she answers placidly. "For which you'll be appropriately compensated."

"Allow me to iterate your accomplishments briefly so that you know I do not make my offer without consideration."

"请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以便你知道我的提议并非是轻率之举。"

她嘴角微动；但并没有露出微笑。

"你必须感谢我对你作出的那些投入。进一步而言：请允许我简要回顾你的成就，以让你清楚我们现在的立场。"

options.en: Say nothing
options.zh: 保持沉默

options.en: Been spying on me?
options.zh: 一直在监视我？

options.en: My favorite subject, please proceed.
options.zh: 我最爱听这个话题，请继续。

texts.en: The intimation of a smile flits over her expression, though her eyes remain chillingly distant.
texts.zh: 一抹近似微笑的弧度掠过她的面容，但她的双眼依旧保持着令人心寒的疏离感。

texts.en: "Now allow me to explain the shape of our partnership."
texts.zh: "现在请允许我阐明我们合作关系的框架。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. You found something very old in the Abyss. Something known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。你在深渊中发现了非常古老的存在，历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en: "Whatever your other, lesser accomplishments, there is one in particular which is why you are here. The ship is in your fleet - what is known to history as the Onslaught Mk.I, which is of interest to me."
texts.zh: "无论你有哪些次要的收获，唯有一项收获令你此刻站在这里。那所正位于你舰队中的舰船 —— 历史上被称为 攻势 Mk.I 的存在，而这正令我产生兴趣。"

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, eyes black.

"I shall make my proposal shortly. First, allow me to elaborate on a shape for our partnership."
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，双眼漆黑。

"我将很快提出我的方案。首先，请允许我进一步阐述我们合作关系的框架。"

options.en: I'm listening.
options.zh: 我在听。

texts.en: "You know my title. I take a portion of surplus capital from the Company and invest it in what we like to call 'black sky initiatives'."
texts.zh: "你知道我的头衔。我从公司提取部分盈余的资本，投入我们称之为 '黑天计划' 的领域。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"There are unimaginable possibilities out there." She raises an arm, hand extended, fingers like rays into the far, dark corners of the cavernous office.

You sense the lights dim slightly - a dramatic effect triggered by her cybernetic implants, no doubt.
texts.zh:
"那里蕴藏着无法想象的可能性。" 她抬起手臂，伸出手掌，手指如光芒般射向这间巨型办公室深处幽暗的角落。

你察觉到灯光变得略微黯淡 —— 无疑是她的赛博植入体触发的浮夸效果。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I take the very long shots. There are things," she stresses the word oddly, "Such things out there, captain. Technologies and phenomena the Human Domain hid away, and from. They locked such wonders and treasures up in red-tape concocted by fearful, jealous little minds. They suffocated these opportunities, blinded themselves to unimaginable possibilities."

"The returns from exploitation would be... astronomical. Or perhaps," her eyes glint in the filtered starlight, "They may prove to be of value well beyond that of mere stars."
texts.zh:
"我专攻那些极低概率的机会。那里存在着，" 她异常地重读这个词，"那样的事物，舰长。人之领 曾隐藏 —— 并逃避 —— 的技术与现象。他们用怯懦而狭隘的头脑炮制的官僚程序，将这些奇迹与珍宝禁锢起来。他们扼杀了这些机遇，对无法想象的可能性视而不见。"

"开发这些事物带来的回报将是...天文数字。或者，" 她的眼眸在过滤的星光下闪烁着，"它们可能被证明拥有远超星辰的价值。"

options.en: Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits.
options.zh: 你说回报吗？听起来是笔巨款。

options.en: Exploration and new technology are of interest to me.
options.zh: 探索与新技术正是我的兴趣所在。

options.en: You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone.
options.zh: 你这是在干涉本应该保持原状的事物。

options.en: I found some mercs in the Abyss who appeared to regret their deal with you.
options.zh: 我在深渊里遇到了一些佣兵，他们似乎对和你的交易颇为后悔。

options.en: Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits.
options.zh: 你说回报吗？听起来是笔巨款。

options.en: Exploration and new technology is of interest to me.
options.zh: 探索与新技术正是我的兴趣所在。

options.en: You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone.
options.zh: 你这是在干涉本应该保持原状的事物。

texts.en:
Her head gives a small twitch.

"Regret, you say."
texts.zh:
她的头部微微抽动了一下。

"后悔，你是说。"

options.en: They used rather stronger language to express the sentiment.
options.zh: 他们表达的措辞可激烈得多。

options.en: They came to a poor end. I should like to avoid that for myself.
options.zh: 他们的结局很糟，我想让自己避免那种下场。

texts.en:
"I see," she says.

"You found them. In the Abyss. And returned." The Director pauses a moment. "This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 她说道。

"你找到了他们，在深渊里，并且回来了。" 总监停顿片刻，"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

options.en: That's one way of looking at it.
options.zh: 这也是其中一种角度。

options.en: It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.
options.zh: 那里很危险，极其危险。

texts.en:
"Evidently, you already have," she says.

"This simply proves your fitness for the operation."
texts.zh:
"显然，你已经做到了，" 她说道。

"这恰恰证明了你是执行这项任务的最佳人选。"

options.en: That's one way of looking at it.
options.zh: 这也是其中一种角度。

options.en: It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous.
options.zh: 那里很危险，极其危险。

texts.en: "It is," she smiles, teeth jewel-like. "And I'll ensure that you receive your share."
texts.zh: "是的，" 她微笑着，牙齿如珠宝般闪烁，"我会确保你获得应得的份额。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Then I think we shall work well together," she says.
texts.zh: "那么我想我们会合作得很愉快，" 她说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Yes. Does that frighten you?" she asks.
texts.zh: "是的。这让你感到恐惧吗？" 她问道。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 不。

options.en: No. (lie)
options.zh: 不。 (说谎)

options.en: Yes. I'd be a fool if I did not fear what's out there.
options.zh: 是的。如果不对那里的存在心怀敬畏，那我才真是愚蠢。

options.en: Yes. Which is why I require adequate compensation.
options.zh: 是的。正因如此，我需要获得充分的补偿。

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
She pauses a moment, making no outward reaction to your pretense of bravado.

"I see," she allows, finally.
texts.zh:
她停顿片刻，对你佯装的虚张声势未表现出任何外在反应。

"我明白了，" 她最终允许道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I see," she says after a moment.

"I trust that you shall ensure your executive judgment is merely tempered, not impaired, by such sentiment."
texts.zh:
"我明白了，" 她停顿片刻后说道。

"我相信你会确保这种情绪仅仅只会调节，而非削弱你的决策判断力。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Of course," she says, allowing a trace of amusement to enter her voice.
texts.zh: "当然，" 她说道，话音里渗入了一丝玩味。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: She makes no outward reaction to your implication, simply proceeding as if you'd said nothing at all.
texts.zh: 她对你的暗示毫无表露，只是继续着，仿佛你未曾开口一般。

texts.en: "The Perseus-Orion Abyss is a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, present company excepted. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
texts.zh: "英仙座-猎户座深渊 是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

texts.en: "You know of the Perseus-Orion Abyss; a melodramatic name. I find spacers are a superstitious lot, excepting present company. Self-limiting mythology is best discarded if one means to ascend to the fullest of human potential." She looks away for a moment, making a dismissive flick with her flingers.
texts.zh: "你听说过 英仙座-猎户座深渊 吗？真是一个夸张的名称。我发现宇宙民大多迷信 —— 当然在座的除外。若想攀登人类潜力的顶峰，最好摒弃这类自我设限的神话。" 她移开视线片刻，手指做了个轻蔑的弹动。

texts.en:
"It is true, however, that the Abyss is hostile to our hyperspace technology. That is precisely why the secrets it holds may be all the more profitably disruptive."

She turns to look you full-on, once more. "I want you to go there. I have data... there is something to find. Very old. Very dangerous. Very valuable. Bring me scans, samples. You will be paid handsomely for tangible specimens."
texts.zh:
"但深渊确实对我们的超空间技术充满敌意。而这恰恰意味着其中隐藏的秘密可能带来更具颠覆性的利润。"

她再度转过身来直视着你，"我要你去往那里。我掌握着数据...那里存在值得探查的事物，非常古老，极度危险，也价值连城。为我带回扫描数据，采集样本。对于实体标本，你将获得丰厚的酬劳。"

options.en: You haven't said exactly what I'm looking for. Salvage?
options.zh: 你还没具体说明我要寻找什么。是要打捞物品吗？

texts.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You went there, and there you found the Onslaught Mk.I... and the 'Threat'."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"I very much desire to have a look at the Mk.I."
texts.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你去过那里，并在那里发现了 攻势 Mk.I...以及 '威胁'。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"我非常希望能亲自看看 Mk.I。"

texts.en:
"You know the Perseus-Orion Abyss. You know of the 'Threat'." She looks away. "A typically non-descriptive name passed to us from some primitive government committee, I'm sure."

"You found Academician Cornelius Elek's enigma, the Onslaught Mk.I... among other things."

She looks at you anew, more present somehow.

"This is what I want."
texts.zh:
"你知道 英仙座-猎户座深渊。你也知道 '威胁'。" 她移开视线，"我敢肯定，这又是某个简陋的政府委员会所传达给我们的一个毫无描述性的名字。"

"你找到了 Cornelius Elek 院士的谜题，攻势 Mk.I...以及其他东西。"

她重新审视着你，目光也变得异常专注。

"这正是我想要的。"

texts.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisifed. "Something more valuable."
texts.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

options.en: Is this about remnants of the AI War fleets?
options.zh: 这与余辉的 AI 战争舰队有关吗？

options.en: Is it aliens?
options.zh: 这是外星人吗？

options.en: Yes, but you haven't said what.
options.zh: 是的，但你还没具体说明要找什么。

texts.en:
"Those old things?" She gives her head an abbreviated shake.

"No, we have people for that. Although," she fixes you with a look, "they've made quite a mess of it, haven't they? The wasted possibilities... but no, we're looking for something older... different."
texts.zh:
"那些旧东西？" 她简短地摇了摇头。

"不，我们有专人负责那些。不过，" 她凝视着你，"它们确实搞得一团糟，不是吗？那些被浪费的可能性...但我们寻找的是更古老的...不同的东西。"

texts.en:
"No, nothing like that." She emits a joyless laugh, like a machine, then pauses suddenly.

"Although if you did happen to find alien technology... provide me with exclusive access and I would ensure you credits enough to purchase your own solar system. Or," she waves a hand in an unconscious arc, "Build yourself a new one out of dross, if that's what you enjoy."
texts.zh:
"不，不是那种东西。" 她发出机器般毫无欢愉的笑声，随即突然停顿。

"不过，如果你真的偶然发现了外星技术...那就向我提供独家接触权限，我会确保你获得足以买下一整个恒星系的财富。或者，" 她无意识地挥手划了个弧线，"如果你喜欢，用废料给自己造个新的也行。"

texts.en: "There's no need. Our strategic indicators forecast a reasonably likely chance of your survival if your outlook is unbiased by speculation, so take heart." She trails off.
texts.zh: "没必要。我们的战略指标预测，如果你不受主观臆断影响，那么你的存活概率将相当可观，所以振作些。" 她的声音渐渐低了下去。

texts.en: Sensing the insufficiency of her pep-talk, she begins anew: "What it is, is old. Early Domain. Pre-Persean Frontier, but we have reason to believe some part of it is out... here. Whether it followed us or we followed it. Whatever it is, wherever there is."
texts.zh: 察觉到自己的鼓舞之辞不够有力，她重新开口道："重点是，它很古老。早于 人之领 时期，在英仙座边境形成之前，但我们有理由相信它的某些部分就在...这里。不知是它尾随而来，还是我们追寻至此。无论它是什么，无论它在何处。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Not exactly," she says, self-satisfied. "Something more valuable."
texts.zh: "不完全是，" 她自得地说道，"是更有价值的东西。"

texts.en:
"Crews talk, TriPads listen. There is little I cannot know if I so wish," she says, injecting a tone of boredom into her words.

"Accept it. Now let's speak of business."
texts.zh:
"船员会闲聊，TriPad 会监听。只要我意愿，便鲜有不能知晓之事，" 她的话语中掺入一丝厌倦的腔调。

"接受现实吧。现在让我们谈谈正事。"

texts.en:
"Old records," she says curtly.

"The Galatia Academy doesn't know what it has, much less how to make good use of it. Their lack of self-motivation is self-evident."
texts.zh:
"旧档案，" 她简短地说道。

"Galatia 学院根本不清楚自己拥有什么，更别说善加利用。他们缺乏主观能动性的事实显而易见。"

texts.en: "A threat, presumably. The hostile connotation lives in the name." A quick, bloodless smile. "You'll prepare yourself for anything, I'm sure."
texts.zh: "一种威胁，大概如此，敌意就蕴含在这个名称里。" 她露出一个迅速而苍白的微笑，"我相信你会做好应对任何情况的准备。"

texts.en: "Something which threatened the Domain, presumably." A quick, bloodless smile. "You'll prepare yourself for anything, I'm sure."
texts.zh: "想来是曾危及人之领的什么东西。\" 她飞快地一笑，笑里没有半点温度。\"你必定会做好万全准备，这我信得过。"

texts.en:
"We assume it'll engage in some sort of hostile action against you or your $shipOrFleet," she says indifferently. "Only this won't be pirate, Pather, or tariff patrol."

"Nor," she fixes you with a cool look, "Some remnant AI warfleet. Those, those we know about."

"Disappointing conversationalists," she mutters. "Superintelligence with no mind for business. Simply unbelievable..."
texts.zh:
"我们推测它会对你或你的$shipOrFleet采取某种敌对行动，" 她漠然说道，"但这并非是海盗、左径分子，或关税巡逻队。"

"也并非是，" 她投来冷静的目光，"某支残存的 AI 战争舰队。那些东西，那些我们有所了解的东西。"

"令人失望的对话对象，" 她低语道，"具有超常的智能却毫无商业头脑，简直难以置信..."

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And she stares for several seconds, motionless.

"You're telling the truth," she says, outwardly cool.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounters with both of these... forces? I offer 150,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。她凝视数秒，纹丝不动。

"你说的是真话，" 她说道，外表依然冷静。

"你是否愿意出售你与这两股...势力遭遇的影像记录？我出 150,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en: "So you are open to dealing," she says. "Good."
texts.zh: "所以你愿意交易，" 她说道，"很好。"

texts.en: "You've been most useful," she says, almost actually smiling. It looks uncomfortable.
texts.zh: "你贡献卓著，" 她说道，几乎真的露出了微笑，看上去极不自然。

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings.
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的 TriPad 响了。

texts.en: "Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for... and more."
texts.zh: "Interesting," she says, and releases a breath. "Yes. This is what I am looking for... and more."

options.en: So you knew what you were asking for. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 所以你清楚自己所需要的是什么，难道在我之前还有另一支考察队吗？

options.zh: 所以你清楚自己所需要的是什么，难道还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time.

"And you lived to tell it," she says, outwardly cool. You suspect, however, that you've impressed the Director because she pauses a moment to consider your words.

"Would you part with recordings of your encounter with the Threat? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。

"而你活着讲述了它，" 她说道，神色冷酷。然而，你怀疑自己已经给这位总监留下了深刻的印象，因为她停顿了片刻以琢磨你的话语。

"你是否愿意出售你与威胁遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en:
She blinks. Her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time.

"That does not... quite fit with our working knowledge of the issue. Would you part with recordings of your... encounter with these entities? I offer 100,000 credits for immediate transfer."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注。

"这与我们对该问题的现有认知不...甚吻合。你是否愿意出售你与这些实体...遭遇的影像记录？我出 100,000 星币，要求即时传输。"

options.en: I accept.
options.zh: 我接受。

options.en: Perhaps another time.
options.zh: 也许下次吧。

texts.en:
For a full two seconds her eyes close, moving rapidly.

Your TriPad pings a credits transfer.

"Fascinating," she says, and releases a breath. "This is unlike previous reports."
texts.zh:
整整两秒，她紧闭双眼，眼睑快速颤动着。

你的TriPad 响起星币到账的提示。

options.zh: '先前的'？难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

options.en: 'Previous'? Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
options.zh: '先前的'？难道在我之前还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

texts.en:
She blinks and her eyes seem suddenly present for the first time. And they narrow slightly.

"Of course not," she says. "But when you do, I'm sure you'll quickly realize why no one else in the Sector is prepared to deal seriously with this... Threat. It is in your interest to work with me."
texts.zh:
她眨了眨眼，目光突然首次显露出专注，眼睛也微微眯起。

"当然没有，" 她说道，"但等到你真的遇到时，我相信你会立刻明白为何星域内没有其他势力准备认真应对这个...威胁。与我合作符合你的利益。"

options.en: You say 'when'. Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '等到'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

"当然没有，" 她说道，"但等到你真的遇到时，我相信你会立刻明白为何星域内没有其他势力准备认真应对这个...威胁。与我合作符合你的利益。"

options.en: You say 'when'. Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
options.zh: 你是说 '等到'，难道在我之前还有另一支科考队已经成功了吗？

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting your expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
texts.zh: "我坚持要求你不计成本地为科考任务配给物资，携带远超预估需求的燃料与补给，以免像那些 —— 算了，不提他们了。你是赢家，而我们只押注赢家。"

options.en: Like the who? Was there another expedition before me?
options.zh: 像哪些人？难道在我之前还有另一支科考队吗？

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting another expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
texts.zh: "我要求你不惜工本，再备一支探险队。燃料和补给，比你估摸着够用的再多带些，免得落得像那——算了，不提他们。你是赢家，我们只押赢家。"

texts.en: "I insist that you spare no expense in outfitting another expedition. Bring more fuel and supplies than you anticipate needing so that you don't embarrass yourself like the- well, never mind them. You're a winner, and we place our bets on winners."
texts.zh: "我要求你不惜工本，再备一支探险队。燃料和补给，比你估摸着够用的再多带些，免得落得像那——算了，不提他们。你是赢家，我们只押赢家。"

options.en: Like the who? Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?
options.zh: 像谁？我之前还有一支成了事的探险队？
